/*
  Document      : bin.location.js
  Description   : Master Bin Location (Lokasi Rak per Gudang) - WMS
                  Cascading Store & Filter Bin Location base on Warehouse
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/bin.locationCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    if (document.getElementById("mainHeaderText")) {
        document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Bin <em>Location</em>";
    }

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    function getFormAccess() {
        if (typeof window.formAccess !== 'undefined' && window.formAccess !== null) {
            return parseInt(window.formAccess, 10);
        }
        if (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined' && formAccess !== null) {
            return parseInt(formAccess, 10);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    // Container Wrapper Setup
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var mainWrapper = document.getElementById('binMainWrapper');
    if (!mainWrapper && gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        mainWrapper = document.createElement('div');
        mainWrapper.id = 'binMainWrapper';
        mainWrapper.style.cssText = 'display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:15px; width:100%;';
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(mainWrapper, gridContainer);
        mainWrapper.appendChild(gridContainer);
    }

    var binDtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
    binDtlDiv.id = 'binDtlContainer';
    binDtlDiv.style.cssText = 'background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color:#fff; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); font-size:13px; max-height:260px; overflow-y:auto; display:none; position:relative; flex-shrink:0;';
    if (mainWrapper) { mainWrapper.appendChild(binDtlDiv); }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. STORES
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var binField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'warehouse_id' }, { name: 'warehouse_name' },
        { name: 'code' }, { name: 'name' }, { name: 'zone' }, { name: 'rack' }, { name: 'level' }, { name: 'location_name' },
        { name: 'active', type: 'boolean' }
    ];

    // Store Warehouse Master
    var warehouseDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '/proyek/php-crud/bin.locationCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_warehouse' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }])
    });
    warehouseDs.load();

    // Store Bin Location Cascading (Filtered by Warehouse)
    var binByWarehouseDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '/proyek/php-crud/bin.locationCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_bin_by_warehouse' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, [
            { name: 'id' }, { name: 'code' }, { name: 'name' }, { name: 'zone' }, { name: 'rack' }, { name: 'level' }
        ])
    });

    // Main Store Grid
    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '/proyek/php-crud/bin.locationCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data' }, binField)
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. MAIN GRID PANEL
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var calcHeight = 320;
    try {
        if (typeof maxGridHeight === 'function' && gridContainer) {
            var h = maxGridHeight(gridContainer);
            if (h && h > 200) { calcHeight = Math.max(220, Math.round(h * 0.55)); }
        }
    } catch (e) { calcHeight = 320; }

    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: calcHeight,
        loadMask: true,
        stripeRows: true,
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        columns: [
            { header: 'Kode Bin', dataIndex: 'code', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
        { header: 'Nama Bin', dataIndex: 'name', width: 160, renderer: CellWrap },
        { header: 'Location', dataIndex: 'location_name', width: 140, renderer: CellWrap }, // <-- Kolom baru di sini
        { header: 'Gudang', dataIndex: 'warehouse_name', width: 150, renderer: CellWrap },
        { header: 'Zona', dataIndex: 'zone', width: 80 },
        { header: 'Rak', dataIndex: 'rack', width: 80 },
        { header: 'Level', dataIndex: 'level', width: 80 },
        {
            header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'active', width: 80, align: 'center',
            renderer: function (v) {
                var isAct = (v === true || v === 'true' || v === 't' || v === 1 || v === '1');
                return isAct ? '<span style="color:#4ade80;font-weight:bold;">Aktif</span>' : '<span style="color:#888;">Nonaktif</span>';
            }
        }
        ],
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                    editDataEnable();
                    loadBinDetail(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.code, dataRecord.warehouse_name);
                }
            }
        }
    });

    mainDs.load();
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. DETAIL VIEW STOK REALTIME
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function loadBinDetail(binId, binCode, warehouseName) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '/proyek/php-crud/bin.locationCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_bin_detail', bin_id: binId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    binDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:15px; color:yellow;">Gagal memuat detail stok Bin Location.</div>';
                    binDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderBinDetailView(res.data || [], binCode, warehouseName);
            },
            failure: function () {
                binDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:15px; color:red;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                binDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderBinDetailView(rows, binCode, warehouseName) {
        var fmtQty = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); };
        var html = '<div style="position:sticky; top:0; background:#1e222d; z-index:10; padding:12px 15px 0 15px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);">' +
                   '  <h3 style="margin:0 0 10px 0; color:#ffffff !important; font-size:14px;">' +
                   '    Rincian Stok Barang pada Bin: ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(binCode || '') + ' (' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(warehouseName || '') + ')' +
                   '  </h3>' +
                   '  <table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px;">' +
                   '    <thead><tr>' +
                   '      <th align="left" style="width:20%; padding:8px 6px; color:#cccccc !important;">Kode Item</th>' +
                   '      <th align="left" style="width:45%; padding:8px 6px; color:#cccccc !important;">Nama Barang / Item</th>' +
                   '      <th align="left" style="width:15%; padding:8px 6px; color:#cccccc !important;">Grade</th>' +
                   '      <th align="right" style="width:20%; padding:8px 6px; color:#cccccc !important;text-align: right !important;">Qty Stok</th>' +
                   '    </tr></thead>' +
                   '  </table></div>';

        html += '<div style="padding:0 15px 12px 15px;"><table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px;"><tbody>';
        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="4" style="padding:20px; text-align:center; color:#aaaaaa !important;">Tidak ada barang tersimpan di lokasi rak/bin ini.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var qty = parseFloat(r.qty) || 0;
                html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">' +
                        '  <td style="width:20%; padding:7px 6px; color:#ffffff !important; font-family:monospace;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.item_code || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '  <td style="width:45%; padding:7px 6px; color:#ffffff !important;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.item_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '  <td style="width:15%; padding:7px 6px; color:#ffffff !important;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.grade_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '  <td style="width:20%; padding:7px 6px; color:#4ade80 !important; font-weight:bold;" align="right">' + fmtQty(qty) + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }
        html += '</tbody></table></div>';

        binDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        binDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
        binDtlDiv.scrollTop = 0;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. FORM EDITOR & FIELD DEFINITION (CASCADING FILTERING)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fldWarehouse = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Gudang',
        id: 'warehouse_id',
        name: 'warehouse_id',
        hiddenName: 'warehouse_id',
        store: warehouseDs,
        displayField: 'name',
        valueField: 'id',
        allowBlank: false,
        listeners: {
            select: function (combo, record) {
                var whId = combo.getValue();
                fldBinLocation.clearValue();
                binByWarehouseDs.load({ params: { warehouse_id: whId } });
            }
        }
    });

    var fldBinLocation = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Lokasi Bin',
        id: 'bin_location_id',
        name: 'bin_location_id',
        hiddenName: 'bin_location_id',
        store: binByWarehouseDs,
        displayField: 'code',
        valueField: 'id',
        mode: 'local',
        triggerAction: 'all',
        emptyText: 'Pilih Bin Location...'
    });

    var fldCode = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Kode Bin', id: 'code', name: 'code', allowBlank: false });
    var fldName = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Nama Bin', id: 'name', name: 'name' });
    var fldZone = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Zona', id: 'zone', name: 'zone' });
    var fldRack = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Rak', id: 'rack', name: 'rack' });
    var fldLevel = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Level', id: 'level', name: 'level' });
    
    var fldActive = new Ext.form.Checkbox({
        fieldLabel: 'Status Aktif',
        labelSeparator: '&nbsp;&nbsp;-&nbsp;&nbsp;',
        id: 'active',
        name: 'active',
        cls: 'fieldCheckClass regular-checkbox',
        inputValue: 'true',
        checked: true
    });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 130,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldWarehouse },
            { items: fldCode },
            { items: fldName },
            { items: fldZone },
            { items: fldRack },
            { items: fldLevel },
            { columnWidth: 0.5, labelAlign: 'right', labelWidth: 130, items: fldActive }
        ]
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. ACTION HANDLERS
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var btnAdd = document.getElementById('addData');
    if (btnAdd) {
        btnAdd.onclick = function () {
            if (getFormAccess() >= 2) {
                task = 'create';
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Bin Location Baru';
                fldActive.setValue(true);
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menambah data.');
            }
        };
    }

    var btnEdit = document.getElementById('editData');
    if (btnEdit) {
        btnEdit.onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data yang ingin diedit.');
                return;
            }
            if (getFormAccess() >= 3) {
                task = 'update';
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();

                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Bin Location';

                fldWarehouse.setValue(dataRecord.warehouse_id);
                fldCode.setValue(dataRecord.code);
                fldName.setValue(dataRecord.name || '');
                fldZone.setValue(dataRecord.zone || '');
                fldRack.setValue(dataRecord.rack || '');
                fldLevel.setValue(dataRecord.level || '');
                
                // Load bin location store berdasarkan warehouse ID record yang diedit
                binByWarehouseDs.load({
                    params: { warehouse_id: dataRecord.warehouse_id },
                    callback: function () {
                        fldBinLocation.setValue(dataRecord.id);
                    }
                });

                var isActive = (
                    dataRecord.active === true || dataRecord.active === 'true' || 
                    dataRecord.active === 't' || dataRecord.active === 1 || dataRecord.active === '1'
                );
                fldActive.setValue(isActive);
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengedit.');
            }
        };
    }

    var btnDel = document.getElementById('deleteData');
    if (btnDel) {
        btnDel.onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data yang ingin dihapus.');
                return;
            }
            if (getFormAccess() >= 4) {
                Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi Hapus', "Hapus Bin Location '" + dataRecord.code + "'?", function (btn) {
                    if (btn === 'yes') {
                        Ext.Ajax.request({
                            url: '/proyek/php-crud/bin.locationCRD.php',
                            method: 'POST',
                            params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                            success: function (response) {
                                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Informasi', res.message);
                                if (res.success) {
                                    binDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                                    mainDs.load();
                                }
                            },
                            failure: function () {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses menghapus data.');
            }
        };
    }

    var btnSave = document.getElementById('saveEdit');
    if (btnSave) {
        btnSave.onclick = function () {
            if (!fldWarehouse.getValue()) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Gudang wajib dipilih.');
                return;
            }
            if (!fldCode.getValue()) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Kode wajib diisi.');
                return;
            }

            var currentId = (task === 'update' && dataRecord) ? dataRecord.id : null;

            Ext.Ajax.request({
                url: '/proyek/php-crud/bin.locationCRD.php',
                method: 'POST',
                params: {
                    task: task,
                    id: currentId,
                    warehouse_id: fldWarehouse.getValue(),
                    code: fldCode.getValue(),
                    name: fldName.getValue(),
                    zone: fldZone.getValue(),
                    rack: fldRack.getValue(),
                    level: fldLevel.getValue(),
                    active: fldActive.getValue() ? 'true' : 'false'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message);
                    if (res.success) {
                        binDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                        mainDs.load();
                        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    }
                },
                failure: function () {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
                }
            });
        };
    }

    if (document.getElementById('editorWdw')) {
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    }
});

/*

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    if (document.getElementById("mainHeaderText")) {
        document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Stock <em>Transfer</em>";
    }

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    function getFormAccess() {
        if (typeof window.formAccess !== 'undefined' && window.formAccess !== null) {
            return parseInt(window.formAccess, 10);
        }
        if (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined' && formAccess !== null) {
            return parseInt(formAccess, 10);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 0. Container Wrapper & Detail Panel Setup
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    (function injectExtraUI() {
        var gridContainer = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        if (gridContainer && !document.getElementById('lblTransferTotal')) {
            var totalsDiv = document.createElement('div');
            totalsDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px; margin-top:8px; font-weight:bold; font-size:14px; text-align:right; background:#1f2d3a; color:#ffffff !important; border-radius:4px;';
            totalsDiv.innerHTML = 'Total Qty Transfer: <span id="lblTransferTotal" style="color:#ffffff !important;">0.0000</span>';
            gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(totalsDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
        }
    })();

    // Container Detail Read-only di bawah grid utama (Pola Stock Card / GRN)
    var gridMainContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var detailDiv = document.createElement('div');
    detailDiv.id = 'transferDetailContainer';
    detailDiv.style.cssText = 'background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color:#fff; margin-top:15px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); font-size:13px; display:none; max-height:260px; overflow-y:auto; position:relative;';

    if (gridMainContainer && gridMainContainer.parentNode) {
        gridMainContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(detailDiv, gridMainContainer.nextSibling);
    }

    function loadTransferDetail(transferId, transferNo) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '/proyek/php-crud/stock.transferCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_detail_items', transfer_id: transferId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    detailDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:15px; color:#f87171 !important;">Gagal memuat detail item.</div>';
                    detailDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderTransferDetail(transferNo, res.data || []);
            },
            failure: function () {
                detailDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:15px; color:#f87171 !important;">Gagal menghubungi server.</div>';
                detailDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderTransferDetail(transferNo, rows) {
        var fmtQty = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); };

        var html = '<div style="position:sticky; top:0; background:#1e222d; z-index:10; padding:12px 15px 0 15px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);">' +
                   '  <h3 style="margin:0 0 10px 0; color:#ffffff !important; font-size:14px;">' +
                   '    Detail Item Transfer: ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(transferNo || '') +
                   '  </h3>' +
                   '  <table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px;">' +
                   '    <thead>' +
                   '      <tr>' +
                   '        <th align="left" style="width:50%; padding:8px 6px; color:#cccccc !important; text-align: left !important;">Nama Item</th>' +
                   '        <th align="left" style="width:25%; padding:8px 6px; color:#cccccc !important; text-align: left !important;">Grade</th>' +
                   '        <th align="right" style="width:25%; padding:8px 6px; color:#cccccc !important; text-align: right !important;">Qty</th>' +
                   '      </tr>' +
                   '    </thead>' +
                   '  </table>' +
                   '</div>';

        html += '<div style="padding:0 15px 12px 15px;">' +
                '  <table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px;">' +
                '    <tbody>';

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="3" style="padding:20px; text-align:center; color:#aaaaaa !important;">Tidak ada item.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">' +
                        '  <td style="width:50%; padding:7px 6px; color:#ffffff !important;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.item_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '  <td style="width:25%; padding:7px 6px; color:#ffffff !important;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.grade_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '  <td style="width:25%; padding:7px 6px; color:#4ade80 !important; font-weight:bold; text-align: right !important;" align="right">' + fmtQty(r.qty) + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }

        html += '    </tbody>' +
                '  </table>' +
                '</div>';

        detailDiv.innerHTML = html;
        detailDiv.style.display = 'block';
        detailDiv.scrollTop = 0;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Fields & Stores (Path Absolut Web)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var transferField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'transfer_no' }, { name: 'transfer_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'warehouse_from_id' }, { name: 'warehouse_from_name' }, { name: 'bin_location_from_id' }, { name: 'bin_from_code' },
        { name: 'warehouse_to_id' }, { name: 'warehouse_to_name' }, { name: 'bin_location_to_id' }, { name: 'bin_to_code' },
        { name: 'status' }, { name: 'remark' }, { name: 'total_qty', type: 'float' }
    ];

    var itemField = [
        { name: 'item_id' }, { name: 'item_name' }, { name: 'grade_id' }, { name: 'grade_name' },
        { name: 'qty', type: 'float' }, { name: 'stock_available', type: 'float' }
    ];

    var warehouseField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }];
    var binField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'code' }, { name: 'name' }];
    var gradeField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }];
    var itemComboField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }];

    var warehouseDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '/proyek/php-crud/stock.transferCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_warehouse' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, warehouseField)
    });
    warehouseDs.load();

    var binFromDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '/proyek/php-crud/stock.transferCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_bin_by_warehouse' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, binField)
    });
    var binToDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '/proyek/php-crud/stock.transferCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_bin_by_warehouse' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, binField)
    });

    var gradeDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '/proyek/php-crud/stock.transferCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_grade' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, gradeField)
    });
    gradeDs.load();

    var itemComboDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '/proyek/php-crud/stock.transferCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_item_combo' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, itemComboField)
    });

    var itemGridDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ idProperty: 'item_id' }, itemField)
    });

    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '/proyek/php-crud/stock.transferCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data' }, transferField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    function updateTransferTotalLabel() {
        var total = 0;
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) { total += parseFloat(r.get('qty')) || 0; });
        var el = document.getElementById('lblTransferTotal');
        if (el) el.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.0000');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Main Grid (Ext.grid.GridPanel TANPA BBAR / Paging Toolbar)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var calcHeight = 320;
    try {
        if (typeof maxGridHeight === 'function' && gridMainContainer) {
            var h = maxGridHeight(gridMainContainer);
            if (h && h > 200) {
                calcHeight = Math.max(220, Math.round(h * 0.55));
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        calcHeight = 320;
    }

    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: calcHeight,
        loadMask: true,
        stripeRows: true,
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. Transfer', dataIndex: 'transfer_no', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'transfer_date', width: 90, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            {
                header: 'Dari', dataIndex: 'warehouse_from_name', width: 150,
                renderer: function (v, m, r) { return CellWrap(v + (r.data.bin_from_code ? ' (' + r.data.bin_from_code + ')' : '')); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Ke', dataIndex: 'warehouse_to_name', width: 150,
                renderer: function (v, m, r) { return CellWrap(v + (r.data.bin_to_code ? ' (' + r.data.bin_to_code + ')' : '')); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Total Qty', dataIndex: 'total_qty', width: 110, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000') + '</b>'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 90, align: 'center',
                renderer: function () {
                    return '<span style="color:#4ade80;font-weight:bold;">Posted</span>';
                }
            },
            { header: 'Keterangan', dataIndex: 'remark', width: 160, renderer: CellWrap }
        ],
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                    loadTransferDetail(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.transfer_no);
                }
            }
        }
    });

    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
    editDataDisable();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Item Grid (Inline Add/Edit saat Modal Editor Dibuka)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var itemGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: itemGridDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 220,
        columns: [
            {
                header: 'Item', dataIndex: 'item_name', width: 200,
                editor: new Ext.form.ComboBox({
                    store: itemComboDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id',
                    mode: 'remote', triggerAction: 'all', minChars: 1, queryParam: 'query'
                }),
                renderer: CellWrap
            },
            {
                header: 'Grade', dataIndex: 'grade_id', width: 110,
                editor: new Ext.form.ComboBox({
                    store: gradeDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id',
                    mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, editable: false
                }),
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    var rec = gradeDs.getById(v);
                    return rec ? rec.get('name') : (record.get('grade_name') || '-');
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Stok Tersedia (Asal)', dataIndex: 'stock_available', width: 140, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Qty Transfer', dataIndex: 'qty', width: 120, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 4 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000') + '</b>'; }
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            beforeedit: function (e) {
                if ((e.field === 'item_name' || e.field === 'grade_id') && !fldWarehouseFrom.getValue()) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih Gudang Asal dulu sebelum menambah item.');
                    return false;
                }
            },
            afteredit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'item_name') {
                    var combo = e.grid.colModel.getCellEditor(e.column, e.row).field;
                    var rec = combo.store.getById(combo.getValue());
                    if (rec) {
                        e.record.set('item_id', rec.get('id'));
                        e.record.set('item_name', rec.get('name'));
                    }
                    checkStockForRow(e.record);
                }
                if (e.field === 'grade_id') {
                    checkStockForRow(e.record);
                }
                if (e.field === 'qty') {
                    var maxQty = parseFloat(e.record.get('stock_available')) || 0;
                    var qtyInput = parseFloat(e.value) || 0;
                    if (qtyInput > maxQty) {
                        e.record.set('qty', maxQty);
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Qty transfer melebihi stok tersedia di lokasi asal. Otomatis dibatasi ke ' + Ext.util.Format.number(maxQty, '0,000.0000') + '.');
                    }
                    if (qtyInput < 0) {
                        e.record.set('qty', 0);
                    }
                }
                updateTransferTotalLabel();
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    function checkStockForRow(record) {
        var itemId = record.get('item_id');
        if (!itemId || !fldWarehouseFrom.getValue()) return;
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '/proyek/php-crud/stock.transferCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: 'check_stock',
                item_id: itemId,
                grade_id: record.get('grade_id') || 0,
                warehouse_id: fldWarehouseFrom.getValue(),
                bin_location_id: fldBinFrom.getValue() || 0
            },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                record.set('stock_available', res.balance_qty || 0);
            }
        });
    }

    // Auto-isi grid item dengan SEMUA stok yang tersedia di Gudang Asal /
    // Bin Asal yang dipilih, Qty Transfer default = Stok Tersedia (artinya
    // semua ikut ditransfer). User tinggal ubah/nolkan qty item yang TIDAK
    // ikut ditransfer -- baris qty 0 otomatis di-skip saat Save.
    function loadStockFromBinAsal() {
        var warehouseId = fldWarehouseFrom.getValue();
        if (!warehouseId) {
            itemGridDs.removeAll();
            updateTransferTotalLabel();
            return;
        }

        itemGrid.el.mask('Memuat stok lokasi asal...', 'x-mask-loading');
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '/proyek/php-crud/stock.transferCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: 'read_stock_by_location',
                warehouse_id: warehouseId,
                bin_location_id: fldBinFrom.getValue() || 0
            },
            success: function (response) {
                itemGrid.el.unmask();
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                itemGridDs.removeAll();
                if (res.success && res.data && res.data.length) {
                    var ItemRecord = Ext.data.Record.create(itemField);
                    Ext.each(res.data, function (row) {
                        var balance = parseFloat(row.balance_qty) || 0;
                        itemGridDs.add(new ItemRecord({
                            item_id: row.item_id,
                            item_name: row.item_name,
                            grade_id: row.grade_id || null,
                            grade_name: row.grade_name || '',
                            qty: balance,
                            stock_available: balance
                        }));
                    });
                }
                updateTransferTotalLabel();
            },
            failure: function () {
                itemGrid.el.unmask();
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal memuat stok dari lokasi asal.');
            }
        });
    }

    function btnAddItemRow() {
        if (!fldWarehouseFrom.getValue()) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih Gudang Asal dulu sebelum menambah item.');
            return;
        }
        var ItemRecord = Ext.data.Record.create(itemField);
        var newRec = new ItemRecord({ item_id: null, item_name: '', grade_id: null, qty: 0, stock_available: 0 });
        itemGridDs.add(newRec);
        itemGrid.startEditing(itemGridDs.getCount() - 1, 0);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Editor Form Fields (Header)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fldTransferNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Transfer', id: 'transfer_no', name: 'transfer_no', readOnly: true, emptyText: 'Auto-generate' });
    var fldTransferDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tgl Transfer', id: 'transfer_date', name: 'transfer_date', allowBlank: false, value: new Date() });

    var fldWarehouseFrom = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Gudang Asal', id: 'warehouse_from_id', name: 'warehouse_from_id', hiddenName: 'warehouse_from_id',
        store: warehouseDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false,
        listeners: {
            select: function (combo, record) {
                fldBinFrom.clearValue();
                binFromDs.load({ params: { warehouse_id: record.get('id') } });
                // Belum tarik stok di sini -- tunggu Bin Asal dipilih dulu,
                // supaya tidak ada tarikan data ganda / hasil ambigu di
                // level gudang sebelum bin-nya jelas.
                itemGridDs.removeAll();
                updateTransferTotalLabel();
            }
        }
    });
    var fldBinFrom = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Bin Asal', id: 'bin_location_from_id', name: 'bin_location_from_id', hiddenName: 'bin_location_from_id',
        store: binFromDs, displayField: 'code', valueField: 'id', emptyText: '(opsional -- level gudang)',
        listeners: {
            select: function () {
                // Begitu Bin Asal dipilih, tarik SEMUA item yang punya
                // stok di bin itu dan isi grid otomatis, qty default =
                // full stok tersedia.
                loadStockFromBinAsal();
            }
        }
    });

    var fldWarehouseTo = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Gudang Tujuan', id: 'warehouse_to_id', name: 'warehouse_to_id', hiddenName: 'warehouse_to_id',
        store: warehouseDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false,
        listeners: {
            select: function (combo, record) {
                fldBinTo.clearValue();
                binToDs.load({ params: { warehouse_id: record.get('id') } });
            }
        }
    });
    var fldBinTo = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Bin Tujuan', id: 'bin_location_to_id', name: 'bin_location_to_id', hiddenName: 'bin_location_to_id',
        store: binToDs, displayField: 'code', valueField: 'id', emptyText: '(opsional -- level gudang)'
    });

    var fldRemark = new myTextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Keterangan', id: 'remark', name: 'remark' });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 110,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldTransferNo },
            { items: fldTransferDate },
            { items: fldWarehouseFrom },
            { items: fldWarehouseTo },
            { items: fldBinFrom },
            { items: fldBinTo },
            { columnWidth: 1, items: fldRemark }
        ]
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var btnAdd = document.getElementById('addData');
    if (btnAdd) {
        btnAdd.onclick = function () {
            if (getFormAccess() >= 2) {
                task = 'create';
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                itemGridDs.removeAll();
                updateTransferTotalLabel();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Stock Transfer Baru';
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menambah data.');
            }
        };
    }

    var btnDel = document.getElementById('deleteData');
    if (btnDel) {
        btnDel.onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data transfer yang ingin dihapus.');
                return;
            }
            if (getFormAccess() >= 4) {
                Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi Hapus', "Hapus transfer '" + dataRecord.transfer_no + "'? Stok akan dikembalikan ke lokasi asal.", function (btn) {
                    if (btn === 'yes') {
                        Ext.Ajax.request({
                            url: '/proyek/php-crud/stock.transferCRD.php',
                            method: 'POST',
                            params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                            success: function (response) {
                                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Informasi', res.message);
                                if (res.success) {
                                    mainDs.load();
                                    detailDiv.style.display = 'none';
                                }
                            },
                            failure: function () { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.'); }
                        });
                    }
                });
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses menghapus data.');
            }
        };
    }

    var btnSave = document.getElementById('saveEdit');
    if (btnSave) {
        btnSave.onclick = function () {
            var warehouseFromId = fldWarehouseFrom.getValue();
            var warehouseToId = fldWarehouseTo.getValue();
            if (!warehouseFromId || !warehouseToId) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Gudang Asal dan Tujuan wajib dipilih.');
                return;
            }

            var arrItems = [];
            var hasInvalid = false;
            itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
                var qty = parseFloat(r.get('qty')) || 0;
                if (!r.get('item_id') && qty > 0) { hasInvalid = true; }
                if (r.get('item_id') && qty > 0) {
                    arrItems.push({
                        item_id: r.get('item_id'),
                        item_name: r.get('item_name'),
                        grade_id: r.get('grade_id') || null,
                        qty: qty,
                        remark: ''
                    });
                }
            });

            if (hasInvalid) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Ada baris dengan qty > 0 tapi item belum dipilih.');
                return;
            }
            if (arrItems.length === 0) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Minimal 1 item dengan qty > 0.');
                return;
            }

            frmEditor.getForm().submit({
                url: '/proyek/php-crud/stock.transferCRD.php',
                method: 'POST',
                params: {
                    task: 'create',
                    arrItems: JSON.stringify(arrItems)
                },
                waitTitle: 'Menyimpan',
                waitMsg: 'Memproses transfer & memindahkan stok...',
                success: function (form, action) {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message);
                    mainDs.load();
                    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                },
                failure: function (form, action) {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
                }
            });
        };
    }

    (function injectAddRowButton() {
        var gridEl = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        if (gridEl && !document.getElementById('btnAddTransferRow')) {
            var btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.id = 'btnAddTransferRow';
            btn.innerHTML = '+ Tambah Item';
            btn.style.cssText = 'background:#2e7dd1; color:#fff; border:none; padding:6px 14px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600; font-size:12.5px; margin-bottom:6px;';
            btn.onclick = btnAddItemRow;
            gridEl.parentNode.insertBefore(btn, gridEl);
        }
    })();

    if (document.getElementById('editorWdw')) {
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    }
});

    let CellSupplier = '';

    function MergeCellSupplier(val, x, store) {
        if (CellSupplier == '' || CellSupplier != val) {
            CellSupplier = val;
            return '<div style="white-space:normal !important;">' + val + '</div>';
        } else {
            return '<div style="white-space:normal !important;">-</div>';
        }
    }
    let txField = [
        { name: 'supplier_name', type: 'string' },

        { name: 'l_rotary', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'l_end', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'l_pecah', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'l_waste', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'trm_volume', type: 'float' },

        { name: 'percent_rt', type: 'int' }
    ];

Ext.onReady(function () {

    var task = '';

    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(whrcvDtlDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
    }

    (function injectExtraUI() {

            totalsDiv.className = 'invoice-totals';
            totalsDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:8px 0; font-weight:bold; font-size:14px; color:#fff; text-align:right;';
            totalsDiv.innerHTML = 'Total Nilai Diterima: <span id="lblWhrcvTotal">0.00</span>';
            gridEditorContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(totalsDiv, gridEditorContainer.nextSibling);
        }
    })();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var whrcvField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'received_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'grn_hdr_id' }, { name: 'grn_ref_no' }, { name: 'warehouse_id' }, { name: 'warehouse_name' },
        { name: 'supplier_name' }, { name: 'status' }, { name: 'remark' },
        { name: 'total_amount', type: 'float' }
    ];

        { name: 'grn_dtl_id' }, { name: 'item_id' }, { name: 'item_name' }, { name: 'grade_id' },

        { name: 'qty_wh_received', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_remaining', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_input', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'bin_location_id' }, { name: 'lot_no' }
    ];

    var grnField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'grn_date' }, { name: 'status' },

    ];

    var grnDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',

    });
    grnDs.load();

    var warehouseField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'init' }, { name: 'name' }];
    var warehouseDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'list_warehouses' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, warehouseField)
    });
    warehouseDs.load();

    var binLocationField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'code' }, { name: 'name' }, { name: 'zone' }, { name: 'rack' }, { name: 'level' }];
    var binLocationDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'list_bin_locations' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, binLocationField)
    });

    var itemGridDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'load_grn_dtl' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, itemField),
        listeners: {
            load: function (store) {
                store.each(function (r) {

                    r.set('qty_input', sisa);
                });

    });

    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'list' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, whrcvField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Main Grid Panel
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var GridDtlHeight = (maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));
    var mainHeight = Math.round(GridDtlHeight - (GridDtlHeight * 0.45));

    var gridMain = new stdGrid({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: mainHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. WH Rcv', dataIndex: 'ref_no', width: 120, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'No. GRN', dataIndex: 'grn_ref_no', width: 120, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Supplier', dataIndex: 'supplier_name', width: 170, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Gudang', dataIndex: 'warehouse_name', width: 120, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Tgl Terima', dataIndex: 'received_date', width: 90, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            {
                header: 'Total Nilai', dataIndex: 'total_amount', width: 130, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00') + '</b>'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 90, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) {
                    if (v === 'reversed') return '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-weight:bold;">Reversed</span>';
                    return '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Posted</span>';
                }
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            cellclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    // [FIX] Edit tidak lagi dipakai (dokumen posted tidak punya form
                    // edit -- cuma bisa direverse), jadi tombol Edit dibiarkan mati.
                    // Delete di-enable di sini, dipakai untuk aksi Reverse (lihat
                    // handler #deleteData di bawah), dan dimatikan lagi kalau
                    // dokumennya sudah berstatus 'reversed'.
                    if (dataRecord.status === 'reversed' || getFormAccess() < 4) {
                        mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
                    } else {
                        mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                    }
                    loadWhrcvDetail(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.ref_no);
                }
            }
        }
    });
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Detail View Renderer (Disamakan dengan PO / GRN)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function loadWhrcvDetail(id, refNo) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_edit', id: id },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    whrcvDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Gagal memuat detail.</div>';
                    whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderWhrcvDetailView(res.data.items || [], refNo);
            },
            failure: function () {
                whrcvDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderWhrcvDetailView(rows, refNo) {
        var fmtQty = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); };
        var fmtAmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };

        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Detail Item WH Rcv: ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(refNo || '') + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Nama Item</th>' +
                   '<th style="text-align:right;">Qty Diterima</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">Lot No</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Harga Satuan</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Subtotal</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        var grandTotal = 0;

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty-msg">Tidak ada item detail.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var qty = parseFloat(r.qty_received) || 0;
                var cost = parseFloat(r.unit_cost) || 0;
                var subtotal = qty * cost;
                grandTotal += subtotal;

                html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.item_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtQty(qty) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.lot_no || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(cost) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" class="subtotal-val">' + fmtAmt(subtotal) + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }

        html += '</tbody>' +
                '<tfoot>' +
                '<tr class="total-row">' +
                '<td colspan="4" align="right" class="total-label">Total Nilai Diterima:</td>' +
                '<td align="right" class="total-val">' + fmtAmt(grandTotal) + '</td>' +
                '</tr>' +
                '</tfoot>' +
                '</table>';

        whrcvDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Item Grid Editor (Form Grid)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var itemGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: itemGridDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 220,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Item', dataIndex: 'item_name', width: 180, renderer: CellWrap },
            {
                header: 'Qty GRN', dataIndex: 'qty_grn', width: 90, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Sisa Belum Diterima', dataIndex: 'qty_remaining', width: 110, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b style="color:#38bdf8;">' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000') + '</b>'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Qty Diterima Skrg', dataIndex: 'qty_input', width: 120, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 4 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b style="color:#2e9e4f;">' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000') + '</b>'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Lot No', dataIndex: 'lot_no', width: 100,
                editor: new myTextField({})
            },
            {
                header: 'Bin Location', dataIndex: 'bin_location_id', width: 130,
                editor: new myComboField({
                    store: binLocationDs, displayField: 'code', valueField: 'id',
                    mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true
                }),
                renderer: function (v) {
                    if (!v) return '-';
                    var rec = binLocationDs.getById(v);
                    return rec ? rec.get('code') : v;
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Harga Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit_cost', width: 100, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Subtotal', dataIndex: 'qty_input', width: 120, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    var subtotal = (parseFloat(record.get('qty_input')) || 0) * (parseFloat(record.get('unit_cost')) || 0);
                    return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(subtotal, '0,000.00') + '</b>';
                }
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'qty_input') {
                    var maxQty = parseFloat(e.record.get('qty_remaining')) || 0;
                    var qtyInput = parseFloat(e.value) || 0;
                    if (qtyInput > maxQty) {
                        e.record.set('qty_input', maxQty);
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Qty melebihi sisa GRN. Otomatis dibatasi ke ' + Ext.util.Format.number(maxQty, '0,000.0000') + '.');
                    }
                    if (qtyInput < 0) {
                        e.record.set('qty_input', 0);
                    }
                }
                updateWhrcvTotalLabel();
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    function updateWhrcvTotalLabel() {
        var total = 0;
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0;
            var cost = parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost')) || 0;
            total += qty * cost;
        });
        var el = document.getElementById('lblWhrcvTotal');
        if (el) el.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Form Header & Input Controls
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fldRefNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. WH Rcv', id: 'ref_no', name: 'ref_no', readOnly: true, emptyText: 'Auto-generate' });
    var fldGrnHdr = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'GRN yang Diterima', id: 'grn_hdr_id', name: 'grn_hdr_id', hiddenName: 'grn_hdr_id',
        store: grnDs, displayField: 'ref_no', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false,
        listeners: {
            select: function (combo, record) {
                if (record.get('warehouse_id')) {
                    fldWarehouse.setValue(record.get('warehouse_id'));
                    binLocationDs.load({ params: { warehouse_id: record.get('warehouse_id') } });
                }
                itemGridDs.load({ params: { grn_hdr_id: record.get('id') } });
            }
        }
    });
    var fldWarehouse = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Gudang Penerima', id: 'warehouse_id', name: 'warehouse_id', hiddenName: 'warehouse_id',
        store: warehouseDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false,
        listeners: {
            select: function (combo, record) {
                binLocationDs.load({ params: { warehouse_id: record.get('id') } });
            }
        }
    });
    var fldReceivedDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tgl Terima', id: 'received_date', name: 'received_date', allowBlank: false, value: new Date() });
    var fldRemark = new myTextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Keterangan', id: 'remark', name: 'remark' });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 130,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldRefNo },
            { items: fldReceivedDate },
            { items: fldGrnHdr },
            { items: fldWarehouse },
            { columnWidth: 1, items: fldRemark }
        ]
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (getFormAccess() >= 2) {
            task = 'create';
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            itemGridDs.removeAll();
            grnDs.load();
            updateWhrcvTotalLabel();
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Penerimaan Fisik Gudang Baru';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        // [FIX] Edit dimatikan permanen -- dokumen WH Rcv yang sudah posted
        // tidak punya form edit, cuma bisa dibatalkan lewat tombol Delete
        // (yang menjalankan Reverse, lihat handler di bawah).
        Ext.Msg.alert('Info', 'Dokumen yang sudah posted tidak bisa diedit. Gunakan tombol Delete untuk membatalkan (reverse) transaksi ini.');
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        // [FIX] Aksi "Delete" untuk modul ini sebenarnya adalah Reverse
        // (pembatalan dengan jejak audit tetap ada) -- dokumen WH Rcv yang
        // sudah posted TIDAK di-hard-delete, karena sudah memengaruhi stok
        // dan jurnal. Sebelumnya aksi ini keliru dipasang di tombol Edit.
        if (!dataRecord) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data WH Rcv yang akan di-reverse.');
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status === 'reversed') {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'WH Rcv ini sudah di-reverse sebelumnya.');
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() >= 4) {
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi Reverse', 'Reverse WH Rcv \'' + dataRecord.ref_no + '\'? Stok & jurnal akan dibatalkan.', function (btn) {
                if (btn === 'yes') {
                    Ext.Ajax.request({
                        url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
                        method: 'POST',
                        params: { task: 'reverse', id: dataRecord.id },
                        success: function (response) {
                            var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                            if (res.success) {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Informasi', res.message || 'WH Rcv berhasil di-reverse.');
                                whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                                mainDs.load();
                                grnDs.load();
                                dataRecord = null;
                                mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
                            } else {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message);
                            }
                        },
                        failure: function () {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        } else {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk reverse.');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        var grnHdrId = fldGrnHdr.getValue();
        if (!grnHdrId) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih GRN yang mau diterima terlebih dahulu.');
            return;
        }
        if (!fldWarehouse.getValue()) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih gudang terlebih dahulu.');
            return;
        }

        var arrItems = [];
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0;
            if (qty > 0) {
                arrItems.push({
                    grn_dtl_id: r.get('grn_dtl_id'),
                    item_id: r.get('item_id'),
                    item_name: r.get('item_name'),
                    grade_id: r.get('grade_id'),
                    qty_received: qty,
                    unit_cost: parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost')) || 0,
                    lot_no: r.get('lot_no') || null,
                    bin_location_id: r.get('bin_location_id') || null
                });
            }
        });

        if (arrItems.length === 0) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Minimal 1 item dengan qty diterima > 0.');
            return;
        }

        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: 'create',
                grn_hdr_id: grnHdrId,
                warehouse_id: fldWarehouse.getValue(),
                received_date: fldReceivedDate.getValue().format('Y-m-d'),
                items: JSON.stringify(arrItems)
            },
            waitTitle: 'Menyimpan',
            waitMsg: 'Memproses penerimaan & posting stok/jurnal...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message || ('WH Rcv ' + res.ref_no + ' berhasil disimpan.'));
                whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                mainDs.load();
                grnDs.load();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('whrcvDtlContainer').style.display = 'none';

});

    }

    function loadKursDetailPanel(hdrId, kmkNo) {
        kursDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:15px;color:#94a3b8;text-align:center;">Memuat rincian kurs...</div>';
        kursDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/m.taxexchangerateCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_detail', hdr_id: hdrId },
            success: function(response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    kursDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#ef4444; padding:15px; text-align:center;">Gagal memuat rincian kurs.</div>';
                    kursDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderKursDetailPanel(res.data || [], kmkNo);
            },
            failure: function() {
                kursDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#ef4444; padding:15px; text-align:center;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                kursDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderKursDetailPanel(rows, kmkNo) {
        var fmtUnit = function(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000'); };

        var html = '<div class="detail-title">Rincian Nilai Kurs Pajak Mingguan (Terhadap Rupiah / IDR) — KMK No: ' +
                   Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(kmkNo || '') + '</div>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<table id="kursDtlTable" class="detail-table" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr>' +

                   '<th align="left">Nama Mata Uang</th>' +
                   '<th align="center">Unit</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Kurs KMK (IDR)</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Kurs Murni / Unit (IDR)</th>' +
                   '<th align="center">Perubahan</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:20px; text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">Belum ada rincian kurs untuk periode ini.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function(r) {
                var chgHtml;
                if (r.change_direction === 'UP') {
                    chgHtml = '<span style="color:#22c55e;font-weight:bold;">&#9650; +' + renderMoneyVal(r.change_amount) + '</span>';
                } else if (r.change_direction === 'DOWN') {
                    chgHtml = '<span style="color:#ef4444;font-weight:bold;">&#9660; -' + renderMoneyVal(r.change_amount) + '</span>';
                } else {
                    chgHtml = '<span style="color:#94a3b8;">&#9644; Tetap</span>';

                html += '<tr class="data-row">' +

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // GRID UTAMA (FIT LEBAR SCREEN)

    // [FIX] Sebelumnya GridPanel tidak diberi "width" eksplisit dan hanya
    // mengandalkan viewConfig.forceFit. forceFit menghitung lebar kolom
    // dari ukuran grid SAAT PERTAMA KALI dirender; kalau di momen itu
    // container (#divMainGrid) belum benar-benar selebar layar (mis. CSS
    // "width:100%" belum sempat diterapkan browser), grid mengunci lebar

    var elGridDiv = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');

    function getGridWidth() {
        var w = elGridDiv ? elGridDiv.clientWidth : 0;
        return (w && w > 300) ? w : (document.documentElement.clientWidth || window.innerWidth || 1024);

            scrollOffset: 0

    // saat container sudah pasti punya lebar akhir yang sebenarnya.
    gridMain.on('afterrender', function() {

        gridMain.setWidth(w);
        gridMain.doLayout();

    // lebar lama walau window melebar/menyempit.
    Ext.EventManager.onWindowResize(function() {

            // konten bisa mengubah lebar efektif container -> sinkron sekali lagi.

Ext.onReady(function () {

    var lastMutationRows = [];

    }

    // 1. Store Gudang (+ "Semua Gudang" ditambah manual)
    var warehouseField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }];

    });

    // 2. Filter Bar
    var fldWarehouseFilter = new myComboField({

        listeners: {
            select: function (combo, record) {
                currentWarehouseId = parseInt(record.get('id'), 10) || 0;
                currentWarehouseName = record.get('name') || '-- Semua Gudang --';
                loadSummary();
                mutationDiv.style.display = 'none';
                setPrintMutationEnabled(false);
            }
        }
    });

    var btnPrintSummary = document.createElement('button');

    btnPrintSummary.innerHTML = '\uD83D\uDDB6 Cetak Ringkasan';
    btnPrintSummary.style.cssText = 'background:#2e7dd1; color:#fff; border:none; padding:7px 16px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600; font-size:12.5px; margin-right:8px;';
    btnPrintSummary.onclick = function () { printStockCard('summary'); };

    var btnPrintMutation = document.createElement('button');
    btnPrintMutation.id = 'btnPrintMutation';

    btnPrintMutation.onclick = function () { if (!btnPrintMutation.disabled) printStockCard('mutation'); };

    function setPrintMutationEnabled(enabled) {
        btnPrintMutation.disabled = !enabled;
        btnPrintMutation.style.cursor = enabled ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed';
        btnPrintMutation.style.background = enabled ? '#2e7dd1' : '#555';

    function loadSummary() {
        summaryGrid.el.mask('Memuat...');
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/stock.cardCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_summary', warehouse_id: currentWarehouseId, only_non_zero: 1 },

    // 4. Mutation Detail
    function loadMutation() {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/stock.cardCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_mutation', item_id: currentItemId, warehouse_id: currentWarehouseId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    mutationDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Gagal memuat mutasi.</div>';
                    mutationDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                lastMutationRows = res.data || [];
                renderMutationView(res.data);
                setPrintMutationEnabled(true);
            }
        });
    }

    var refLabels = {
        'grn': 'Penerimaan (GRN)',
        'sales_delivery': 'Pengiriman (Surat Jalan)',
        'purchase_return': 'Retur Pembelian',
        'sales_return': 'Retur Penjualan',
        'stock_transfer': 'Transfer Gudang',
        'adjustment': 'Penyesuaian Stok'
    };

    function renderMutationView(rows) {
        var fmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); };
        var scopeLabel = currentWarehouseId > 0 ? '' : ' (Semua Gudang)';

        var html = '<h3 style="margin-top:0; color:#ffffff !important;">Mutasi Stok: ' + currentItemName + scopeLabel + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr style="border:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); margin:10px 0 15px;" />' +
                   '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px;">' +
                   '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);">' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;">Tanggal</td>' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;">Jenis Transaksi</td>' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;">No. Referensi</td>' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;">Gudang</td>' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;" align="right">Masuk</td>' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;" align="right">Keluar</td>' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;" align="right">Saldo Berjalan</td>' +
                   '</tr>';

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="7" style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#aaaaaa !important;">Belum ada mutasi.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var isIn = r.movement_type === 'IN';
                var masuk = isIn ? fmt(r.qty) : '-';
                var keluar = !isIn ? fmt(r.qty) : '-';
                var refLabel = refLabels[r.reference_type] || r.reference_type;
                html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#ffffff !important;">' + r.movement_date + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#ffffff !important;">' + refLabel + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#ffffff !important;">' + (r.reference_no || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#ffffff !important;">' + (r.warehouse_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#4ade80 !important; font-weight:bold;" align="right">' + masuk + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#f87171 !important; font-weight:bold;" align="right">' + keluar + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#ffffff !important;" align="right"><b>' + fmt(r.running_balance) + '</b></td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }
        html += '</table>';

        mutationDiv.innerHTML = html;
        mutationDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

## File: ./js/trialbalance.js
