/*
  Document      : m.trialbalance.js
  Description   : Trial Balance - Rekap saldo semua akun per periode,
                   dengan indikator total Debit = Kredit.
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/trialbalanceCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Trial <em>Balance</em>";

    ['addData', 'editData', 'deleteData'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 0. Buat elemen filter bar & summary secara dinamis
    // ============================================================
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var filterBarDiv = document.createElement('div');
    filterBarDiv.id = 'tbFilterBar';
    filterBarDiv.style.padding = '0 10px';
    var summaryDiv = document.createElement('div');
    summaryDiv.id = 'tbSummary';
    summaryDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:8px 12px; font-size:13px; margin:0 10px 10px 10px; border-radius:4px;';
    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(filterBarDiv, gridContainer);
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(summaryDiv, gridContainer);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 1. Field definitions & stores
    // ============================================================
    var tbField = [
        { name: 'account_code' }, { name: 'account_name' }, { name: 'account_type' },
        { name: 'debit', type: 'float' }, { name: 'credit', type: 'float' }
    ];

    var periodField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'period_name' }, { name: 'start_date' }, { name: 'end_date' }];
    var periodDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/trialbalanceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_periods' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, periodField),
        listeners: {
            load: function (store) {
                // Auto-pilih periode terbaru (baris pertama, karena ORDER BY start_date DESC)
                if (store.getCount() > 0 && !fldPeriod.getValue()) {
                    fldPeriod.setValue(store.getAt(0).get('id'));
                    loadTrialBalance();
                }
            }
        }
    });
    periodDs.load();

    var tbDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/trialbalanceCRD.php',
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, tbField)
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Filter bar
    // ============================================================
    var fldPeriod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Periode', width: 200, store: periodDs, displayField: 'period_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldHideZero = new Ext.form.Checkbox({ boxLabel: 'Sembunyikan saldo nol', checked: true });
    var btnShow = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Tampilkan', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button' });

    var filterPanel = new Ext.Panel({
        renderTo: 'tbFilterBar',
        layout: 'column',
        border: false,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:8px 0;',
        defaults: { border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;' },
        items: [
            { columnWidth: 0.25, layout: 'form', labelWidth: 60, items: fldPeriod },
            { columnWidth: 0.25, style: 'padding-top:6px;', items: fldHideZero },
            { columnWidth: 0.15, style: 'padding-top:2px;', items: btnShow }
        ]
    });

    function loadTrialBalance() {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) return;

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/trialbalanceCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_trial_balance', period_id: perId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    summaryDiv.innerHTML = res.message || 'Gagal memuat data.';
                    return;
                }

                var rows = res.data;
                if (fldHideZero.getValue()) {
                    rows = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.debit != 0 || r.credit != 0; });
                }
                var reader = tbDs.reader;
                tbDs.loadData({ data: rows, totalCount: rows.length }, false);

                var balanceColor = res.is_balance ? '#2e9e4f' : '#c0392b';
                var balanceText = res.is_balance ? 'BALANCE ✓' : 'TIDAK BALANCE ✗';
                summaryDiv.style.background = res.is_balance ? 'rgba(255, 0, 255, 0.29)' : 'rgb(255, 255, 0)';
                 summaryDiv.style.color ='yellow'; 
                summaryDiv.innerHTML =
                    '<b>Periode:</b> ' + res.period_name + ' (per ' + res.as_of_date + ')' +
                    ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b>Total Debit:</b> ' + Ext.util.Format.number(res.total_debit, '0,000.00') +
                    ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b>Total Kredit:</b> ' + Ext.util.Format.number(res.total_credit, '0,000.00') +
                    ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b style="color:' + balanceColor + ';">' + balanceText + '</b>';
            }
        });
    }

    btnShow.on('click', loadTrialBalance);
    fldHideZero.on('check', loadTrialBalance);

    // ============================================================
    // 3. Grid Trial Balance
    // ============================================================
    let mainHeight=(maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));

    var gridMain = new stdGridPaging({
        store: tbDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height : mainHeight,

        columns: [
            { header: 'Kode Akun', dataIndex: 'account_code', width: 100, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Nama Akun', dataIndex: 'account_name', width: 260, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Tipe', dataIndex: 'account_type', width: 100, renderer: function (v) { return v ? v.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + v.slice(1) : ''; } },
            {
                header: 'Debit', dataIndex: 'debit', width: 140, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return v ? Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0,000.00') : ''; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Kredit', dataIndex: 'credit', width: 140, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return v ? Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0,000.00') : ''; }
            }
        ],
        pageSize: 500,
        pageStore: tbDs
    });

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        window.open('../pdf/trialbalance.php?period_id=' + perId, 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };
       document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';

    }
});

## File: ./js/m.supplier.js
----------------------------------------
Ext.onReady(function() {
  Ext.QuickTips.init();

  // Scoped state variables
  let task = '';
  let deleteRow = 0;
  let deleteRecord = null;
  let gridEditorCheck = 0;

  // DOM Helper
  const setDisplay = (id, displayStyle) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.style.display = displayStyle;
  };

  const setHtml = (id, html) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.innerHTML = html;
  };

  setDisplay('addWdw', 'block');

  // Event Handlers
  document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function() {
    const saveBtn = document.getElementById("saveEdit");
    saveBtn.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
    saveBtn.style.backgroundColor = '#1D6788';
    saveBtn.style.color = '#fff';
    
    if (formAccess==2 || formAccess==3 || formAccess==4){
      task = 'create';
      gridEditorDs.load({ params: { id: 0 } });
      setDisplay('editorWdw', 'block');
      setHtml("editorFormHeaderText", "&nbsp;&nbsp;New Supplier");
      frmEditor.getForm().reset();
      Ext.getCmp('init').focus('', 10);
    } else {
      task = '';
      setHtml("popWdwTxt", 'not enough permission to access this window');
      setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');
    }
  };

  document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function() {
    if ( formAccess==3 || formAccess==4){
      task = 'update';
      frmEditor.getForm().reset();
      Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().load({
        url: '../php-crud/m.supplierCRD.php',
        params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'readedit' },
        success: function(form, action) {
          let dt = action.result.data;
        }
      });
      setDisplay('editorWdw', 'block');
      setHtml("editorFormHeaderText", "&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Supplier");
    } else {
      task = '';
      setHtml("popWdwTxt", 'not enough permission to access this window');
      setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');
    }
  };

  document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function() {
    if (formAccess === 4) {
      task = 'delete';
      let supplierName = dataRecord.name;
      setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');
      setDisplay('popCancel', 'block');
      setHtml("popWdwTxt", `delete '${supplierName}' ?`);
    } else {
      task = '';
      setHtml("popWdwTxt", 'not enough permission to delete this data');
      setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');
    }
  };

  document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function() {
    window.open(
      "../pdf/m.supplier.php", 
      'sub', 
      'toolbar=no,location=no,status=no,directories=no,menubar=no'
    );
  };

  document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function() {
    let arrContact = new Ext.data.ArrayStore({ fields: contactField });
    let records = gridEditorDs.getRange();

    records.forEach(rec => {
      arrContact.add(new addRow({
        cont_id         : rec.get('cont_id'),
        name            : rec.get('name'),
        position        : rec.get('position'),
        cont_phone_id   : rec.get('cont_phone_id'),
        phone           : rec.get('phone'),
        cont_mobile_id  : rec.get('cont_mobile_id'),
        mobile          : rec.get('mobile'),
        cont_email_id   : rec.get('cont_email_id'),
        email           : rec.get('email'),
        cont_address_id : rec.get('cont_address_id'),
        address         : rec.get('address'),
        remark          : rec.get('remark')
      }));
    });

    frmEditor.getForm().submit({
      method: 'POST',
      params: { 
        task: task, 
        logActive: Ext.getCmp('logActive').getValue(), 
        arrContact: DsArray2Json(arrContact)
      },
      waitTitle: 'Connecting',
      waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
      success: function(form, action) {
        let objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
        setHtml("popWdwTxt", objResponse.message);
        setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');

        mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        setDisplay('editorWdw', 'none');
      },
      failure: function(form, action) {
        let objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
        setHtml("popWdwTxt", objResponse ? objResponse.message : 'Save failed');
        setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');
      }
    });
  };

  document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function() {
    if (deleteRow > 0 && deleteRecord) {
      gridEditor.getStore().remove(deleteRecord);
      gridEditor.getView().refresh();
      deleteRow = 0;
      deleteRecord = null;
    }

          setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');
          
          mainDs.load({
            callback: function() {
              gridMain.getView().refresh(true);
            }
          });
        }
      });
    } else {
      setDisplay('popWdw', 'none');
      setDisplay('popCancel', 'none');
    }
    
    task = '';
  };

document.getElementById('addSaveEdit').onclick = function(event) {
  let phone = Ext.getCmp('cont_phone').getValue();
  let mobile = Ext.getCmp('cont_mobile').getValue();
  let email = Ext.getCmp('cont_email').getValue();

  let cont_contact = (phone == null || phone === '') ? '' : ' Phone : ' + phone;
  cont_contact += (mobile == null || mobile === '') ? '' : '<br> Mobile : ' + mobile;
  cont_contact += (email == null || email === '') ? '' : ' <br> Email : ' + email;

  let formattedAddress = (Ext.getCmp('cont_addr').getValue() || '').replace(/\n/gi, '<br>');

  if (gridEditorCheck === 1) {
    let sm = gridEditor.getSelectionModel();
    let rec = null;

    // Safely retrieve selected record regardless of SelectionModel type
    if (typeof sm.getSelected === 'function') {
      rec = sm.getSelected();
    } else if (typeof sm.getSelections === 'function') {
      rec = sm.getSelections()[0];
    } else if (typeof sm.getSelectedCell === 'function') {
      let cell = sm.getSelectedCell();
      if (cell) {
        rec = gridEditor.getStore().getAt(cell[0]);
      }
    }

    if (rec) {
      rec.set('name', Ext.getCmp('cont_name').getValue());
      rec.set('position', Ext.getCmp('cont_position').getValue());
      rec.set('address', formattedAddress);
      rec.set('contact', cont_contact);
      rec.set('phone', phone);
      rec.set('mobile', mobile);
      rec.set('email', email);
      rec.set('remark', Ext.getCmp('cont_remark').getValue());
      gridEditor.getView().refresh();
    } else {
      Ext.Msg.alert('Warning', 'Please select a row in the contact grid first.');
      return;
    }
  } else {
    gridEditor.store.add(new addRow({
      cont_id          : Ext.getCmp('cont_id').getValue(),
      cont_address_id : Ext.getCmp('cont_address_id').getValue(),
      cont_email_id   : Ext.getCmp('cont_email_id').getValue(),
      cont_mobile_id  : Ext.getCmp('cont_mobile_id').getValue(),
      cont_phone_id   : Ext.getCmp('cont_phone_id').getValue(),
      name            : Ext.getCmp('cont_name').getValue(),
      position        : Ext.getCmp('cont_position').getValue(),
      address         : formattedAddress,
      contact         : cont_contact,
      phone           : phone,
      mobile          : mobile,
      email           : email,
      remark          : Ext.getCmp('cont_remark').getValue()
    }));
  }
  document.getElementById('addWdw').style.display = 'none';
};

/*
  Document      : m.user.system.js
  Description   : Client-side Management User System & Hak Akses Form
  Project       : Universal ERP / Inventory / Proyek Kontraktor

Ext.onReady(function() {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();

    if (document.getElementById("mainHeaderText")) {
        document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "User <em>List</em> ";
    }

    var task = '';
    var deleteRow = 0;
    var deleteRecord = null;
    var dataRecord = null;

    // ==========================================
    // 1. EVENT HANDLERS TOP TOOLBAR BUTTONS
    // ==========================================
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function(event) {
        task = '';
        if (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined' && (formAccess == 2 || formAccess == 3 || formAccess == 4)) {
            task = 'create';
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "&nbsp;&nbsp;New User";
            
            var editorFormEl = document.getElementById('editorForm');
            var btnAddItemEl = document.getElementById('btnAddItem');
            if (editorFormEl && btnAddItemEl) {
                var gridEditorHeight = editorFormEl.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - btnAddItemEl.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - 5;
                if (Ext.getCmp('gridEditor')) {
                    Ext.getCmp('gridEditor').setHeight(gridEditorHeight);
                }
            }
            
            gridDetailDs.load({ params: { task: 'read_detail', user_id: 0 } });
            gridEditorDs.load({ params: { task: 'read_detail', user_id: 0 } });
            Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().reset();
            Ext.getCmp('name').focus('', 10);
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to access this window';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function(event) {
        task = '';
        if (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined' && (formAccess == 3 || formAccess == 4)) {
            if (!dataRecord || !dataRecord.id) {
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Pilih data user terlebih dahulu dari tabel.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }

            task = 'update';
            Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().load({
                url: '../php-crud/m.user.systemCRD.php',
                params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' },
                success: function(form, action) {
                    // Pastikan hidden field employee_id dan combo name terisi presisi
                    if (dataRecord.employee_id) {
                        Ext.getCmp('employee_id').setValue(dataRecord.employee_id);
                        Ext.getCmp('name').setValue(dataRecord.employee_id);
                    }
                }
            });
            
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit User";
            
            var editorFormEl = document.getElementById('editorForm');
            var btnAddItemEl = document.getElementById('btnAddItem');
            if (editorFormEl && btnAddItemEl) {
                var gridEditorHeight = editorFormEl.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - btnAddItemEl.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - 5;
                if (Ext.getCmp('gridEditor')) {
                    Ext.getCmp('gridEditor').setHeight(gridEditorHeight);
                }
            }
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to access this window';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function(event) {
        if (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined' && formAccess == 4) {
            if (!dataRecord || !dataRecord.id) {
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Pilih data user yang akan dihapus.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }

            task = 'delete';
            deleteRow = 0; // Pastikan bukan penghapusan baris grid editor
            var userName = dataRecord.employee_name || dataRecord.login_name || '';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'delete \'' + userName + '\' ?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to delete this data';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function(event) {
        window.open("../pdf/m.form.name.php", 'sub', 'toolbar=no,location=no,status=no,directories=no,menubar=no');
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function(event) {
        var arrForm = [];
        
        // Loop data store pada grid editor hak akses menu
        if (Ext.getCmp('gridEditor')) {
            var store = Ext.getCmp('gridEditor').getStore();
            store.each(function(rec) {
                arrForm.push({
                    id: rec.data.id || 0,
                    form_id: rec.data.form_id || 0,
                    access_level: rec.data.access_level || 1
                });
            });
        }

        // Tangkap employee_id dengan proteksi dari ComboBox 'name' atau Hidden Field 'employee_id'
        var selectedEmployeeId = Ext.getCmp('name').getValue() || Ext.getCmp('employee_id').getValue();

        Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().submit({
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: task,
                user_id: (dataRecord && dataRecord.id) ? dataRecord.id : 0,
                employee_id: selectedEmployeeId,
                u_active: Ext.getCmp('AddActive').getValue(),
                form_access: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arrForm)
            },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function(form, action) {
                var objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                var messages = objResponse.message || 'Data berhasil disimpan.';

                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = messages;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';

                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                if (gridDetailDs && dataRecord && dataRecord.id) {
                    gridDetailDs.load({ params: { task: 'read_detail', id: dataRecord.id } });
                }

                Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().reset();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function(form, action) {
                var messages = 'Gagal menyimpan data ke database.';
                if (action && action.response && action.response.responseText) {
                    var objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                    messages = objResponse.message || messages;
                }

                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = messages;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    // ==========================================
    // 2. DIALOG POP-UP OK HANDLER
    // ==========================================
    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function(event) {
        // A. Hapus Baris Grid Editor Hak Akses (Lokal)
        if (deleteRow > 0) {
            if (deleteRecord && Ext.getCmp('gridEditor')) {
                Ext.getCmp('gridEditor').getStore().remove(deleteRecord);
                Ext.getCmp('gridEditor').getView().refresh();
            }
            deleteRow = 0;
            deleteRecord = null;
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
            return;
        }

        // B. Hapus Master Data User (Backend API)
        if (task == 'delete') {
            deleteDs.load({
                params: { task: "delete", id: dataRecord.id },
                callback: function(records, operation, success) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
                    task = '';
                    
                    var messages = 'Data berhasil dihapus.';
                    try {
                        var textMessages = Ext.util.JSON.decode(operation.response.responseText);
                        messages = textMessages.message || messages;
                    } catch(e) {}

                    document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = messages;
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';

                    mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                    if (gridMain && gridMain.getView()) {
                        gridMain.getView().refresh(true);
                    }
                }
            });
            task = '';
            return;
        }

        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
    };

    document.getElementById('logData').onclick = function(event) {
        if (!dataRecord) return;
        document.getElementById('logWdw').style.display = 'block';
        var userName = dataRecord.employee_name || '';
        var deptName = dataRecord.department_name || '';
        document.getElementById("logFormHeaderText").innerHTML = userName + '  [' + deptName + ']';
        
        if (typeof calculateDivHeight === 'function') {
            GridHistory.setHeight(calculateDivHeight(['logForm', 'logFormHeader']));
        }
        GridHistoryDs.load({ params: { id: dataRecord.id } });
    };

    // ==========================================
    // 3. STORES & DATA STRUCTURES
    // ==========================================
    var myMask = new Ext.LoadMask(Ext.getBody(), { msg: "Please wait..." });
    var deleteDs = new Ext.data.Store({ url: '../php-crud/m.user.systemCRD.php' });

## File: ./js/m.fiscalperiod.js

/*
  Document      : m.fiscalperiod.js
  Description   : Fiscal Period - Grid + Add Form + Close/Reopen action
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/m.fiscalperiodCRD.php (tabel accounting_periods)
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Fiscal <em>Period</em>";

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 1. Field definitions
    // ============================================================
    var periodField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'period_name' },
        { name: 'start_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'end_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'is_closed', type: 'boolean' }
    ];

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Main store & grid
    // ============================================================
    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/m.fiscalperiodCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, periodField)
    });
    mainDs.load();
    let mainHeight=(maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));

 
    var gridMain = new stdGridPaging({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height : mainHeight,

        columns: [
            { header: 'Periode', dataIndex: 'period_name', width: 150, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Mulai', dataIndex: 'start_date', width: 100, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            { header: 'Selesai', dataIndex: 'end_date', width: 100, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            {
                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'is_closed', width: 100, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) { return v ? '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-weight:bold;">Closed</span>' : '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;">Open</span>'; }
            },

        ],
        listeners: {
            cellclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                dataRecord = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex).data;
                mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                toggleCloseReopenButton();
            }
        },
        pageSize: 250,
        pageStore: mainDs
    });
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // Fiscal Period tidak diedit isinya -- cuma bisa Add & Close/Reopen
    document.getElementById('editData').style.display = 'none';

    function toggleCloseReopenButton() {
        var btn = document.getElementById('closePeriod');
        if (!btn || !dataRecord) return;
        btn.style.display = 'block';
        btn.innerHTML = dataRecord.is_closed
            ? '<t>Reopen</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">lock_open</i>'
            : '<t>Close</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">lock</i>';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 3. Editor Form (Add periode baru)
    // ============================================================
    var fldName = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Nama Periode', id: 'period_name', name: 'period_name', allowBlank: false, emptyText: 'ex: 2026-08 atau Agustus 2026' });
    var fldStart = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Mulai', id: 'start_date', name: 'start_date', allowBlank: false });
    var fldEnd = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Selesai', id: 'end_date', name: 'end_date', allowBlank: false });
    var fldId = new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 120,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 1, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldName },
            { columnWidth: 0.5, items: fldStart },
            { columnWidth: 0.5, items: fldEnd },
            { items: fldId },
            { columnWidth: 1, items: FieldSpaceTopLabel }

        ]
    });
    frmEditor.on('clientvalidation', function (f, valid) { if (!valid) { saveEditDisable(); } else { saveEditEnable(); } });

    // ============================================================
    // 4. Toolbar
    // ============================================================
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        if (getFormAccess() == 2 || getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'create';
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Tambah Periode';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    var closeReopenBtn = document.getElementById('closePeriod');
    if (closeReopenBtn) {
        closeReopenBtn.onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            if (getFormAccess() < 4) {
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya akses tertinggi yang boleh menutup/membuka periode.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            var actionTask = dataRecord.is_closed ? 'reopen' : 'close';
            var confirmMsg = dataRecord.is_closed
                ? 'Buka kembali periode \'' + dataRecord.period_name + '\'?'
                : 'Tutup periode \'' + dataRecord.period_name + '\'? Setelah ditutup, jurnal baru tidak bisa masuk ke periode ini.';

            task = actionTask;
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = confirmMsg;
        };
    }

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.is_closed) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Periode yang sudah ditutup tidak boleh dihapus.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'delete';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hapus periode \'' + dataRecord.period_name + '\' ?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus data.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };
  document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function (event) {
        window.open("../pdf/fiscalperiod.php", 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };
    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/m.fiscalperiodCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: task },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        if (task == 'delete' || task == 'close' || task == 'reopen') {
            var actionDs = new Ext.data.Store({ url: '../php-crud/m.fiscalperiodCRD.php' });
            actionDs.load({
                params: { task: task, id: dataRecord.id },
                callback: function (records, operation) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(operation.response ? operation.response.responseText : '{}');
                    document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message || 'Selesai';
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    task = '';
                    mainDs.load();
                }
            });
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

Ext.onReady(function () {

    (function injectExtraUI() {

            var soItemPanel = document.createElement('div');
            soItemPanel.id = 'soItemPickerPanel';
            soItemPanel.style.cssText = 'padding:6px; margin-bottom:6px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius:4px; display:none;';
            gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(soItemPanel, gridContainer);

            var toolbar = document.createElement('div');
            toolbar.style.padding = '5px 0';
            //toolbar.innerHTML = '<button id="btnAddItem" type="button" class="field-button grey-field-button">+ Tambah Item Manual</button>';
            gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(toolbar, gridContainer);

            var totalsDiv = document.createElement('div');
            totalsDiv.className = 'invoice-totals';
            totalsDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:8px 0; font-weight:bold; font-size:14px; color:#fff;';
            totalsDiv.innerHTML = 'Total: <span id="lblInvoiceTotal">0.00</span>';
            gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(totalsDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
        }
    })();

    function renderSoItemPicker() {
        var panel = document.getElementById('soItemPickerPanel');
        if (!panel) return;

        if (soItemDs.getCount() === 0) {
            panel.style.display = 'none';
            return;
        }

        // Otomatis masukkan SEMUA item SO yang belum di-invoice ke grid invoice
        soItemDs.each(function (r) {
            var soItemId = r.get('so_item_id');
            var soqty = r.get('qty');
            var sounitprice = r.get('unit_price');
            var sosubtotal = r.get('subtotal');

            var exists = itemGridDs.findExact('so_item_id', soItemId) >= 0;
            if (!exists) {
                itemGridDs.add(new addItemRow({
                    so_item_id: soItemId,
                    description: r.get('description') || r.get('product_name') || '(tanpa deskripsi)',
                    qty: soqty, unit_price: sounitprice, subtotal: sosubtotal
                }));
            }
        });
        updateInvoiceTotal();

        panel.style.display = 'block';
        panel.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px; color:#2e9e4f;">✓ ' + soItemDs.getCount() + ' item dari Sales Order ini sudah otomatis ditambahkan ke daftar item invoice di bawah.</div>';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 1. Field definitions & stores
    // ============================================================
    var invoiceField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'invoice_no' }, { name: 'so_id' }, { name: 'so_ref_no' },
        { name: 'customer_id' }, { name: 'customer_name' },
        { name: 'invoice_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'due_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'total_amount', type: 'float' }, { name: 'paid_amount', type: 'float' }, { name: 'status' }
    ];

    var itemField = [
        { name: 'line_id' }, 
        { name: 'so_item_id' }, 
        { name: 'description' }, 
        { name: 'qty', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'unit_price', type: 'float' }, 
        { name: 'subtotal', type: 'float' }
    ];
    var addItemRow = Ext.data.Record.create(itemField);

    var soItemField = [
        { name: 'so_item_id' }, 
        { name: 'description' },
        { name: 'qty' }, 
        { name: 'unit_price' }, 
        { name: 'subtotal' },  
        { name: 'product_name' }
    ];
    var soItemDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_so_items' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data' }, soItemField)
    });
    soItemDs.on('load', renderSoItemPicker);

    var soField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'tx_date' }, { name: 'legacy_customer_name' }];
    var soDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_so' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, soField)
    });
    soDs.load();

    var customerField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }];
    var customerDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_customer' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, customerField)
    });
    customerDs.load();

    var itemGridDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_items' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, itemField)
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Main grid
    // ============================================================
    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, invoiceField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    function statusRenderer(v) {
        return v === 'final'
            ? '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Final</span>'
            : '<span style="color:#e08e0b;">Draft</span>';
    }
    let mainHeight=(maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));

    var gridMain = new stdGridPaging({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height : mainHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. Invoice', dataIndex: 'invoice_no', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'No. SO', dataIndex: 'so_ref_no', width: 100, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Customer', dataIndex: 'customer_name', width: 160, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'invoice_date', width: 90, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            { header: 'Jatuh Tempo', dataIndex: 'due_date', width: 90, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            {
                header: 'Total', dataIndex: 'total_amount', width: 120, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Terbayar', dataIndex: 'paid_amount', width: 110, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            { header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 80, align: 'center', renderer: statusRenderer }
        ],
        listeners: {
            cellclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                dataRecord = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex).data;
                mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                editDataEnable();
            }
        },
        pageSize: 250,
        pageStore: mainDs
    });
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ============================================================
    // 3. Item grid (inline editable)
    // ============================================================
    var itemDeleter = new Extensive.grid.ItemDeleter();

    var itemGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: itemGridDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 200,
        selModel: itemDeleter,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Deskripsi', dataIndex: 'description', width: 220, editor: new myTextField({}), renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Qty', dataIndex: 'qty', width: 70, align: 'right', editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }), renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); } },
            { header: 'Harga Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit_price', width: 120, align: 'right', editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }), renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); } },
            { header: 'Subtotal', dataIndex: 'subtotal', width: 130, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00') + '</b>'; } },
            itemDeleter
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'qty' || e.field === 'unit_price') {
                    var qty = parseFloat(e.record.get('qty')) || 0;
                    var price = parseFloat(e.record.get('unit_price')) || 0;
                    e.record.set('subtotal', qty * price);
                }
                updateInvoiceTotal();
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    document.getElementById('btnAddItem') && (document.getElementById('btnAddItem').onclick = function () {
        itemGridDs.add(new addItemRow({ description: '', qty: 1, unit_price: 0, subtotal: 0 }));
    });

    function updateInvoiceTotal() {
        var total = 0;
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) { total += parseFloat(r.get('subtotal')) || 0; });
        var el = document.getElementById('lblInvoiceTotal');
        if (el) el.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00');
    }
    itemGridDs.on('update', updateInvoiceTotal);
    itemGridDs.on('add', updateInvoiceTotal);
    itemGridDs.on('remove', updateInvoiceTotal);
    itemGridDs.on('load', updateInvoiceTotal);

    // ============================================================
    // 4. Editor Form
    // ============================================================
    var fldInvoiceNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Invoice', id: 'invoice_no', name: 'invoice_no', readOnly: true, emptyText: 'Auto-generate' });
    var fldSo = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Sales Order', id: 'so_id', name: 'so_id', hiddenName: 'so_id',
        store: soDs, displayField: 'ref_no', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false,
        listeners: {
            select: function (combo, record) {
                soItemDs.load({ params: { so_id: record.get('id') } });

                // Coba cocokkan Customer berdasarkan NAMA (bukan ID -- SO lama
                // pakai tabel m_customer yang terpisah dari tabel customers
                // baru, ID-nya tidak sebanding).
                var legacyName = (record.get('legacy_customer_name') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                fldCustomer.clearValue();
                if (legacyName) {
                    var matchIdx = customerDs.findBy(function (rec) {
                        return (rec.get('name') || '').trim().toLowerCase() === legacyName;
                    });
                    if (matchIdx >= 0) {
                        fldCustomer.setValue(customerDs.getAt(matchIdx).get('id'));
                    } else {
                        document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Customer SO ("' + record.get('legacy_customer_name') + '") tidak ditemukan otomatis di data Customer baru. Silakan pilih Customer secara manual.';
                        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });
    var fldCustomer = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Customer', id: 'customer_id', name: 'customer_id', hiddenName: 'customer_id',
        store: customerDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldInvDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Invoice', id: 'invoice_date', name: 'invoice_date', allowBlank: false, value: new Date() });
    var fldDueDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Jatuh Tempo', id: 'due_date', name: 'due_date' });
    var fldId = new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 110,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldInvoiceNo },
            { items: fldSo },
            { items: fldCustomer },
            { items: fldInvDate },
            { items: fldDueDate },
            { items: fldId }
        ]
    });
    frmEditor.on('clientvalidation', function (f, valid) { if (!valid) { saveEditDisable(); } else { saveEditEnable(); } });

    // ============================================================
    // 5. Toolbar
    // ============================================================
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        if (getFormAccess() == 2 || getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'create';
            itemGridDs.removeAll();
            soItemDs.removeAll();
            var panel = document.getElementById('soItemPickerPanel');
            if (panel) panel.style.display = 'none';
            updateInvoiceTotal();
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Tambah Invoice';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'draft') {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya invoice berstatus Draft yang boleh diedit.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            task = 'update';
            frmEditor.getForm().load({ url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php', params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' } });
            itemGridDs.load({ params: { id: dataRecord.id } });
            if (dataRecord.so_id) soItemDs.load({ params: { so_id: dataRecord.so_id } });
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Invoice';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'draft') {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya invoice berstatus Draft yang boleh dihapus.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'delete';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hapus invoice \'' + dataRecord.invoice_no + '\' ?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus data.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    // Print -- finalisasi otomatis dulu (draft -> final + jurnal), baru buka PDF
    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih invoice terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'finalize', id: dataRecord.id },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                if (!res.already_final) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                }
                window.open('../pdf/invoice.php?id=' + dataRecord.id, 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
            },
            failure: function () {
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Gagal menghubungi server untuk finalisasi invoice.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        var arrItems = [];
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            arrItems.push({
                so_item_id: r.get('so_item_id'),
                description: r.get('description'), qty: r.get('qty'),
                unit_price: r.get('unit_price'), subtotal: r.get('subtotal')
            });
        });

        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: task, arrItems: JSON.stringify(arrItems) },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                itemGridDs.removeAll();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message || 'Gagal menyimpan invoice.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        if (task == 'delete') {
            var deleteDs = new Ext.data.Store({ url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php' });
            deleteDs.load({
                params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                callback: function (records, operation) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(operation.response ? operation.response.responseText : '{}');
                    document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message || 'Selesai';
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    task = '';
                    mainDs.load();
                }
            });
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

/*

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();

    ];

                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'active', width: 100, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) {
                    return (v === true || v === 'true' || v === 't' || v === 1)
                        ? '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Aktif</span>'
                        : '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-weight:bold;">Nonaktif</span>';
                }
            }

                        mainBtnEnable('#editData');
                        mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                    }
                }
            }
        }

    if (typeof mainBtnDisable === 'function') mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    var fldUnit = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Satuan', id: 'unit', name: 'unit', allowBlank: false, maxLength: 20, emptyText: 'sak, m3, kg, btg, pcs, dll' });
    var fldEstimatedPrice = new myNumberField({ fieldLabel: 'Estimasi Harga', id: 'estimated_price', name: 'estimated_price', decimalPrecision: 2, allowBlank: false, value: 0 });

        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 130,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldMaterialCode },
            { items: fldUnit },
            { items: fldMaterialName },
            { items: fldEstimatedPrice },
            { columnWidth: 0.5, labelAlign: 'right', labelWidth: 130, items: fldActive },
            { items: [new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true })] }
        ]
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 4. ACTION HANDLERS (Tambah, Edit, Hapus, Simpan)
    // ============================================================

    // TAMBAH DATA
    if (document.getElementById('addData')) {
        document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
            if (getFormAccess() >= 2 || getFormAccess() === 0) {
                task = 'create';
                dataRecord = null;
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                fldActive.setValue(true);
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
                if (document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText')) {
                    document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Material Baru';
                }
                fldMaterialCode.focus('', 10);
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menambah material.');
            }
        };
    }

    // EDIT DATA
    if (document.getElementById('editData')) {
        document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data material terlebih dahulu dari tabel.');
                return;
            }
            if (getFormAccess() >= 3 || getFormAccess() === 0) {
                task = 'update';
                frmEditor.getForm().load({
                    url: '../php-crud/m.materialsCRD.php',
                    params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' },
                    success: function (form, action) {
                        var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                        var val = res.data.active;
                        
                        // Parameter konversi boolean presisi
                        var isChecked = (val === true || val === 'true' || val === 't' || val === 1 || val === '1');
                        fldActive.setValue(isChecked);
                    },
                    failure: function () {
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal memuat data material.');
                    }
                });
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
                if (document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText')) {
                    document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Material';
                }
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk edit material.');
            }
        };
    }

    // NONAKTIFKAN / HAPUS DATA
    if (document.getElementById('deleteData')) {
        document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data material yang akan dinonaktifkan.');
                return;
            }
            if (getFormAccess() >= 4 || getFormAccess() === 0) {
                Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi', 'Nonaktifkan material \'' + dataRecord.material_name + '\'?', function (btn) {
                    if (btn === 'yes') {
                        Ext.Ajax.request({
                            url: '../php-crud/m.materialsCRD.php',
                            method: 'POST',
                            params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                            success: function (response) {
                                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                                if (res.success) {
                                    Ext.Msg.alert('Informasi', 'Material berhasil dinonaktifkan.');
                                    dataRecord = null;
                                    if (typeof editDataDisable === 'function') editDataDisable();
                                    if (typeof mainBtnDisable === 'function') mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
                                    mainDs.load();
                                } else {
                                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message);
                                }
                            },
                            failure: function () {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menonaktifkan material.');
            }
        };
    }

    // SIMPAN DATA (CREATE / UPDATE)
        document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
            var code = fldMaterialCode.getValue();
            var name = fldMaterialName.getValue();
            var unit = fldUnit.getValue();

            if (!code) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Kode Material wajib diisi.'); return; }
            if (!name) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Nama Material wajib diisi.'); return; }
            if (!unit) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Satuan wajib diisi.'); return; }

            // Evaluasi eksplisit kondisi Checkbox agar dikirim akurat
            var isChecked = fldActive.getValue();
            var activeVal = (isChecked === true || isChecked === 'true' || isChecked === '1') ? 'true' : 'false';

            frmEditor.getForm().submit({
                url: '../php-crud/m.materialsCRD.php',
                method: 'POST',
                params: {
                    task: task,
                    id: (dataRecord && dataRecord.id) ? dataRecord.id : 0,
                    is_active: activeVal
                },
                waitTitle: 'Menyimpan',
                waitMsg: 'Menyimpan data material...',
                success: function (form, action) {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', 'Material ' + (res.material_code || code) + ' berhasil disimpan.');
                    mainDs.load();
                    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                },
                failure: function (form, action) {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
                }
            });
        };

    if (document.getElementById('editorWdw')) {
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    }
});

## File: ./js/grn00.js

/*

  Backend       : /inv/php-crud/grn00CRD.php

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Goods Receipt Note";

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 0. Container Detail Item GRN
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');

    var grnDtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
    grnDtlDiv.id = 'grnDtlContainer';
    grnDtlDiv.className = 'detail-panel-container';
    grnDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';

    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(grnDtlDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
    }

    (function injectExtraUI() {
        var gridEditorContainer = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        if (gridEditorContainer && !document.getElementById('lblGrnTotal')) {
            var totalsDiv = document.createElement('div');
            totalsDiv.className = 'invoice-totals';
            totalsDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:8px 0; font-weight:bold; font-size:14px; color:#fff; text-align:right;';
            totalsDiv.innerHTML = 'Total Nilai GRN: <span id="lblGrnTotal">0.00</span>';
            gridEditorContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(totalsDiv, gridEditorContainer.nextSibling);
        }
    })();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Fields & Stores
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var grnField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'grn_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'po_id' }, { name: 'po_ref_no' }, { name: 'supplier_id' }, { name: 'supplier_name' },
        { name: 'status' }, { name: 'remark' },
        { name: 'total_qty', type: 'float' }, { name: 'total_amount', type: 'float' }
    ];

    var itemField = [
        { name: 'po_dtl_id' }, { name: 'item_id' }, { name: 'item_name' },
        { name: 'qty_ordered', type: 'float' }, { name: 'unit_price', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_received', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'sisa_qty_po', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_max_allowed', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_receivable_max', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_received_this_grn', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'unit_cost_this_grn', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_input', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'unit_cost', type: 'float' }
    ];

    var poField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'supplier_id' }, { name: 'supplier_name' }];
    var poDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/grn00CRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'list_po_open' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, poField)
    });
    poDs.load();

    var itemGridDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/grn00CRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_po_items' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, itemField),
        listeners: {
            load: function (store) {
                store.each(function (r) {
                    var existingQty = parseFloat(r.get('qty_received_this_grn')) || 0;
                    if (existingQty > 0 && task === 'update') {
                        r.set('qty_input', existingQty);
                    } else {
                        var defaultQty = parseFloat(r.get('sisa_qty_po')) || 0;
                        r.set('qty_input', defaultQty);
                    }

                    var existingCost = r.get('unit_cost_this_grn');
                    var poUnitPrice = parseFloat(r.get('unit_price')) || 0;
                    r.set('unit_cost', (existingCost !== null && existingCost !== undefined && existingCost !== '') ? existingCost : poUnitPrice);
                });
                updateGrnTotalLabel();
            }
        }
    });

    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/grn00CRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, grnField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Main Grid
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var GridDtlHeight = (maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));
    var mainHeight = Math.round(GridDtlHeight - (GridDtlHeight * 0.45));

    var gridMain = new stdGrid({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: mainHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. GRN', dataIndex: 'ref_no', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'grn_date', width: 90, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            { header: 'No. PO', dataIndex: 'po_ref_no', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Supplier', dataIndex: 'supplier_name', width: 170, renderer: CellWrap },
            {
                header: 'Total Qty', dataIndex: 'total_qty', width: 100, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Total Nilai', dataIndex: 'total_amount', width: 130, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00') + '</b>'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 110, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) {
                    if (v === 'draft') return '<span style="color:#e08e0b;font-weight:bold;">Draft</span>';
                    if (v === 'cancelled') return '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-weight:bold;">Cancelled</span>';
                    return '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Confirmed</span>';
                }
            },
            { header: 'Keterangan', dataIndex: 'remark', width: 160, renderer: CellWrap }
        ],
        listeners: {
            cellclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                    editDataEnable();
                    loadGrnDetail(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.ref_no);
                }
            }
        }
    });
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Detail View Renderer
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function loadGrnDetail(grnId, grnNo) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/grn00CRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_grn_items', grn_id: grnId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    grnDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Gagal memuat detail GRN.</div>';
                    grnDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderGrnDetailView(res.data || [], grnNo);
            },
            failure: function () {
                grnDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                grnDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderGrnDetailView(rows, grnNo) {
        var fmtQty = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); };
        var fmtAmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };

        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Detail Item GRN: ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(grnNo || '') + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Nama Item</th>' +
                    '<th style="text-align:right;">Qty Diterima</th>' +
                    '<th style="text-align:right;">Harga Satuan</th>' +
                    '<th style="text-align:right;">Subtotal</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        var grandTotal = 0;

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="4" class="empty-msg">Tidak ada item detail.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var qty = parseFloat(r.qty) || 0;
                var cost = parseFloat(r.unit_price) || 0;
                var subtotal = qty * cost;
                grandTotal += subtotal;

                html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.item_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtQty(qty) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(cost) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" class="subtotal-val">' + fmtAmt(subtotal) + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }

        html += '</tbody>' +
                '<tfoot>' +
                '<tr class="total-row">' +
                '<td colspan="3" align="right" class="total-label">Total Nilai GRN:</td>' +
                '<td align="right" class="total-val">' + fmtAmt(grandTotal) + '</td>' +
                '</tr>' +
                '</tfoot>' +
                '</table>';

        grnDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        grnDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Item Grid Editor
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function toleranceRenderer(v, meta, record) {
        var qtyOrdered = parseFloat(record.get('qty_ordered')) || 0;
        var qtyMax = parseFloat(record.get('qty_max_allowed')) || (qtyOrdered * 1.10);
        var qtyInput = parseFloat(v) || 0;

        var pctOfOrdered = qtyOrdered > 0 ? (qtyInput / qtyOrdered) * 100 : 0;
        var color = '#2e9e4f';
        if (qtyInput > qtyOrdered && qtyInput <= qtyMax) {
            color = '#e08e0b';
        } else if (qtyInput > qtyMax) {
            color = '#c0392b';
        }
        return '<b style="color:' + color + ';">' + Ext.util.Format.number(qtyInput, '0,000.0000') +
               '</b> <span style="color:#888;font-size:11px;">(' + pctOfOrdered.toFixed(0) + '% dari PO)</span>';
    }

    var itemGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: itemGridDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 240,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Item', dataIndex: 'item_name', width: 180, renderer: CellWrap },
            {
                header: 'Qty PO', dataIndex: 'qty_ordered', width: 90, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Sisa Qty PO', dataIndex: 'sisa_qty_po', width: 90, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b style="color:#38bdf8;">' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000') + '</b>'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Batas +10%', dataIndex: 'qty_max_allowed', width: 90, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Qty Diterima', dataIndex: 'qty_input', width: 150, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 4 }),
                renderer: toleranceRenderer
            },
            {
                header: 'Harga Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit_cost', width: 110, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Subtotal', dataIndex: 'qty_input', width: 130, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    var subtotal = (parseFloat(record.get('qty_input')) || 0) * (parseFloat(record.get('unit_cost')) || 0);
                    return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(subtotal, '0,000.00') + '</b>';
                }
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'qty_input') {
                    var qtyMax = parseFloat(e.record.get('qty_max_allowed')) || 0;
                    var qtyInput = parseFloat(e.value) || 0;
                    if (qtyInput > qtyMax) {
                        e.record.set('qty_input', qtyMax);
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Qty diterima melebihi batas toleransi 10% dari PO. Otomatis dibatasi ke ' + Ext.util.Format.number(qtyMax, '0,000.0000') + '.');
                    }
                    if (qtyInput < 0) {
                        e.record.set('qty_input', 0);
                    }
                }
                updateGrnTotalLabel();
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    function updateGrnTotalLabel() {
        var total = 0;
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0;
            var cost = parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost')) || 0;
            total += qty * cost;
        });
        var el = document.getElementById('lblGrnTotal');
        if (el) el.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00');
    }

    var fldPoHdr = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Purchase Order', id: 'po_id', name: 'po_id', hiddenName: 'po_id',

                itemGridDs.load({
