                collection.push( collection.shift() )
                fullCollection.push( fullCollection.shift() )
            }

            // Create and return the table head group.
            return _.node(
                'thead',
                _.node(
                    'tr',
                    _.group({
                        min: 0,
                        max: DAYS_IN_WEEK - 1,
                        i: 1,
                        node: 'th',
                        item: function( counter ) {
                            return [
                                collection[ counter ],
                                settings.klass.weekdays,
                                'scope=col title="' + fullCollection[ counter ] + '"'
                            ]
                        }
                    })
                )
            ) //endreturn

        // Materialize modified
        })( ( settings.showWeekdaysFull ? settings.weekdaysFull : settings.weekdaysLetter ).slice( 0 ), settings.weekdaysFull.slice( 0 ) ), //tableHead


        // Create the nav for next/prev month.
        createMonthNav = function( next ) {

            // Otherwise, return the created month tag.
            return _.node(
                'div',
                ' ',
                settings.klass[ 'nav' + ( next ? 'Next' : 'Prev' ) ] + (

                    // If the focused month is outside the range, disabled the button.
                    ( next && viewsetObject.year >= maxLimitObject.year && viewsetObject.month >= maxLimitObject.month ) ||
                    ( !next && viewsetObject.year <= minLimitObject.year && viewsetObject.month <= minLimitObject.month ) ?
                    ' ' + settings.klass.navDisabled : ''
                ),
                'data-nav=' + ( next || -1 ) + ' ' +
                _.ariaAttr({
                    role: 'button',
                    controls: calendar.$node[0].id + '_table'
                }) + ' ' +
                'title="' + (next ? settings.labelMonthNext : settings.labelMonthPrev ) + '"'
            ) //endreturn
        }, //createMonthNav


        // Create the month label.
        //Materialize modified
        createMonthLabel = function(override) {

            var monthsCollection = settings.showMonthsShort ? settings.monthsShort : settings.monthsFull

             // Materialize modified
            if (override == "short_months") {
              monthsCollection = settings.monthsShort;
            }

            // If there are months to select, add a dropdown menu.
            if ( settings.selectMonths  && override == undefined) {

                return _.node( 'select',
                    _.group({
                        min: 0,
                        max: 11,
                        i: 1,
                        node: 'option',
                        item: function( loopedMonth ) {

                            return [

                                // The looped month and no classes.
                                monthsCollection[ loopedMonth ], 0,

                                // Set the value and selected index.
                                'value=' + loopedMonth +
                                ( viewsetObject.month == loopedMonth ? ' selected' : '' ) +
                                (
                                    (
                                        ( viewsetObject.year == minLimitObject.year && loopedMonth < minLimitObject.month ) ||
                                        ( viewsetObject.year == maxLimitObject.year && loopedMonth > maxLimitObject.month )
                                    ) ?
                                    ' disabled' : ''
                                )
                            ]
                        }
                    }),
                    settings.klass.selectMonth + ' browser-default',
                    ( isOpen ? '' : 'disabled' ) + ' ' +
                    _.ariaAttr({ controls: calendar.$node[0].id + '_table' }) + ' ' +
                    'title="' + settings.labelMonthSelect + '"'
                )
            }

            // Materialize modified
            if (override == "short_months")
                if (selectedObject != null)
                return _.node( 'div', monthsCollection[ selectedObject.month ] );
                else return _.node( 'div', monthsCollection[ viewsetObject.month ] );

            // If there's a need for a month selector
            return _.node( 'div', monthsCollection[ viewsetObject.month ], settings.klass.month )
        }, //createMonthLabel


        // Create the year label.
        // Materialize modified
        createYearLabel = function(override) {

            var focusedYear = viewsetObject.year,

            // If years selector is set to a literal "true", set it to 5. Otherwise
            // divide in half to get half before and half after focused year.
            numberYears = settings.selectYears === true ? 5 : ~~( settings.selectYears / 2 )

            // If there are years to select, add a dropdown menu.
            if ( numberYears ) {

                var
                    minYear = minLimitObject.year,
                    maxYear = maxLimitObject.year,
                    lowestYear = focusedYear - numberYears,
                    highestYear = focusedYear + numberYears

                // If the min year is greater than the lowest year, increase the highest year
                // by the difference and set the lowest year to the min year.
                if ( minYear > lowestYear ) {
                    highestYear += minYear - lowestYear
                    lowestYear = minYear
                }

                // If the max year is less than the highest year, decrease the lowest year
                // by the lower of the two: available and needed years. Then set the
                // highest year to the max year.
                if ( maxYear < highestYear ) {

                    var availableYears = lowestYear - minYear,
                        neededYears = highestYear - maxYear

                    lowestYear -= availableYears > neededYears ? neededYears : availableYears
                    highestYear = maxYear
                }

                if ( settings.selectYears  && override == undefined ) {
                    return _.node( 'select',
                        _.group({
                            min: lowestYear,
                            max: highestYear,
                            i: 1,
                            node: 'option',
                            item: function( loopedYear ) {
                                return [

                                    // The looped year and no classes.
                                    loopedYear, 0,

                                    // Set the value and selected index.
                                    'value=' + loopedYear + ( focusedYear == loopedYear ? ' selected' : '' )
                                ]
                            }
                        }),
                        settings.klass.selectYear + ' browser-default',
                        ( isOpen ? '' : 'disabled' ) + ' ' + _.ariaAttr({ controls: calendar.$node[0].id + '_table' }) + ' ' +
                        'title="' + settings.labelYearSelect + '"'
                    )
                }
            }

            // Materialize modified
            if (override == "raw")
                return _.node( 'div', focusedYear )

            // Otherwise just return the year focused
            return _.node( 'div', focusedYear, settings.klass.year )
        } //createYearLabel


        // Materialize modified
        createDayLabel = function() {
                if (selectedObject != null)
                    return _.node( 'div', selectedObject.date)
                else return _.node( 'div', nowObject.date)
            }
        createWeekdayLabel = function() {
            var display_day;

            if (selectedObject != null)
                display_day = selectedObject.day;
            else
                display_day = nowObject.day;
            var weekday = settings.weekdaysFull[ display_day ]
            return weekday
        }


    // Create and return the entire calendar.
return _.node(
        // Date presentation View
        'div',
            _.node(
                'div',
                createWeekdayLabel(),
                "picker__weekday-display"
            )+
            _.node(
                // Div for short Month
                'div',
                createMonthLabel("short_months"),
                settings.klass.month_display
            )+
            _.node(
                // Div for Day
                'div',
                createDayLabel() ,
                settings.klass.day_display
            )+
            _.node(
                // Div for Year
                'div',
                createYearLabel("raw") ,
                settings.klass.year_display
            ),
        settings.klass.date_display
    )+
    // Calendar container
    _.node('div',
        _.node('div',
        ( settings.selectYears ?  createMonthLabel() + createYearLabel() : createMonthLabel() + createYearLabel() ) +
        createMonthNav() + createMonthNav( 1 ),
        settings.klass.header
    ) + _.node(
        'table',
        tableHead +
        _.node(
            'tbody',
            _.group({
                min: 0,
                max: WEEKS_IN_CALENDAR - 1,
                i: 1,
                node: 'tr',
                item: function( rowCounter ) {

                    // If Monday is the first day and the month starts on Sunday, shift the date back a week.
                    var shiftDateBy = settings.firstDay && calendar.create([ viewsetObject.year, viewsetObject.month, 1 ]).day === 0 ? -7 : 0

                    return [
                        _.group({
                            min: DAYS_IN_WEEK * rowCounter - viewsetObject.day + shiftDateBy + 1, // Add 1 for weekday 0index
                            max: function() {
                                return this.min + DAYS_IN_WEEK - 1
                            },
                            i: 1,
                            node: 'td',
                            item: function( targetDate ) {

                                // Convert the time date from a relative date to a target date.
                                targetDate = calendar.create([ viewsetObject.year, viewsetObject.month, targetDate + ( settings.firstDay ? 1 : 0 ) ])

                                var isSelected = selectedObject && selectedObject.pick == targetDate.pick,
                                    isHighlighted = highlightedObject && highlightedObject.pick == targetDate.pick,
                                    isDisabled = disabledCollection && calendar.disabled( targetDate ) || targetDate.pick < minLimitObject.pick || targetDate.pick > maxLimitObject.pick,
                                    formattedDate = _.trigger( calendar.formats.toString, calendar, [ settings.format, targetDate ] )

                                return [
                                    _.node(
                                        'div',
                                        targetDate.date,
                                        (function( klasses ) {

                                            // Add the `infocus` or `outfocus` classes based on month in view.
                                            klasses.push( viewsetObject.month == targetDate.month ? settings.klass.infocus : settings.klass.outfocus )

                                            // Add the `today` class if needed.
                                            if ( nowObject.pick == targetDate.pick ) {
                                                klasses.push( settings.klass.now )
                                            }

                                            // Add the `selected` class if something's selected and the time matches.
                                            if ( isSelected ) {
                                                klasses.push( settings.klass.selected )
                                            }

                                            // Add the `highlighted` class if something's highlighted and the time matches.
                                            if ( isHighlighted ) {
                                                klasses.push( settings.klass.highlighted )
                                            }

                                            // Add the `disabled` class if something's disabled and the object matches.
                                            if ( isDisabled ) {
                                                klasses.push( settings.klass.disabled )
                                            }

                                            return klasses.join( ' ' )
                                        })([ settings.klass.day ]),
                                        'data-pick=' + targetDate.pick + ' ' + _.ariaAttr({
                                            role: 'gridcell',
                                            label: formattedDate,
                                            selected: isSelected && calendar.$node.val() === formattedDate ? true : null,
                                            activedescendant: isHighlighted ? true : null,
                                            disabled: isDisabled ? true : null
                                        })
                                    ),
                                    '',
                                    _.ariaAttr({ role: 'presentation' })
                                ] //endreturn
                            }
                        })
                    ] //endreturn
                }
            })
        ),
        settings.klass.table,
        'id="' + calendar.$node[0].id + '_table' + '" ' + _.ariaAttr({
            role: 'grid',
            controls: calendar.$node[0].id,
            readonly: true
        })
    )
    , settings.klass.calendar_container) // end calendar

     +

    // * For Firefox forms to submit, make sure to set the buttons’ `type` attributes as “button”.
    _.node(
        'div',
        _.node( 'button', settings.today, "btn-flat picker__today",
            'type=button data-pick=' + nowObject.pick +
            ( isOpen && !calendar.disabled(nowObject) ? '' : ' disabled' ) + ' ' +
            _.ariaAttr({ controls: calendar.$node[0].id }) ) +
        _.node( 'button', settings.clear, "btn-flat picker__clear",
            'type=button data-clear=1' +
            ( isOpen ? '' : ' disabled' ) + ' ' +
            _.ariaAttr({ controls: calendar.$node[0].id }) ) +
        _.node('button', settings.close, "btn-flat picker__close",
            'type=button data-close=true ' +
            ( isOpen ? '' : ' disabled' ) + ' ' +
            _.ariaAttr({ controls: calendar.$node[0].id }) ),
        settings.klass.footer
    ) //endreturn
} //DatePicker.prototype.nodes

;(function ($) {

  $.fn.characterCounter = function(){
    return this.each(function(){
      var $input = $(this);
      var $counterElement = $input.parent().find('span[class="character-counter"]');

      // character counter has already been added appended to the parent container
      if ($counterElement.length) {
        return;
      }

      var itHasLengthAttribute = $input.attr('length') !== undefined;

      if(itHasLengthAttribute){
        $input.on('input', updateCounter);
        $input.on('focus', updateCounter);
        $input.on('blur', removeCounterElement);

        addCounterElement($input);
      }

    });
  };

  function updateCounter(){
    var maxLength     = +$(this).attr('length'),
    actualLength      = +$(this).val().length,
    isValidLength     = actualLength <= maxLength;

    $(this).parent().find('span[class="character-counter"]')
                    .html( actualLength + '/' + maxLength);

    addInputStyle(isValidLength, $(this));
  }

  function addCounterElement($input) {
    var $counterElement = $input.parent().find('span[class="character-counter"]');

    if ($counterElement.length) {
      return;
    }

    $counterElement = $('<span/>')
                        .addClass('character-counter')
                        .css('float','right')
                        .css('font-size','12px')
                        .css('height', 1);

    $input.parent().append($counterElement);
  }

  function removeCounterElement(){
    $(this).parent().find('span[class="character-counter"]').html('');
  }

  function addInputStyle(isValidLength, $input){
    var inputHasInvalidClass = $input.hasClass('proyekalid');
    if (isValidLength && inputHasInvalidClass) {
      $input.removeClass('proyekalid');
    }
    else if(!isValidLength && !inputHasInvalidClass){
      $input.removeClass('valid');
      $input.addClass('proyekalid');
    }
  }

  $(document).ready(function(){
    $('input, textarea').characterCounter();
  });

}( jQuery ));
;(function ($) {

  var methods = {

    init : function(options) {
      var defaults = {
        time_constant: 200, // ms
        dist: -100, // zoom scale TODO: make this more intuitive as an option
        shift: 0, // spacing for center image
        padding: 0, // Padding between non center items
        full_width: false, // Change to full width styles
        indicators: false, // Toggle indicators
        no_wrap: false // Don't wrap around and cycle through items.
      };
      options = $.extend(defaults, options);

      return this.each(function() {

        var images, offset, center, pressed, dim, count,
            reference, referenceY, amplitude, target, velocity,
            xform, frame, timestamp, ticker, dragged, vertical_dragged;
        var $indicators = $('<ul class="indicators"></ul>');


        // Initialize
        var view = $(this);
        var showIndicators = view.attr('data-indicators') || options.indicators;

        // Don't double initialize.
        if (view.hasClass('initialized')) {
          // Redraw carousel.
          $(this).trigger('carouselNext', [0.000001]);
          return true;
        }


        // Options
        if (options.full_width) {
          options.dist = 0;
          var firstImage = view.find('.carousel-item img').first();
          if (firstImage.length) {
            imageHeight = firstImage.load(function(){
              view.css('height', $(this).height());
            });
          } else {
            imageHeight = view.find('.carousel-item').first().height();
            view.css('height', imageHeight);
          }

          // Offset fixed items when indicators.
          if (showIndicators) {
            view.find('.carousel-fixed-item').addClass('with-indicators');
          }
        }


        view.addClass('initialized');
        pressed = false;
        offset = target = 0;
        images = [];
        item_width = view.find('.carousel-item').first().innerWidth();
        dim = item_width * 2 + options.padding;

        view.find('.carousel-item').each(function (i) {
          images.push($(this)[0]);
          if (showIndicators) {
            var $indicator = $('<li class="indicator-item"></li>');

            // Add active to first by default.
            if (i === 0) {
              $indicator.addClass('active');
            }

            // Handle clicks on indicators.
            $indicator.click(function () {
              var index = $(this).index();
              cycleTo(index);
            });
            $indicators.append($indicator);
          }
        });

        if (showIndicators) {
          view.append($indicators);
        }
        count = images.length;


        function setupEvents() {
          if (typeof window.ontouchstart !== 'undefined') {
            view[0].addEventListener('touchstart', tap);
            view[0].addEventListener('touchmove', drag);
            view[0].addEventListener('touchend', release);
          }
          view[0].addEventListener('mousedown', tap);
          view[0].addEventListener('mousemove', drag);
          view[0].addEventListener('mouseup', release);
          view[0].addEventListener('mouseleave', release);
          view[0].addEventListener('click', click);
        }

        function xpos(e) {
          // touch event
          if (e.targetTouches && (e.targetTouches.length >= 1)) {
            return e.targetTouches[0].clientX;
          }

          // mouse event
          return e.clientX;
        }

        function ypos(e) {
          // touch event
          if (e.targetTouches && (e.targetTouches.length >= 1)) {
            return e.targetTouches[0].clientY;
          }

          // mouse event
          return e.clientY;
        }

        function wrap(x) {
          return (x >= count) ? (x % count) : (x < 0) ? wrap(count + (x % count)) : x;
        }

        function scroll(x) {
          var i, half, delta, dir, tween, el, alignment, xTranslation;

          offset = (typeof x === 'number') ? x : offset;
          center = Math.floor((offset + dim / 2) / dim);
          delta = offset - center * dim;
          dir = (delta < 0) ? 1 : -1;
          tween = -dir * delta * 2 / dim;
          half = count >> 1;

          if (!options.full_width) {
            alignment = 'translateX(' + (view[0].clientWidth - item_width) / 2 + 'px) ';
            alignment += 'translateY(' + (view[0].clientHeight - item_width) / 2 + 'px)';
          } else {
            alignment = 'translateX(0)';
          }

          // Set indicator active
          if (showIndicators) {
            var diff = (center % count);
            var activeIndicator = $indicators.find('.indicator-item.active');
            if (activeIndicator.index() !== diff) {
              activeIndicator.removeClass('active');
              $indicators.find('.indicator-item').eq(diff).addClass('active');
            }
          }

          // center
          // Don't show wrapped items.
          if (!options.no_wrap || (center >= 0 && center < count)) {
            el = images[wrap(center)];
            el.style[xform] = alignment +
              ' translateX(' + (-delta / 2) + 'px)' +
              ' translateX(' + (dir * options.shift * tween * i) + 'px)' +
              ' translateZ(' + (options.dist * tween) + 'px)';
            el.style.zIndex = 0;
            if (options.full_width) { tweenedOpacity = 1; }
            else { tweenedOpacity = 1 - 0.2 * tween; }
            el.style.opacity = tweenedOpacity;
            el.style.display = 'block';
          }

          for (i = 1; i <= half; ++i) {
            // right side
            if (options.full_width) {
              zTranslation = options.dist;
              tweenedOpacity = (i === half && delta < 0) ? 1 - tween : 1;
            } else {
              zTranslation = options.dist * (i * 2 + tween * dir);
              tweenedOpacity = 1 - 0.2 * (i * 2 + tween * dir);
            }
            // Don't show wrapped items.
            if (!options.no_wrap || center + i < count) {
              el = images[wrap(center + i)];
              el.style[xform] = alignment +
                ' translateX(' + (options.shift + (dim * i - delta) / 2) + 'px)' +
                ' translateZ(' + zTranslation + 'px)';
              el.style.zIndex = -i;
              el.style.opacity = tweenedOpacity;
              el.style.display = 'block';
            }


            // left side
            if (options.full_width) {
              zTranslation = options.dist;
              tweenedOpacity = (i === half && delta > 0) ? 1 - tween : 1;
            } else {
              zTranslation = options.dist * (i * 2 - tween * dir);
              tweenedOpacity = 1 - 0.2 * (i * 2 - tween * dir);
            }
            // Don't show wrapped items.
            if (!options.no_wrap || center - i >= 0) {
              el = images[wrap(center - i)];
              el.style[xform] = alignment +
                ' translateX(' + (-options.shift + (-dim * i - delta) / 2) + 'px)' +
                ' translateZ(' + zTranslation + 'px)';
              el.style.zIndex = -i;
              el.style.opacity = tweenedOpacity;
              el.style.display = 'block';
            }
          }

          // center
          // Don't show wrapped items.
          if (!options.no_wrap || (center >= 0 && center < count)) {
            el = images[wrap(center)];
            el.style[xform] = alignment +
              ' translateX(' + (-delta / 2) + 'px)' +
              ' translateX(' + (dir * options.shift * tween) + 'px)' +
              ' translateZ(' + (options.dist * tween) + 'px)';
            el.style.zIndex = 0;
            if (options.full_width) { tweenedOpacity = 1; }
            else { tweenedOpacity = 1 - 0.2 * tween; }
            el.style.opacity = tweenedOpacity;
            el.style.display = 'block';
          }
        }

        function track() {
          var now, elapsed, delta, v;

          now = Date.now();
          elapsed = now - timestamp;
          timestamp = now;
          delta = offset - frame;
          frame = offset;

          v = 1000 * delta / (1 + elapsed);
          velocity = 0.8 * v + 0.2 * velocity;
        }

        function autoScroll() {
          var elapsed, delta;

          if (amplitude) {
            elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
            delta = amplitude * Math.exp(-elapsed / options.time_constant);
            if (delta > 2 || delta < -2) {
                scroll(target - delta);
                requestAnimationFrame(autoScroll);
            } else {
                scroll(target);
            }
          }
        }

        function click(e) {
          // Disable clicks if carousel was dragged.
          if (dragged) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return false;

          } else if (!options.full_width) {
            var clickedIndex = $(e.target).closest('.carousel-item').index();
            var diff = (center % count) - clickedIndex;

            // Disable clicks if carousel was shifted by click
            if (diff !== 0) {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
            }
            cycleTo(clickedIndex);
          }
        }

        function cycleTo(n) {
          var diff = (center % count) - n;

          // Account for wraparound.
          if (!options.no_wrap) {
            if (diff < 0) {
              if (Math.abs(diff + count) < Math.abs(diff)) { diff += count; }

            } else if (diff > 0) {
              if (Math.abs(diff - count) < diff) { diff -= count; }
            }
          }

          // Call prev or next accordingly.
          if (diff < 0) {
            view.trigger('carouselNext', [Math.abs(diff)]);

          } else if (diff > 0) {
            view.trigger('carouselPrev', [diff]);
          }
        }

        function tap(e) {
          pressed = true;
          dragged = false;
          vertical_dragged = false;
          reference = xpos(e);
          referenceY = ypos(e);

          velocity = amplitude = 0;
          frame = offset;
          timestamp = Date.now();
          clearInterval(ticker);
          ticker = setInterval(track, 100);

        }

        function drag(e) {
          var x, delta, deltaY;
          if (pressed) {
            x = xpos(e);
            y = ypos(e);
            delta = reference - x;
            deltaY = Math.abs(referenceY - y);
            if (deltaY < 30 && !vertical_dragged) {
              // If vertical scrolling don't allow dragging.
              if (delta > 2 || delta < -2) {
                dragged = true;
                reference = x;
                scroll(offset + delta);
              }

            } else if (dragged) {
              // If dragging don't allow vertical scroll.
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              return false;

            } else {
              // Vertical scrolling.
              vertical_dragged = true;
            }
          }

          if (dragged) {
            // If dragging don't allow vertical scroll.
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return false;
          }
        }

        function release(e) {
          if (pressed) {
            pressed = false;
          } else {
            return;
          }

          clearInterval(ticker);
          target = offset;
          if (velocity > 10 || velocity < -10) {
            amplitude = 0.9 * velocity;
            target = offset + amplitude;
          }
          target = Math.round(target / dim) * dim;

          // No wrap of items.
          if (options.no_wrap) {
            if (target >= dim * (count - 1)) {
              target = dim * (count - 1);
            } else if (target < 0) {
              target = 0;
            }
          }
          amplitude = target - offset;
          timestamp = Date.now();
          requestAnimationFrame(autoScroll);

          if (dragged) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
          }
          return false;
        }

        xform = 'transform';
        ['webkit', 'Moz', 'O', 'ms'].every(function (prefix) {
          var e = prefix + 'Transform';
          if (typeof document.body.style[e] !== 'undefined') {
            xform = e;
            return false;
          }
          return true;
        });



        window.onresize = scroll;

        setupEvents();
        scroll(offset);

        $(this).on('carouselNext', function(e, n) {
          if (n === undefined) {
            n = 1;
          }
          target = offset + dim * n;
          if (offset !== target) {
            amplitude = target - offset;
            timestamp = Date.now();
            requestAnimationFrame(autoScroll);
          }
        });

        $(this).on('carouselPrev', function(e, n) {
          if (n === undefined) {
            n = 1;
          }
          target = offset - dim * n;
          if (offset !== target) {
            amplitude = target - offset;
            timestamp = Date.now();
            requestAnimationFrame(autoScroll);
          }
        });

        $(this).on('carouselSet', function(e, n) {
          if (n === undefined) {
            n = 0;
          }
          cycleTo(n);
        });

      });



    },
    next : function(n) {
      $(this).trigger('carouselNext', [n]);
    },
    prev : function(n) {
      $(this).trigger('carouselPrev', [n]);
    },
    set : function(n) {
      $(this).trigger('carouselSet', [n]);
    }
  };


    $.fn.carousel = function(methodOrOptions) {
      if ( methods[methodOrOptions] ) {
        return methods[ methodOrOptions ].apply( this, Array.prototype.slice.call( arguments, 1 ));
      } else if ( typeof methodOrOptions === 'object' || ! methodOrOptions ) {
        // Default to "init"
        return methods.init.apply( this, arguments );
      } else {
        $.error( 'Method ' +  methodOrOptions + ' does not exist on jQuery.carousel' );
      }
    }; // Plugin end
}( jQuery ));

## File: ./js/financialreport.js
----------------------------------------
/*
  Document      : financialreport.js
  Description   : Laporan Keuangan - Neraca & Laba Rugi, render sebagai
                   HTML table (bukan Ext Grid, supaya mudah bikin format
                   laporan keuangan konvensional: indentasi, subtotal, dll).
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/financialreportCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Financial <em>Report</em>";

    ['addData', 'editData', 'deleteData'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 0. Buat elemen filter bar & area laporan secara dinamis
    // ============================================================
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    if (gridContainer) gridContainer.style.display = 'none'; // tidak pakai Ext grid di modul ini

    var wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.style.padding = '0 10px';
    wrapper.innerHTML =
        '<div id="frFilterBar" style="padding:8px 0;"></div>' +
        '<div style="display:flex; gap:20px; flex-wrap:wrap;">' +
        '  <div id="frBalanceSheet" style="flex:1; min-width:400px;"></div>' +
        '  <div id="frIncomeStatement" style="flex:1; min-width:400px;"></div>' +
        '</div>';
    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, gridContainer);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 1. Filter periode
    // ============================================================
    var periodField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'period_name' }];
    var periodDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/financialreportCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_periods' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, periodField),
        listeners: {
            load: function (store) {
                if (store.getCount() > 0 && !fldPeriod.getValue()) {
                    fldPeriod.setValue(store.getAt(0).get('id'));
                    loadReport();
                }
            }
        }
    });
    periodDs.load();

    var fldPeriod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Periode', width: 200, store: periodDs, displayField: 'period_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var btnShow = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Tampilkan', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button' });

    new Ext.Panel({
        renderTo: 'frFilterBar',
        layout: 'column',
        border: false,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;',
        defaults: { border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;' },
        items: [
            { columnWidth: 0.3, layout: 'form', labelWidth: 60, items: fldPeriod },
            { columnWidth: 0.15, style: 'padding-top:2px;', items: btnShow }
        ]
    });
    btnShow.on('click', loadReport);

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Helper render tabel HTML
    // ============================================================
    function fmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }

    function renderAccountRows(items) {
        return items.map(function (it) {
            return '<tr style="color:#e5e5e5;"><td style="padding-left:20px;">' + it.account_code + ' - ' + it.account_name + '</td>' +
                   '<td style="text-align:right;">' + fmt(it.balance !== undefined ? it.balance : it.amount) + '</td></tr>';
        }).join('');
    }

    function renderBalanceSheet(bs) {
        var balColor = bs.is_balance ? '#2e9e4f' : '#c0392b';
        var balText = bs.is_balance ? 'BALANCE ✓' : 'TIDAK BALANCE ✗';
        var html = '<h3 style="margin-bottom:6px; color:#fff;">NERACA</h3>' +
            '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; color:#e5e5e5;" class="fr-table">' +
            '<tr style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff;"><td colspan="2"><b>ASET</b></td></tr>' +
            renderAccountRows(bs.asset) +
            '<tr style="border-top:1px solid #888; color:#fff;"><td><b>Total Aset</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(bs.asset_total) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td colspan="2">&nbsp;</td></tr>' +
            '<tr style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff;"><td colspan="2"><b>LIABILITAS</b></td></tr>' +
            renderAccountRows(bs.liability) +
            '<tr style="border-top:1px solid #888; color:#fff;"><td><b>Total Liabilitas</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(bs.liability_total) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td colspan="2">&nbsp;</td></tr>' +
            '<tr style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff;"><td colspan="2"><b>EKUITAS</b></td></tr>' +
            renderAccountRows(bs.equity) +
            '<tr><td style="padding-left:20px;">Laba (Rugi) Kumulatif s/d Periode Ini</td><td style="text-align:right;">' + fmt(bs.net_income_cumulative) + '</td></tr>' +
            '<tr style="border-top:1px solid #888; color:#fff;"><td><b>Total Ekuitas</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(bs.equity_total) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td colspan="2">&nbsp;</td></tr>' +
            '<tr style="border-top:2px solid #888; color:#fff;"><td><b>Total Liabilitas + Ekuitas</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(bs.liability_total + bs.equity_total) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '</table>' +
            '<p style="color:' + balColor + '; font-weight:bold; margin-top:8px;">' + balText + '</p>';
        document.getElementById('frBalanceSheet').innerHTML = html;
    }

    function renderIncomeStatement(is) {
        var niColor = is.net_income_period >= 0 ? '#2e9e4f' : '#c0392b';
        var niLabel = is.net_income_period >= 0 ? 'LABA BERSIH' : 'RUGI BERSIH';
        var html = '<h3 style="margin-bottom:6px; color:#fff;">LAPORAN LABA RUGI</h3>' +
            '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; color:#e5e5e5;" class="fr-table">' +
            '<tr style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff;"><td colspan="2"><b>PENDAPATAN</b></td></tr>' +
            renderAccountRows(is.revenue) +
            '<tr style="border-top:1px solid #888; color:#fff;"><td><b>Total Pendapatan</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(is.revenue_total) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td colspan="2">&nbsp;</td></tr>' +
            '<tr style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff;"><td colspan="2"><b>BEBAN</b></td></tr>' +
            renderAccountRows(is.expense) +
            '<tr style="border-top:1px solid #888; color:#fff;"><td><b>Total Beban</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(is.expense_total) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td colspan="2">&nbsp;</td></tr>' +
            '<tr style="border-top:2px solid #888;"><td style="color:#fff;"><b>' + niLabel + '</b></td><td style="text-align:right; color:' + niColor + ';"><b>' + fmt(Math.abs(is.net_income_period)) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '</table>';
        document.getElementById('frIncomeStatement').innerHTML = html;
    }

    function loadReport() {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) return;
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/financialreportCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_report', period_id: perId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Error', res.message || 'Gagal memuat laporan.');
                    return;
                }
                renderBalanceSheet(res.balance_sheet);
                renderIncomeStatement(res.income_statement);
            }
        });
    }

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        window.open('../pdf/financialreport.php?period_id=' + perId, 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };
});

## File: ./js/rab.js

/*
  Document      : rab.js
  Description   : Kelola baris RAB Material per Proyek. Grid utama
                   menampilkan daftar Proyek (public.projects) + ringkasan
                   RAB (jumlah material, total budget, total aktual,
                   status). Klik baris -> buka editor RAB (grid editable
                   material + kolom monitoring qty terpakai/status,
                   sumber material dari master m_materials).
                   Modul ini TIDAK mengubah header proyek (nama, client,
                   PIC, dll) -- itu urusan Master Proyek (m_proyek.js).
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/rabCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "RAB <em>Material</em>";

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    function statusColor(v) {
        if (v === 'OVERBUDGET') return '#c0392b !important';
        if (v === 'WARNING') return '#e6a817 !important';
        if (v === 'NO BUDGET') return '#888888 !important';
        return '#00ff4c !important';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 0. Container Panel Detail Material (tampil di bawah grid utama,
    //    style disesuaikan dengan Purchase Planning)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var rabDtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
    rabDtlDiv.id = 'rabDtlContainer';
    rabDtlDiv.className = 'detail-panel-container';
    rabDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';

    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(rabDtlDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
    }

    function loadRabDetailPanel(projectId, projectName) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/rabCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'load_rab', project_id: projectId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    rabDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow; padding:10px;">Gagal memuat daftar material.</div>';
                    rabDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderRabDetailPanel(res.data.items || [], projectName);
            },
            failure: function () {
                rabDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red; padding:10px;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                rabDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderRabDetailPanel(rows, projectName) {
        var fmtQty = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); };
        var fmtAmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };
        var fmtPct = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0.00') + '%'; };

        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Daftar Material RAB: ' +
                   Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(projectName || '') + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<table id="rabTable" class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Material</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Budget Qty</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Harga Satuan</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Total Budget</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Qty Terpakai</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">% Terpakai</th>' +
                   '<th align="center">Status</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="7" style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#557982;">Belum ada baris RAB material untuk proyek ini. Klik Edit untuk menambahkan.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var totalBudget = (parseFloat(r.budget_qty) || 0) * (parseFloat(r.unit_price) || 0);
                html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.material_name || '-') + ' <span style="color:#668894;">(' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.material_code || '') + ')</span></td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtQty(r.budget_qty) + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.unit || '') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(r.unit_price) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" class="subtotal-val">' + fmtAmt(totalBudget) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtQty(r.total_qty_out) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtPct(r.usage_pct) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="center" style="font-weight:bold; color:' + statusColor(r.status) + ';">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.status || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }
        html += '</tbody></table>';

        rabDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        rabDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Fields & Stores
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var projectField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }, { name: 'client_name' }, { name: 'status' },
        { name: 'material_count', type: 'int' },
        { name: 'total_budget_cost', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'total_actual_cost', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'rab_status' }
    ];

    var materialField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'material_code' }, { name: 'material_name' }, { name: 'unit' },
        { name: 'estimated_price', type: 'float' }
    ];

    var rabItemField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'material_id' }, { name: 'material_code' }, { name: 'material_name' },
        { name: 'unit' }, { name: 'budget_qty', type: 'float' }, { name: 'unit_price', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'tolerance_pct', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'total_qty_out', type: 'float' }, { name: 'remaining_qty', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'usage_pct', type: 'float' }, { name: 'status' }
    ];

    var materialDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/rabCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'list_materials' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, materialField)
    });
    materialDs.load();

    var rabItemDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data' }, rabItemField)
    });

    // PENTING: assignment polos (bukan var/let) -- konvensi search box global.
    mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/rabCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'list_projects' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, projectField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Main Grid (Daftar Proyek + Ringkasan RAB)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var GridDtlHeight = (maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));
    var mainHeight = Math.round(GridDtlHeight - (GridDtlHeight * 0.5));
    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: mainHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Nama Proyek', dataIndex: 'name', width: 220, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Klien', dataIndex: 'client_name', width: 170, renderer: function (v) { return CellWrap(v || '-'); } },
            { header: 'Status Proyek', dataIndex: 'status', width: 110, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Jml Material RAB', dataIndex: 'material_count', width: 110, align: 'center' },
            {
                header: 'Total Budget', dataIndex: 'total_budget_cost', width: 140, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Total Aktual', dataIndex: 'total_actual_cost', width: 140, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Status RAB', dataIndex: 'rab_status', width: 110, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) {
                    return '<span style="color:' + statusColor(v) + ';font-weight:bold;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v || '-') + '</span>';
                }
            }
        ],
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        loadMask: true,
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    mainBtnEnable('#editData');
                    loadRabDetailPanel(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.name);
                }
            }
        }
    });
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#addData');
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Item Grid Editor (Baris RAB + kolom Monitoring)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var itemGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: rabItemDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 300,
        columns: [
            {
                header: 'Material', dataIndex: 'material_id', width: 200,
                editor: new myComboField({
                    store: materialDs, displayField: 'material_name', valueField: 'id',
                    mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true,
                    listeners: {
                        select: function (combo, record) {
                            var activeRow = itemGrid.getSelectionModel().getSelected();
                            if (activeRow) {
                                activeRow.set('material_code', record.get('material_code'));
                                activeRow.set('material_name', record.get('material_name'));
                                activeRow.set('unit', record.get('unit'));
                                if (!activeRow.get('unit_price')) {
                                    activeRow.set('unit_price', record.get('estimated_price'));
                                }
                                updateRabTotalLabel();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }),
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    var rec = materialDs.getById(v);
                    if (rec) return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(rec.get('material_name'));
                    if (record && record.get('material_name')) {
                        return '<span style="color:#e6a817;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(record.get('material_name')) + '</span>';
                    }
                    return '<i>-- pilih material --</i>';
                }
            },
            { header: 'Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit', width: 60, align: 'center' },
            {
                header: 'Budget Qty', dataIndex: 'budget_qty', width: 90, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 4 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Harga Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit_price', width: 100, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Toleransi (%)', dataIndex: 'tolerance_pct', width: 80, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 })
            },
            {
                header: 'Total Budget', dataIndex: 'budget_qty', width: 110, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    var total = (parseFloat(record.get('budget_qty')) || 0) * (parseFloat(record.get('unit_price')) || 0);
                    return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00') + '</b>';
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Qty Terpakai', dataIndex: 'total_qty_out', width: 90, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
            },
            {
                header: '% Terpakai', dataIndex: 'usage_pct', width: 80, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0.00') + '%'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 90, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) {
                    return '<span style="color:' + statusColor(v) + ';font-weight:bold;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v || '-') + '</span>';
                }
            },
            {
                id: 'rabDeleteCol', header: '', dataIndex: 'material_id', width: 32, align: 'center', fixed: true,
                renderer: function () {
                    return '<span class="rabDeleteBtn" style="color:#e05353;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;font-size:14px;" title="Hapus baris">&#10005;</span>';
                }
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function () { updateRabTotalLabel(); },
            cellclick: function (grid, rowIndex, columnIndex) {
                if (grid.getColumnModel().getColumnId(columnIndex) === 'rabDeleteCol') {
                    grid.getStore().removeAt(rowIndex);
                    updateRabTotalLabel();
                }
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    (function injectExtraUI() {
        var gridEditorContainer = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        if (gridEditorContainer && !document.getElementById('lblRabTotal')) {
            var totalsDiv = document.createElement('div');
            totalsDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px; margin-top:8px; font-weight:bold; font-size:14px; text-align:right; background:#1f2d3a; color:#ffffff !important; border-radius:4px;';
            totalsDiv.innerHTML = 'Total Budget RAB: <span id="lblRabTotal" style="color:#ffffff !important;">0.00</span>';
            gridEditorContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(totalsDiv, gridEditorContainer.nextSibling);

            var btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.id = 'btnAddRabRow';
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.innerHTML = '+ Tambah Material';
            btn.style.cssText = 'margin-bottom:6px; padding:5px 12px; background:#2e6da4; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer;';
            btn.onclick = addBlankMaterialRow;
            gridEditorContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(btn, gridEditorContainer);
        }
    })();

    function updateRabTotalLabel() {
        var total = 0;
        rabItemDs.each(function (r) {
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('budget_qty')) || 0;
            var price = parseFloat(r.get('unit_price')) || 0;
            total += qty * price;
        });
        var el = document.getElementById('lblRabTotal');
        if (el) el.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00');
    }

    function addBlankMaterialRow() {
        var RabRecord = rabItemDs.recordType || Ext.data.Record.create(rabItemField);
        var rec = new RabRecord({
            id: 0, material_id: null, material_code: '', material_name: '', unit: '',
            budget_qty: 0, unit_price: 0, tolerance_pct: 0,
            total_qty_out: 0, remaining_qty: 0, usage_pct: 0, status: 'ON TRACK'
        });
        rabItemDs.add(rec);
        updateRabTotalLabel();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih proyek terlebih dahulu dari tabel.');
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() < 3) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengedit RAB.');
            return;
        }
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/rabCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'load_rab', project_id: dataRecord.id },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Gagal memuat RAB.');
                    return;
                }
                rabItemDs.loadData({ data: res.data.items || [] });
                updateRabTotalLabel();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;RAB Material -- ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(res.data.name || '');
            },
            failure: function () {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) return;

        var arrItems = [];
        var hasInvalidRow = false;
        rabItemDs.each(function (r) {
            var materialId = r.get('material_id');
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('budget_qty')) || 0;
            if (!materialId && qty <= 0) return;
            if (!materialId || qty <= 0) { hasInvalidRow = true; return; }
            arrItems.push({
                id: r.get('id') || 0,
                material_id: materialId,
                budget_qty: qty,
                unit_price: parseFloat(r.get('unit_price')) || 0,
                tolerance_pct: parseFloat(r.get('tolerance_pct')) || 0
            });
        });

        if (hasInvalidRow) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Ada baris material yang belum lengkap. Pastikan material dipilih dan Budget Qty > 0.');
            return;
        }

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/rabCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: 'save_rab',
                project_id: dataRecord.id,
                items: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arrItems)
            },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (res.success) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', 'RAB material berhasil disimpan.');
                    mainDs.load();
                    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    loadRabDetailPanel(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.name);
                } else {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
                }
            },
            failure: function () {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        if (document.getElementById('popCancel')) {
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

/*
  Document      : m.clients.js
  Description   : Master Klien (public.clients) -- CRUD sederhana tanpa
                   detail grid. Pola sama dengan m.materials.js.
                   mainDs di-assign POLOS (tanpa var/let) supaya search
                   box global di header (lihat many-template-icn.php)
                   bisa mengaksesnya.
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/clientsCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Master <em>Klien</em>";

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Fields & Store
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var clientField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }, { name: 'contact_person' }, { name: 'phone' },
        { name: 'email' }, { name: 'address' }, { name: 'project_count', type: 'int' },
        { name: 'created_at', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' }
    ];

    // PENTING: assignment polos (bukan var/let) -- supaya search box
    // global di header (kotak Search, id 'q') bisa mengakses mainDs ini.
    // Lihat many-template-icn.php: `let mainDs = '';` dideklarasikan
    // global, dan keydown listener global manggil mainDs.load(...).
    mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/clientsCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'list' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, clientField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Main Grid
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var GridDtlHeight = (maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));
    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: GridDtlHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Nama Klien', dataIndex: 'name', width: 200, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Contact Person', dataIndex: 'contact_person', width: 160, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Telepon', dataIndex: 'phone', width: 120, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Email', dataIndex: 'email', width: 180, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Alamat', dataIndex: 'address', width: 220, renderer: CellWrap },
            {
                header: 'Jml Proyek', dataIndex: 'project_count', width: 100, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) {
                    return '<span style="font-weight:bold;">' + (v || 0) + '</span>';
                }
            }
        ],
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        loadMask: true,
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    mainBtnEnable('#editData');
                    mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                }
            }
        }
    });
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Editor Form Fields
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fldName = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Nama Klien', id: 'name', name: 'name', allowBlank: false, maxLength: 255 });
    var fldContactPerson = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Contact Person', id: 'contact_person', name: 'contact_person', maxLength: 255 });
    var fldPhone = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Telepon', id: 'phone', name: 'phone', maxLength: 50 });
    var fldEmail = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Email', id: 'email', name: 'email', maxLength: 255, vtype: 'email' });
    var fldAddress = new myTextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Alamat', id: 'address', name: 'address' });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 130,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldName },
            { items: fldContactPerson },
            { items: fldPhone },
            { items: fldEmail },
            { columnWidth: 1, items: fldAddress },
            { items: [new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true })] }
        ]
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. CRUD Toolbar Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (getFormAccess() >= 2) {
            task = 'create';
            dataRecord = null;
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Klien Baru';
            fldName.focus('', 10);
        } else {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menambah klien.');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data klien terlebih dahulu dari tabel.');
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() >= 3) {
            task = 'update';
            frmEditor.getForm().load({
                url: '../php-crud/clientsCRD.php',
                params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' },
                success: function () {},
                failure: function () {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal memuat data klien.');
                }
            });
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Klien';
        } else {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk edit klien.');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data klien yang akan dihapus.');
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() >= 4) {
            var warn = dataRecord.project_count > 0
                ? ('Klien \'' + dataRecord.name + '\' terpakai di ' + dataRecord.project_count + ' proyek. Yakin ingin menghapus?')
                : ('Hapus klien \'' + dataRecord.name + '\'?');
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi Hapus', warn, function (btn) {
                if (btn === 'yes') {
                    Ext.Ajax.request({
                        url: '../php-crud/clientsCRD.php',
                        method: 'POST',
                        params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                        success: function (response) {
                            var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                            if (res.success) {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Informasi', 'Klien berhasil dihapus.');
                                dataRecord = null;
                                editDataDisable();
                                mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
                                mainDs.load();
                            } else {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message);
                            }
                        },
                        failure: function () {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        } else {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus.');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        var name = fldName.getValue();
        if (!name) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Nama Klien wajib diisi.');
            return;
        }

        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/clientsCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: task,
                id: (dataRecord && dataRecord.id) ? dataRecord.id : 0,
                name: name,
                contact_person: fldContactPerson.getValue(),
                phone: fldPhone.getValue(),
                email: fldEmail.getValue(),
                address: fldAddress.getValue()
            },
            waitTitle: 'Menyimpan',
            waitMsg: 'Menyimpan data klien...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', 'Klien ' + (res.name || name) + ' berhasil disimpan.');
                mainDs.load();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

## File: ./js/m.form.group.js

/*
    Document        : Master Form Group
    Description     : Controller & UI Handler ExtJS 3.4 (Aligned Checkbox & Layout)
*/

Ext.onReady(function() {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    
    if (document.getElementById("mainHeaderText")) {
        document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Form Group";
    }

    var task = '';
    var pageSizeVal = typeof PageSize !== 'undefined' ? PageSize : 250;

    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function(event) {
        task = '';
        if (formAccess == 2 || formAccess == 3 || formAccess == 4) {
            task = 'create';
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "&nbsp;&nbsp;New Form Group";
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            fldActive.setValue(true);
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to access this window';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function(event) {
        task = '';
        if (formAccess == 3 || formAccess == 4) {
            if (!dataRecord || !dataRecord.id) {
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Pilih data group terlebih dahulu.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            task = 'update';
            Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().load({
                url: '../php-crud/m.form.groupCRD.php',
                params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' },
                success: function(form, action) {
                    let res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                    let row = (res && Ext.isArray(res.data)) ? res.data[0] : (res ? res.data : null);
                    let rawActive = row ? row.active : true;
                    let isActive = (rawActive === true || rawActive === 'true' || rawActive === 't' || rawActive === 1 || rawActive === '1');
                    fldActive.setValue(isActive);
                }
            });
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Form Group";
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to edit this data';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function(event) {
        if (formAccess == 4) {
            if (!dataRecord || !dataRecord.id) {
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Pilih data group yang akan dihapus.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            task = 'delete';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'delete group \'' + (dataRecord.grp_name || dataRecord.name || '') + '\' ?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to delete this data';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function(event) {
        window.open("../pdf/m.material_type.php", 'sub', 'toolbar=no,location=no,status=no,directories=no,menubar=no');
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function(event) {
        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: task,
                active: fldActive.getValue() ? 'true' : 'false'
            },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function(form, action) {
                let objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = objResponse.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';

                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function(form, action) {
                let objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = objResponse.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function(event) {
        if (task == 'delete') {
            deleteDs.load({
                params: { task: "delete", id: dataRecord.id },
                callback: function(records, operation, success) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
                    task = '';

                    let textMessages = Ext.util.JSON.decode(operation.response.responseText);
                    document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = textMessages.message;
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';

                    mainDs.load();
                    if (gridMain && gridMain.getView()) {
                        gridMain.getView().refresh(true);
                    }
                }
            });
            task = '';
            return;
        }
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        task = '';
    };

    document.getElementById('logData').onclick = function(event) {
        if (!dataRecord) return;
        document.getElementById('logWdw').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById("logFormHeaderText").innerHTML = '&nbsp;' + (dataRecord.grp_name || dataRecord.name || '');
        let historyHeight = calculateDivHeight(['logForm', 'logFormHeader']);
        GridHistory.setHeight(historyHeight);
        GridHistoryDs.load({ params: { id: dataRecord.id } });
    };

    let myMask = new Ext.LoadMask(Ext.getBody(), { msg: "Please wait..." });
    let deleteDs = new Ext.data.Store({ url: '../php-crud/m.form.groupCRD.php' });
    let grpField = [
        { name: 'id' },
        { name: 'seq' },
        { name: 'grp_name' },
        { name: 'remark' },
        { name: 'active', type: 'boolean' }
    ];

    mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/m.form.groupCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read', start: 0, limit: pageSizeVal },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalRecord', fields: grpField })
    });
    mainDs.load();

    // Checkbox Active -- TANPA name:'active' (supaya tidak ikut auto-submit
    // form asli dan bentrok dengan nilai eksplisit yang dikirim manual di
    // saveEdit -- itu yang bikin reaktivasi nonaktif->aktif gagal tersimpan).
    // TANPA boxLabel juga sesuai permintaan, cukup label "Active:" saja.
    let fldActive = new Ext.form.Checkbox({
        fieldLabel: 'Active',
        id: 'AddActive',
        checked: true,
        cls: 'fieldCheckClass regular-checkbox'
    });

    let frmEditor = new stdForm({

    }

    task='';

      frmEditor.getForm().reset();
      task = 'update';
      Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().load({url:'../php-crud/m.location.php',params:{id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit'}});
      document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display='block';
      document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Location";
      locHourDs.load({
        params:{id: dataRecord.id},
        callback: function(success , r){
          if(success){
            locHourDs.each(function(r){
              Ext.getCmp('start_date'+r.data.shift).setValue(r.data.from_date);
              Ext.getCmp(r.data.shift+((dayName[r.data.day]).substring(0,3)).toLowerCase()+'_start').setValue((r.data.from_time).substring(0,5));
              Ext.getCmp(r.data.shift+((dayName[r.data.day]).substring(0,3)).toLowerCase()+'_end').setValue((r.data.to_time).substring(0,5));
            });
          }
        }

Ext.onReady(function() {
	Ext.QuickTips.init();
