	document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function(event) {
    document.getElementById("cst_type").style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
		document.getElementById("saveEdit").style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
		document.getElementById("saveEdit").style.backgroundColor = '#1D6788';
		document.getElementById("saveEdit").style.color = '#fff';
		task='';
		if (formAccess==2 || formAccess==3 || formAccess==4){
			task = 'create';
      gridEditorDs.load({params:{id: 0}});
			document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display='block';
			document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "New Customer";

      var frmEditorHeight=(document.getElementById('editorForm').clientHeight - document.getElementById('editorFormHeader').clientHeight)+5;
      Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').setHeight(frmEditorHeight);

			frmEditor.getForm().reset();
			Ext.getCmp('init').focus('', 10);
			Ext.getCmp('country').setValue('1');
			Ext.getCmp('country').getEl().dom.removeAttribute('readOnly');
      Ext.getCmp('country').readOnly = false;
      Ext.getCmp('fsetnpwp').show();
      npwpNotAllowBlank();
		}else{
			document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to access this window';
			document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
		}
	};
	document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function(event) {
		task='';
		if (formAccess==3 || formAccess==4){
			frmEditor.getForm().reset();
			task = 'update';
			Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().load({
				url:'../php-crud/m.customerCRD.php',
				params:{id: dataRecord.id, task: 'readedit'},
				success:function(form, action) {
					var dt = action.result.data;
          cityDs.load({params: {province_id: dt.province},callback: function(success , r){if(success){Ext.getCmp('city').setValue(dt.city);}}});
          districtDs.load({params: {city_id: dt.city},callback: function(success , r){if(success){Ext.getCmp('district').setValue(dt.district);}}});
          villageDs.load({params: {district_id: dt.district},callback: function(success , r){if(success){Ext.getCmp('village').setValue(dt.village);}}});
          if (dt.cst_type==1) {Ext.getCmp('fsetnpwp').show();npwpNotAllowBlank();} else {Ext.getCmp('fsetnpwp').hide();npwpAllowBlank();}
				}
			});
			document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display='block';
			document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "Edit Customer";

      var frmEditorHeight=(document.getElementById('editorForm').clientHeight - document.getElementById('editorFormHeader').clientHeight)+5;
      Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').setHeight(frmEditorHeight);
      Ext.getCmp('country').getEl().dom.setAttribute('readOnly', true);
      Ext.getCmp('country').readOnly = true;
      document.getElementById("cst_type").style.pointerEvents = 'none';
		}else{
			document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML ='not enough permission to access this window';
			document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
		}
		task='update';
	};

				,ass_addr_off : Ext.getCmp('as_addr').getValue()

			waitTitle:'Connecting',

			success:function(form,action){
				var objResponse=Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
				var messagesStatus=objResponse.status;
				var messages=objResponse.message;
				/*document.getElementById("popWdwMainHeaderText").innerHTML=messagesStatus;*/
				document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML=messages;
				document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';

				mainDs.load({params:{task: 'read'}});
				frmEditor.getForm().reset();
				document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display='none';
			},
			failure:function(form, action){
				var objResponse=Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
				var messagesStatus=objResponse.status;
				var messages=objResponse.message;
				/*document.getElementById("popWdwMainHeaderText").innerHTML=messagesStatus;*/
				document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML=messages;
				document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
			}
		});

			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('rt').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('rt').getValue()=='') ? '' : ' RT : ' + Ext.getCmp('rt').getValue();
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('rw').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('rw').getValue()=='') ? '' : ' RW : ' + Ext.getCmp('rw').getValue();
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('city').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('city').getValue()=='') ? '' : '\n' + Ext.getCmp('city').getRawValue();
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('district').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('district').getValue()=='') ? '' : ' - ' + Ext.getCmp('district').getRawValue();
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('village').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('village').getValue()=='') ? '' : ' - ' + Ext.getCmp('village').getRawValue();
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('postal_code').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('postal_code').getValue()=='') ? '' : ' (' + Ext.getCmp('postal_code').getRawValue() + ')';
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('province').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('province').getValue()=='') ? '' : '\n' + Ext.getCmp('province').getRawValue() + ' - Indonesia';

## File: ./js/supplier.payment.js

/*
  Document      : supplier.payment.js
  Description   : Controller Supplier Payment
                  Main Grid + Detail Panel + Add / Edit / Delete (Editor Window)
  Backend       : ../php-crud/supplier.paymentCRD.php

  Hak akses (formAccess) -- sama dengan pengecekan di server:
     >= 2 : Add      >= 3 : Edit      >= 4 : Delete

  Aturan dana (sama dengan server):
     Dialokasikan ke invoice = SUM(Dibayar per invoice)
     Lebih bayar (uang muka) = Total Dibayar (kas/bank) + Saldo Deposit dipakai - Dialokasikan
     Lebih bayar  < 0  -> tidak boleh disimpan (dana kurang)
     Lebih bayar  > 0  -> dicatat sebagai Uang Muka Pembelian (deposit supplier)
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    if (document.getElementById("mainHeaderText")) {

    // Gaya toolbar & ringkasan grid alokasi (scoped ke #editorFormGrid, tidak memengaruhi halaman lain).

    var CRD = '../php-crud/supplier.paymentCRD.php';

    var origSupplierId = 0;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    function num(v) {
        var n = parseFloat(v);
        return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
    }
    function round2(v) {
        return Math.round((num(v) + 0.0000001) * 100) / 100;
    }
    function fmtAmt(v) {
        return Ext.util.Format.number(num(v), '0,000.00');
    }
    function esc(v) {
        return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v));
    }

    // Fungsi penanganan exception store aman
    function handleStoreException(proxy, type, action, options, response, arg) {
        var msg = 'Terjadi kesalahan saat memuat data dari server.';
        if (response && response.responseText) {
            try {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (res && res.message) msg = res.message;
            } catch (e) {
                msg = 'Format respon server tidak valid.';
            }
        }
        if (window.console) console.error('Store Exception:', type, action, response);
        Ext.Msg.alert('Error Store', msg);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Data Stores
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var paymentField = [
        { name: 'id' },
        { name: 'payment_no' },
        { name: 'payment_date' },
        { name: 'supplier_id' },
        { name: 'supplier_name' },
        { name: 'account_id' },
        { name: 'account_name' },
        { name: 'payment_method' },
        { name: 'total_amount', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'allocated_amount', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'excess_amount', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'deposit_applied', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'reference_no' },
        { name: 'notes' }
    ];

    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, paymentField),
        listeners: { exception: handleStoreException }

    var supplierDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        baseParams: { task: 'read_supplier' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }])

    var accountDs = new Ext.data.Store({

    var methodDs = new Ext.data.Store({

        baseParams: { task: 'read_payment_method' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data' }, [{ name: 'value' }, { name: 'label' }])

    // Invoice belum lunas (baris grid alokasi). POST supaya supplier_id & payment_id terkirim.

    function loadPaymentDetailPanel(paymentId, paymentNo) {
        if (!paymentId) return;

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_payment_detail', payment_id: paymentId },
            success: function (response) {
                try {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                    if (!res.success) {
                        payDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#ef4444; padding:10px; font-weight:bold;">Gagal memuat detail: ' + esc(res.message || '') + '</div>';
                        payDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                        return;
                    }
                    renderPaymentDetailPanel(res.data || [], paymentNo);
                } catch (e) {
                    payDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#ef4444; padding:10px;">Error parsing JSON backend.</div>';
                    payDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                }
            },
            failure: function () {
                payDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#ef4444; padding:10px;">Gagal terhubung ke server backend.</div>';
                payDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderPaymentDetailPanel(rows, paymentNo) {
        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title" style="margin:10px 0 5px 0; font-size:14px; color:#38bdf8;">Detail Alokasi Invoice: ' +
                   esc(paymentNo || '') + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" style="border:0; border-top:1px solid #334155; margin-bottom:10px;" />' +
                   '<table id="payTable" class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="6" style="border-collapse:collapse; color:#f8fafc; font-size:12px;">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row" style="background-color:#1e293b; color:#94a3b8;">' +
                   '<th align="left">No. Invoice</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">No. Invoice Supplier</th>' +
                   '<th align="center">Tgl Inv</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Total Tagihan</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Sisa Tagihan</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Nominal Dialokasikan</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">Belum ada alokasi invoice untuk pembayaran ini.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            var grandTotal = 0;
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var paid = num(r.amount_paid);
                grandTotal += paid;

                html += '<tr class="data-row" style="border-bottom:1px solid #334155;">' +
                        '<td align="left">' + esc(r.invoice_no || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="left">' + esc(r.supplier_invoice_no || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="center">' + esc(r.invoice_date || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(r.total_amount) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(r.unpaid_amount) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#38bdf8; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtAmt(paid) + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });

            html += '<tr class="footer-row" style="background-color:#0f172a; font-weight:bold;">' +
                    '<td colspan="5" align="right" style="padding:8px;">TOTAL ALOKASI:</td>' +
                    '<td align="right" style="color:#22c55e;">' + fmtAmt(grandTotal) + '</td>' +
                    '</tr>';
        }
        html += '</tbody></table>';

        payDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        payDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

    function setMainButtons() {
        if (typeof mainBtnEnable !== 'function' || typeof mainBtnDisable !== 'function') return;
        if (dataRecord && getFormAccess() >= 3) mainBtnEnable('#editData'); else mainBtnDisable('#editData');
        if (dataRecord && getFormAccess() >= 4) mainBtnEnable('#deleteData'); else mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
    }

    function clearSelection() {
        dataRecord = null;
        payDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
        setMainButtons();
    }

    gridMain.on('rowclick', function (grid, rowIndex) {
        var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
        if (rec) {
            dataRecord = rec.data;
            setMainButtons();
            loadPaymentDetailPanel(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.payment_no);
        }
    });

    setMainButtons(); // Edit & Delete nonaktif sampai ada baris dipilih

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Form Editor
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fldId = new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true });
    var fldPayNo = new myTextField({
        fieldLabel: 'No. Pembayaran', id: 'payment_no', name: 'payment_no',
        readOnly: true, disabled: true, emptyText: 'Otomatis oleh sistem', width: 200
    });
    var fldPayDate = new Ext.form.DateField({
        fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Bayar', id: 'payment_date', name: 'payment_date',
        format: 'Y-m-d', width: 140, allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldSupplier = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Supplier', id: 'supplier_id', name: 'supplier_id', hiddenName: 'supplier_id',
        store: supplierDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id',
        mode: 'remote', triggerAction: 'all', width: 200, allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldMethod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Metode', id: 'payment_method', name: 'payment_method', hiddenName: 'payment_method',
        store: methodDs, displayField: 'label', valueField: 'value',
        mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', editable: false, width: 200, allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldAccount = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Bayar Dari Akun', id: 'account_id', name: 'account_id', hiddenName: 'account_id',
        store: accountDs, displayField: 'account_name', valueField: 'id',
        mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', width: 200, allowBlank: true
    });
    var fldTotal = new Ext.form.NumberField({
        fieldLabel: 'Total Dibayar (Kas/Bank)', id: 'total_amount', name: 'total_amount',
        width: 140, allowNegative: false, decimalPrecision: 2, value: 0
    });
    var fldDeposit = new Ext.form.NumberField({
        fieldLabel: 'Pakai Saldo Deposit', id: 'deposit_applied', name: 'deposit_applied',
        width: 140, allowNegative: false, decimalPrecision: 2, value: 0
    });
    var fldDepBalance = new Ext.form.DisplayField({
        fieldLabel: 'Saldo Deposit Tersedia', id: 'deposit_balance', value: '0.00'
    });
    var fldRef = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Ref/Bukti', id: 'reference_no', name: 'reference_no', width: 200 });
    var fldNotes = new Ext.form.TextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Keterangan', id: 'notes', name: 'notes', width: 200, height: 45 });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 150,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: [fldId, fldPayNo, fldPayDate, fldSupplier, fldMethod, fldAccount] },
            { items: [fldTotal, fldDeposit, fldDepBalance, fldRef, fldNotes] }
        ]
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Grid Alokasi Invoice (editor)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var editorDeleter = (typeof Extensive !== 'undefined' && Extensive.grid && Extensive.grid.ItemDeleter)
        ? new Extensive.grid.ItemDeleter() : null;

    var allocColumns = [
        { header: 'No. Invoice', dataIndex: 'invoice_no', width: 120, align: 'left' },
        { header: 'No. Inv. Supplier', dataIndex: 'supplier_invoice_no', width: 120, align: 'left' },
        { header: 'Tgl Inv', dataIndex: 'invoice_date', width: 85, align: 'center' },
        { header: 'Total Tagihan', dataIndex: 'total_amount', width: 105, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt },
        { header: 'Sisa Hutang', dataIndex: 'unpaid_amount', width: 105, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt },
        {
            header: 'Dibayar', dataIndex: 'amount_paid', width: 115, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt,
            editor: new Ext.form.NumberField({ allowNegative: false, decimalPrecision: 2 }),
            css: (typeof cssGridEditColumn !== 'undefined') ? cssGridEditColumn : ''
        }
    ];
    if (editorDeleter) allocColumns.push(editorDeleter);
    allocColumns.push({ dataIndex: 'invoice_id', hidden: true });

    var gridAlloc = new stdGridEditor({
        id: 'gridEditorAlloc',
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        store: gridInvoiceDs,
        selModel: editorDeleter || new Ext.grid.RowSelectionModel({ singleSelect: true }),
        columns: allocColumns,
        tbar: [
            '<div id="gridHeaderText" class="alloc-title">Alokasi ke Invoice</div>',
            { xtype: 'tbfill' },
            '<div id="allocSummary" class="alloc-stats"></div>',
            { xtype: 'tbspacer', width: 14 },
            '<a id="btnAutoAlloc" class="alloc-btn" href="javascript:void(0)" title="Bagi dana ke invoice tertua lebih dulu">Alokasi otomatis (FIFO)</a>'
        ]
    });
    var lnkAutoAlloc = Ext.get('btnAutoAlloc');
    if (lnkAutoAlloc) {
        lnkAutoAlloc.on('click', function (e) {
            if (e && e.stopEvent) e.stopEvent();
            if (gridAlloc.stopEditing) gridAlloc.stopEditing();
            autoAllocateCombined();
        });
    }
    gridAlloc.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    function getAllocatedTotal() {
        var t = 0;
        gridInvoiceDs.each(function (r) { t += num(r.get('amount_paid')); });
        return round2(t);
    }

    // Deposit yang benar-benar bisa dipakai form ini.
    // Saat edit dengan supplier yang sama: saldo sekarang + deposit yang dipakai pembayaran ini
    // - uang muka yang dibuat pembayaran ini (keduanya akan dibalik dulu oleh server).
    function getAvailableDeposit() {
        var avail = depositBalance;
        if (task === 'update' && String(fldSupplier.getValue()) === String(origSupplierId)) {
            avail = depositBalance + origDeposit - origExcess;
        }
        return round2(Math.max(0, avail));
    }

    function refreshDepositDisplay() {
        fldDepBalance.setValue(fmtAmt(getAvailableDeposit()));
    }

    function statHtml(label, value, cls, hint) {
        return '<div class="alloc-stat ' + (cls || '') + '"' + (hint ? ' title="' + esc(hint) + '"' : '') + '>' +
               '<span class="alloc-lbl">' + label + '</span>' +
               '<span class="alloc-val">' + value + '</span></div>';
    }

    function refreshSummary() {
        var cash = num(fldTotal.getValue());
        var dep = num(fldDeposit.getValue());
        var alloc = getAllocatedTotal();
        var diff = round2(cash + dep - alloc);
        var el = Ext.get('allocSummary');
        if (!el) return;

        var third;
        if (diff < -0.01) {
            third = statHtml('Dana kurang', fmtAmt(-diff), 'pill bad', 'Dana belum cukup menutup alokasi invoice');
        } else if (diff > 0.01) {
            third = statHtml('Uang muka', fmtAmt(diff), 'pill ok', 'Lebih bayar: dicatat sebagai Uang Muka Pembelian (deposit supplier)');
        } else {
            third = statHtml('Selisih', 'Pas', 'pill zero', 'Dana sama dengan total alokasi');
        }

        el.update(
            statHtml('Dialokasikan', fmtAmt(alloc), 'first', 'Total nominal yang dibayarkan ke invoice') +
            statHtml('Dana (kas + deposit)', fmtAmt(cash + dep), '', 'Total dibayar (kas/bank) + saldo deposit yang dipakai') +
            third
        );
    }

    // Bagi dana ke invoice tertua dulu (urutan dari server: tanggal invoice, lalu id)
    function autoAllocateFIFO(total) {
        var remaining = round2(total);
        gridInvoiceDs.each(function (rec) {
            var unpaid = num(rec.get('unpaid_amount'));
            var alloc = round2(Math.max(0, Math.min(remaining, unpaid)));
            rec.set('amount_paid', alloc);
            remaining = round2(remaining - alloc);
        });
        refreshSummary();
    }

    function autoAllocateCombined() {
        autoAllocateFIFO(num(fldTotal.getValue()) + num(fldDeposit.getValue()));
    }

    // Batas per baris: 0 <= dibayar <= sisa hutang
    gridAlloc.on('afteredit', function (e) {
        if (e.field !== 'amount_paid') return;
        var unpaid = num(e.record.get('unpaid_amount'));
        var v = num(e.value);
        if (v < 0) {
            e.record.set('amount_paid', 0);
        } else if (v > unpaid + 0.01) {
            e.record.set('amount_paid', unpaid);
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Nominal dibayar tidak boleh melebihi sisa hutang invoice (' + fmtAmt(unpaid) + ').');
        }
        refreshSummary();
    });

    gridInvoiceDs.on('load', function () {
        // mode tambah: server sudah mengembalikan amount_paid = unpaid_amount (sisa hutang)
        // mode edit  : server sudah mengembalikan amount_paid dari alokasi tersimpan
        refreshSummary();
    });
    gridInvoiceDs.on('remove', refreshSummary);

    function onFundsChanged() {
        var dep = num(fldDeposit.getValue());
        var avail = getAvailableDeposit();
        if (dep > avail + 0.01) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Saldo deposit yang dipakai tidak boleh melebihi saldo tersedia (' + fmtAmt(avail) + ').');
            fldDeposit.setValue(avail);
        }
        if (task !== 'update') autoAllocateCombined(); else refreshSummary();
    }
    fldTotal.on('change', onFundsChanged);
    fldDeposit.on('change', onFundsChanged);

    function loadDepositBalance(supplierId, cb) {
        depositBalance = 0;
        if (!supplierId) {
            refreshDepositDisplay();
            if (cb) cb();
            return;
        }
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_supplier_deposit_balance', supplier_id: supplierId },
            success: function (response) {
                try {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                    if (res && res.success) depositBalance = num(res.balance);
                } catch (e) { /* saldo dianggap 0 */ }
                refreshDepositDisplay();
                if (cb) cb();
            },
            failure: function () {
                refreshDepositDisplay();
                if (cb) cb();
            }
        });
    }

    function loadInvoicesFor(supplierId) {
        gridInvoiceDs.removeAll();
        refreshSummary();
        if (!supplierId) return;
        gridInvoiceDs.load({
            params: {
                supplier_id: supplierId,
                payment_id: (task === 'update' && dataRecord) ? dataRecord.id : 0
            }
        });
    }

    fldSupplier.on('select', function (combo, record) {
        var sid = record.get('id');
        if (task !== 'update') fldDeposit.setValue(0);
        loadDepositBalance(sid, function () {
            if (num(fldDeposit.getValue()) > getAvailableDeposit() + 0.01) fldDeposit.setValue(getAvailableDeposit());
            loadInvoicesFor(sid);
        });
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. Window editor (template)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function setEditorGridHeight() {
        if (typeof $ !== 'function') return;
        var editorFormHeight = $('#editorForm').height() || 400;
        var headerHeight = $('#editorFormHeader').height() || 50;
        var mainFormHeight = $('#editorFormMain').height() || 150;
        var computedHeight = editorFormHeight - headerHeight - mainFormHeight - 20;
        if (computedHeight > 150) {
            gridAlloc.setHeight(computedHeight);
        }
    }

    function showWindow(titleText) {
        var wdw = document.getElementById('editorWdw');
        if (wdw) wdw.style.display = 'block';
        if (document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText')) {
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;' + titleText;
        }
        setEditorGridHeight();
        var frmCmp = Ext.getCmp('frmEditor');
        if (frmCmp) frmCmp.doLayout();
        refreshSummary();
    }

    function hideWindow() {
        var wdw = document.getElementById('editorWdw');
        if (wdw) wdw.style.display = 'none';
    }

    // Muat semua combo (supplier, akun, metode) sebelum form dibuka / diisi
    function loadCombos(cb) {
        var pending = 3;
        var done = function () {
            pending--;
            if (pending === 0 && cb) cb();
        };
        supplierDs.load({ callback: done });
        accountDs.load({ callback: done });
        methodDs.load({ callback: done });
    }

    function defaultMethod() {
        var idx = methodDs.find('value', 'BANK_TRANSFER');
        if (idx >= 0) return 'BANK_TRANSFER';
        return methodDs.getCount() > 0 ? methodDs.getAt(0).get('value') : 'BANK_TRANSFER';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 7. Aksi: Add, Edit, Delete, Save, Discard
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    if (Ext.get('addData')) {
        Ext.get('addData').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            if (getFormAccess() < 2) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak untuk menambah data.');
                return;
            }
            task = 'create';
            origSupplierId = 0; origDeposit = 0; origExcess = 0; depositBalance = 0;

            loadCombos(function () {
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                fldPayDate.setValue(new Date());
                fldMethod.setValue(defaultMethod());
                fldTotal.setValue(0);
                fldDeposit.setValue(0);
                gridInvoiceDs.removeAll();
                refreshDepositDisplay();
                showWindow('Tambah Pembayaran Supplier');
            });
        });
    }

    if (Ext.get('editData')) {
        Ext.get('editData').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            if (getFormAccess() < 3) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak untuk mengubah data.');
                return;
            }
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Silakan pilih data pembayaran terlebih dahulu.');
                return;
            }
            task = 'update';

            loadCombos(function () {
                Ext.Ajax.request({
                    url: CRD,
                    method: 'POST',
                    params: { task: 'read_edit', id: dataRecord.id },
                    success: function (response) {
                        var res;
                        try {
                            res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                        } catch (ex) {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Error', 'Format respon server tidak valid.');
                            return;
                        }
                        if (!res.success || !res.data) {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Data pembayaran tidak ditemukan.');
                            return;
                        }
                        var row = res.data;
                        origSupplierId = row.supplier_id;
                        origDeposit = num(row.deposit_applied);
                        origExcess = num(row.excess_amount);

                        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                        frmEditor.getForm().setValues(row);
                        gridInvoiceDs.removeAll();

                        loadDepositBalance(row.supplier_id, function () {
                            gridInvoiceDs.load({ params: { supplier_id: row.supplier_id, payment_id: row.id } });
                        });
                        showWindow('Edit Pembayaran Supplier: ' + esc(row.payment_no));
                    },
                    failure: function () {
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Error', 'Gagal terhubung ke server.');
                    }
                });
            });
        });
    }

    if (Ext.get('deleteData')) {
        Ext.get('deleteData').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            if (getFormAccess() < 4) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak untuk menghapus data.');
                return;
            }
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Silakan pilih data pembayaran terlebih dahulu.');
                return;
            }

            Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi',
                'Hapus pembayaran ' + esc(dataRecord.payment_no) + '?<br/>Jurnal pembayaran ikut dibatalkan dan sisa hutang invoice dikembalikan.',
                function (btn) {
                    if (btn !== 'yes') return;
                    Ext.Ajax.request({
                        url: CRD,
                        method: 'POST',
                        params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                        success: function (response) {
                            var res;
                            try {
                                res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                            } catch (ex) {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Error', 'Format respon server tidak valid.');
                                return;
                            }
                            if (res.success) {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message || 'Data pembayaran berhasil dihapus.');
                                mainDs.reload();
                                clearSelection();
                            } else {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Gagal menghapus data.');
                            }
                        },
                        failure: function () {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Error', 'Gagal terhubung ke server.');
                        }
                    });
                });
        });
    }

    function submitPayment(arrItems) {
        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: CRD,
            params: {
                task: task,
                arrItems: Ext.encode(arrItems)
            },
            waitMsg: 'Menyimpan data...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var msg = (action && action.result && action.result.message) ? action.result.message : 'Data pembayaran berhasil disimpan.';
                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', msg);
                hideWindow();
                mainDs.reload();
                clearSelection();
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var msg = 'Gagal menyimpan data.';
                if (action && action.result && action.result.message) {
                    msg = action.result.message;
                } else if (action && action.failureType === Ext.form.Action.CONNECT_FAILURE) {
                    msg = 'Gagal terhubung ke server (sesi mungkin berakhir).';
                }
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', msg);
            }
        });
    }

    if (Ext.get('saveEdit')) {
        Ext.get('saveEdit').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();

            if (!frmEditor.getForm().isValid()) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Mohon lengkapi semua field yang wajib diisi.');
                return;
            }
            if (gridAlloc.stopEditing) gridAlloc.stopEditing();

            var cash = num(fldTotal.getValue());
            var dep = num(fldDeposit.getValue());
            var alloc = getAllocatedTotal();
            var avail = getAvailableDeposit();

            if (cash <= 0 && dep <= 0) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Total dibayar atau saldo deposit yang dipakai harus lebih dari 0.');
                return;
            }
            if (cash > 0 && !fldAccount.getValue()) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih akun Kas/Bank sumber dana.');
                return;
            }
            if (dep > avail + 0.01) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Saldo deposit yang dipakai (' + fmtAmt(dep) + ') melebihi saldo tersedia (' + fmtAmt(avail) + ').');
                return;
            }
            if (dep > alloc + 0.01) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Saldo deposit yang dipakai tidak boleh melebihi total alokasi ke invoice.');
                return;
            }
            if (cash + dep + 0.01 < alloc) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Total dibayar + saldo deposit (' + fmtAmt(cash + dep) + ') belum cukup menutupi alokasi invoice (' + fmtAmt(alloc) + ').');
                return;
            }

            var arrItems = [];
            var overRow = null;
            gridInvoiceDs.each(function (rec) {
                var amt = round2(rec.get('amount_paid'));
                if (amt <= 0) return;
                if (amt > num(rec.get('unpaid_amount')) + 0.01) overRow = rec;
                arrItems.push({ invoice_id: rec.get('invoice_id'), amount_paid: amt });
            });
            if (overRow) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Nominal dibayar untuk invoice ' + esc(overRow.get('invoice_no')) + ' melebihi sisa hutangnya.');
                return;
            }

            var excess = round2(cash + dep - alloc);
            if (excess > 0.01) {
                Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi Uang Muka',
                    'Dana melebihi alokasi invoice sebesar <b>' + fmtAmt(excess) + '</b>.<br/>Selisih dicatat sebagai Uang Muka Pembelian (deposit supplier). Lanjutkan?',
                    function (btn) { if (btn === 'yes') submitPayment(arrItems); });
            } else {
                submitPayment(arrItems);
            }
        });
    }

    var btnDiscard = Ext.get('discardEdit') || Ext.select('#editorWdw .x-tool-close');
    if (btnDiscard) {
        btnDiscard.on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            hideWindow();
        });
    }

    var wdwInit = document.getElementById('editorWdw');
    if (wdwInit) wdwInit.style.display = 'none';
});

  let myMask = new Ext.LoadMask(Ext.getBody(), {msg:"Please wait..."});

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();

        ])

    clientDs.load();

    var picDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/m.proyekCRD.php',

        ])
    });

        url: '../php-crud/m.proyekCRD.php',

            { name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }

    var fldLocation = new myComboField({ fieldLabel: 'Lokasi', id: 'location_id', name: 'location_id', hiddenName: 'location_id', store: locationDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, width: 220 });

        ]
    });

        task = 'create';
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();

        document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Tambah Proyek Baru';
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) return;
        task = 'update';
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        frmEditor.getForm().load({
            url: '../php-crud/m.proyekCRD.php',
            params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_one' },
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                var d = res.data || {};
                fldClient.setValue(d.client_id);
                fldPic.setValue(d.pic_id);
                fldLocation.setValue(d.location_id);
                fldStatus.setValue(d.status);
            },
            failure: function () {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal memuat data proyek.');
            }
        });
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Master Proyek';
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        if (!frmEditor.getForm().isValid()) return;
        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/m.proyekCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: task },
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) return;
        Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi', 'Hapus proyek ini?', function (btn) {
            if (btn === 'yes') {
                Ext.Ajax.request({
                    url: '../php-crud/m.proyekCRD.php',
                    params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                    success: function (response) {
                        var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                        document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                        mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    };


    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        if (document.getElementById('popCancel')) {
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';

});

/*
  Document      : financial_profit_loss.js
  Description   : Income Statement (Rugi Laba) - Read-only report
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/profitlossCRD.php

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Profit & <em>Loss</em>";

    // Sembunyikan toolbar CRUD bawaan
    ['addData', 'editData', 'deleteData'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // 0. Buat container filter & report secara dinamis
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var filterBarDiv = document.createElement('div');
    filterBarDiv.id = 'plFilterBar';
    filterBarDiv.style.padding = '0 10px';

    var reportDiv = document.createElement('div');
    reportDiv.id = 'plReportContainer';
    reportDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:15px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color:#fff; margin:0 10px 10px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); font-size:13px;';

    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(filterBarDiv, gridContainer);
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(reportDiv, gridContainer);
    }

    // 1. Store Periode
    var periodField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'period_name' }, { name: 'start_date' }, { name: 'end_date' }];
    var periodDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/profitlossCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_periods' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, periodField),
        listeners: {
            load: function (store) {
                if (store.getCount() > 0 && !fldPeriod.getValue()) {
                    fldPeriod.setValue(store.getAt(0).get('id'));
                    loadProfitLoss();
                }
            }
        }
    });
    periodDs.load();

    // 2. Filter Bar
    var fldPeriod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Periode', width: 220, store: periodDs, displayField: 'period_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var btnShow = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Tampilkan', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button' });

    var filterPanel = new Ext.Panel({
        renderTo: 'plFilterBar',
        layout: 'column',
        border: false,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:8px 0;',
        defaults: { border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;' },
        items: [
            { columnWidth: 0.35, layout: 'form', labelWidth: 60, items: fldPeriod },
            { columnWidth: 0.15, style: 'padding-top:2px;', items: btnShow }
        ]
    });

    function loadProfitLoss() {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/profitlossCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_profit_loss', period_id: perId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    reportDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">' + (res.message || 'Gagal memuat data.') + '</div>';
                    return;
                }
                renderPLView(res);
            }
        });
    }

    function renderPLView(res) {
        var fmt = function (val) { return Ext.util.Format.number(val || 0, '0,000.00'); };

        var html = '<h2 style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:4px; font-weight:normal;">LAPORAN RUGI LABA</h2>' +
                   '<h4 style="text-align:center; color:#bbb; margin-top:0; font-weight:normal;">Periode: ' + res.period_name + ' (' + res.start_date + ' s/d ' + res.end_date + ')</h4>' +
                   '<hr style="border:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); margin:15px 0;" />';

        // Pendapatan
        html += '<h3 style="color:#2e9e4f; margin-bottom:8px;">PENDAPATAN</h3>' +
                '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse; margin-bottom:15px;">';
        Ext.each(res.revenues, function (r) {
            html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #71de25;">' +
                    '<td padding="6px" width="15%">' + r.account_code + '</td>' +
                    '<td padding="6px">' + r.account_name + '</td>' +
                    '<td padding="6px" align="right" width="20%">' + fmt(r.amount) + '</td>' +
                    '</tr>';
        });
        html += '<tr style="font-weight:bold; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #71de25;">' +
                '<td colspan="2" style="padding:8px;">TOTAL PENDAPATAN</td>' +
                '<td align="right" style="padding:8px; color:#2e9e4f;">' + fmt(res.total_revenue) + '</td>' +
                '</tr></table>';

        // Beban
        html += '<h3 style="color:#e74c3c; margin-bottom:8px;">BEBAN / BIAYA</h3>' +
                '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse; margin-bottom:20px;">';
        Ext.each(res.expenses, function (e) {
            html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);color: #e74c3c">' +
                    '<td padding="6px" width="15%">' + e.account_code + '</td>' +
                    '<td padding="6px">' + e.account_name + '</td>' +
                    '<td padding="6px" align="right" width="20%">' + fmt(e.amount) + '</td>' +
                    '</tr>';
        });
        html += '<tr style="font-weight:bold; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color:#e74c3c">' +
                '<td colspan="2" style="padding:8px;">TOTAL BEBAN</td>' +
                '<td align="right" style="padding:8px; color:#e74c3c;">' + fmt(res.total_expense) + '</td>' +
                '</tr></table>';

        // Summary Laba / Rugi
        var netColor = res.net_profit_loss >= 0 ? '#71de25' : '#e74c3c';
        var netLabel = res.net_profit_loss >= 0 ? 'LABA BERSIH' : 'RUGI BERSIH';

        html += '<div style="padding:12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08; ) ;font-size:15px; font-weight:bold; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; border-radius:4px;">' +
                '<span>' + netLabel + '</span>' +
                '<span style="color:' + netColor + ';">' + fmt(res.net_profit_loss) + '</span>' +
                '</div>';

        reportDiv.innerHTML = html;
    }

    btnShow.on('click', loadProfitLoss);

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        window.open('../pdf/profitloss.php?period_id=' + perId, 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };

    if (document.getElementById('popOK')) {
        document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        };
    }
});

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();

        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    // 0. Container Detail Baris Jurnal (Pola Detail Panel GRN)
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');

    var journalDtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
    journalDtlDiv.id = 'journalDtlContainer';
    journalDtlDiv.className = 'detail-panel-container';
    journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';

    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(journalDtlDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
    }

    // Buat elemen UI tambahan pada form editor
    (function injectExtraUI() {
        var iconMenu = document.getElementById('iconMenuL');
        if (iconMenu && !document.getElementById('postData')) {
            var postBtn = document.createElement('a');
            postBtn.id = 'postData';
            postBtn.href = 'javascript:void(0);';
            postBtn.style.display = 'none';
            postBtn.innerHTML = '<t>Post</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">lock</i>';
            iconMenu.appendChild(postBtn);
        }

        var gridEditorContainer = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        if (gridEditorContainer && !document.getElementById('btnAddLine')) {
            var toolbar = document.createElement('div');
            toolbar.style.padding = '5px 0';
            toolbar.innerHTML = '<button id="btnAddLine" type="button" class="field-button grey-field-button">+ Tambah Baris</button>';
            gridEditorContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(toolbar, gridEditorContainer);

        }
    })();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Fields & Stores

            { header: 'Keterangan', dataIndex: 'description', width: 220, renderer: CellWrap },
            {
                header: 'Total Debit', dataIndex: 'total_debit', width: 110, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Total Kredit', dataIndex: 'total_credit', width: 110, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            { header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 90, align: 'center', renderer: statusRenderer }
        ],
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        loadMask: true,
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                    editDataEnable();
                    togglePostButton();
                    toggleEditViewButtons();
                    loadJournalDetail(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.ref_no);
                }
            }
        }
    });
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Detail View Renderer (Desain Seragam dengan GRN)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function loadJournalDetail(journalId, refNo) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/journal.entryCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_lines', id: journalId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    journalDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Gagal memuat detail jurnal.</div>';
                    journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderJournalDetailView(res.data || [], refNo);
            },
            failure: function() {
                journalDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderJournalDetailView(rows, refNo) {
        var fmtAmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };
        var totalDebit = 0, totalCredit = 0;

        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Detail Baris Jurnal: ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(refNo || '') + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Kode Akun</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">Nama Akun</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">Journal </th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Debit</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Kredit</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty-msg">Tidak ada baris jurnal.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var debit = parseFloat(r.debit) || 0;
                var credit = parseFloat(r.credit) || 0;
                totalDebit += debit;
                totalCredit += credit;

                html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.account_code || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.account_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.description || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:bold;">' + (debit ? fmtAmt(debit) : '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#f87171; font-weight:bold;">' + (credit ? fmtAmt(credit) : '-') + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }

        html += '</tbody>' +
                '<tfoot>' +
                '<tr class="total-row">' +
                '<td colspan="3" align="right" class="total-label">TOTAL:</td>' +
                '<td align="right" style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtAmt(totalDebit) + '</td>' +
                '<td align="right" style="color:#f87171; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtAmt(totalCredit) + '</td>' +
                '</tr>' +
                '</tfoot>' +
                '</table>';

        journalDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

    function toggleEditViewButtons() {
        var editBtn = document.getElementById('editData');
        var viewBtn = document.getElementById('viewData');
        if (!dataRecord) return;
        var isDraft = dataRecord.status === 'draft';
        if (editBtn) editBtn.style.display = isDraft ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (viewBtn) viewBtn.style.display = isDraft ? 'none' : 'block';
    }

    function setLineEditable(editable) {
        var cm = lineGrid.getColumnModel();
        for (var i = 0; i < cm.getColumnCount(); i++) {
            if (cm.isHidden(i)) continue;
            cm.setEditable(i, editable);
        }
        var addBtn = document.getElementById('btnAddLine');
        if (addBtn) addBtn.style.display = editable ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
        var saveBtn = document.getElementById('saveEdit');
        if (saveBtn) saveBtn.style.display = editable ? 'block' : 'none';
        fldDate.setDisabled(!editable);
        fldPeriod.setDisabled(!editable);
        fldDesc.setDisabled(!editable);
    }

    function togglePostButton() {
        var btn = document.getElementById('postData');
        if (!btn || !dataRecord) return;
        if (dataRecord.status === 'draft') {
            btn.style.display = 'block';
            btn.innerHTML = '<t>Post</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">lock</i>';
        } else if (dataRecord.status === 'posted') {
            btn.style.display = 'block';
            btn.innerHTML = '<t>Reverse</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">undo</i>';
        } else {
            btn.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Line Grid Editor (Form Dialog)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var lineDeleter = new Extensive.grid.ItemDeleter();

    var lineGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: lineGridDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 220,
        selModel: lineDeleter,
        columns: [
            {
                header: 'Akun', dataIndex: 'account_id', width: 220,
                editor: new myComboField({ store: coaDs, displayField: 'account_name', valueField: 'id' }),
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    return record.get('account_code') ? (record.get('account_code') + ' - ' + record.get('account_name')) : '';
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Debit', dataIndex: 'debit', width: 110, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return v ? Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0,000.00') : ''; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Kredit', dataIndex: 'credit', width: 110, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return v ? Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0,000.00') : ''; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Keterangan', dataIndex: 'description', width: 180,
                editor: new myTextField({}), renderer: CellWrap
            },
            lineDeleter
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'account_id') {
                    var rec = coaDs.getById(e.value);
                    if (rec) {
                        e.record.set('account_code', rec.get('account_code'));
                        e.record.set('account_name', rec.get('account_name'));
                    }
                }
                updateTotals();
            }
        }
    });
    lineGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    document.getElementById('btnAddLine') && (document.getElementById('btnAddLine').onclick = function () {
        lineGridDs.add(new addLineRow({ account_id: null, debit: 0, credit: 0, description: '' }));
    });

    function updateTotals() {
        var totalDebit = 0, totalCredit = 0;
        lineGridDs.each(function (r) {
            totalDebit += parseFloat(r.get('debit')) || 0;
            totalCredit += parseFloat(r.get('credit')) || 0;
        });
        var debitEl = document.getElementById('lblTotalDebit');
        var creditEl = document.getElementById('lblTotalCredit');
        var balanceEl = document.getElementById('lblBalanceStatus');
        if (debitEl) debitEl.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(totalDebit, '0,000.00');
        if (creditEl) creditEl.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(totalCredit, '0,000.00');
        if (balanceEl) {
            var isBalance = Math.abs(totalDebit - totalCredit) < 0.01;
            balanceEl.innerHTML = isBalance ? 'BALANCE' : 'TIDAK BALANCE';
            balanceEl.style.color = isBalance ? '#2e9e4f' : '#c0392b';
        }
    }
    lineGridDs.on('update', updateTotals);
    lineGridDs.on('add', updateTotals);
    lineGridDs.on('remove', updateTotals);
    lineGridDs.on('load', updateTotals);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Editor Form
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fldJournalNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Jurnal', id: 'ref_no', name: 'ref_no', readOnly: true, emptyText: 'Auto-generate' });
    var fldDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal', id: 'journal_date', name: 'journal_date', allowBlank: false, value: new Date() });
    var fldPeriod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Periode', id: 'period_id', name: 'period_id', hiddenName: 'period_id',
        store: periodDs, displayField: 'period_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldDesc = new myTextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Keterangan', id: 'description', name: 'description' });
    var fldId = new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 100,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldJournalNo },
            { items: fldDate },
            { items: fldPeriod },
            { columnWidth: 1, items: fldDesc },
            { items: fldId }
        ]
    });
    frmEditor.on('clientvalidation', function (f, valid) { if (!valid) { saveEditDisable(); } else { saveEditEnable(); } });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        if (getFormAccess() == 2 || getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'create';
            lineGridDs.removeAll();
            lineGridDs.add(new addLineRow({ account_id: null, debit: 0, credit: 0, description: '' }));
            lineGridDs.add(new addLineRow({ account_id: null, debit: 0, credit: 0, description: '' }));
            updateTotals();
            setLineEditable(true);
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Tambah Jurnal';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'draft') {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya jurnal berstatus Draft yang boleh diedit. Gunakan tombol View untuk melihat detail.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            task = 'update';
            frmEditor.getForm().load({ url: '../php-crud/journal.entryCRD.php', params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' } });
            lineGridDs.load({ params: { id: dataRecord.id } });
            setLineEditable(true);
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Jurnal';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    var viewBtn = document.getElementById('viewData');
    if (viewBtn) {
        viewBtn.onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            task = '';
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            frmEditor.getForm().load({ url: '../php-crud/journal.entryCRD.php', params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' } });
            lineGridDs.load({ params: { id: dataRecord.id } });
            setLineEditable(false);
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Detail Jurnal (' + dataRecord.status.toUpperCase() + ') - Read Only';
        };
    }

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'draft') {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya jurnal berstatus Draft yang boleh dihapus.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'delete';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hapus jurnal \'' + dataRecord.ref_no + '\' ?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus data.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    var postBtn = document.getElementById('postData');
    if (postBtn) {
        postBtn.onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih jurnal terlebih dahulu.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            if (dataRecord.status === 'draft') {
                task = 'post';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Post jurnal \'' + dataRecord.ref_no + '\'? Setelah di-post, jurnal tidak bisa diedit/dihapus lagi.';
            } else if (dataRecord.status === 'posted') {
                task = 'reverse';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Reverse jurnal \'' + dataRecord.ref_no + '\'? Ini akan membuat jurnal koreksi baru dengan debit/kredit dibalik.';
            }
        };
    }

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function (event) {
        window.open("../pdf/journal.php", 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        var totalDebit = 0, totalCredit = 0;
        var arrLines = [];
        lineGridDs.each(function (r) {
            var acc = r.get('account_id');
            var debit = parseFloat(r.get('debit')) || 0;
            var credit = parseFloat(r.get('credit')) || 0;
            if (!acc || (debit === 0 && credit === 0)) return;
            totalDebit += debit;
            totalCredit += credit;
            arrLines.push({ account_id: acc, debit: debit, credit: credit, description: r.get('description') });
        });

        if (arrLines.length < 2) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Jurnal minimal harus punya 2 baris (debit & kredit).';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (Math.abs(totalDebit - totalCredit) > 0.01) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Jurnal tidak balance! Total Debit: ' + totalDebit.toFixed(2) + ', Total Kredit: ' + totalCredit.toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }

        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/journal.entryCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: task, arrLines: JSON.stringify(arrLines) },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                lineGridDs.removeAll();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message || 'Gagal menyimpan jurnal.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

/* Document      : purchaseinvoice.js
