## File: ./views/dashboard03.php
----------------------------------------
<?php
/*
    Document        : views/dashboard.php
    Description     : Integrated Monitoring Dashboard (Material, Budget & Financial Control)
*/

if (!isset($_SESSION)) { 
    session_start(); 
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

// Security Check
if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || is_null($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    header('Location: ../index.php');
    exit;
}

$db = new crud();
$user_id = $_SESSION["user_id"] ?? 0;

function toRoman($num) {
    $romans = ['', 'I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII', 'VIII', 'IX', 'X', 'XI', 'XII', 'XIII', 'XIV', 'XV'];
    $num = intval($num);
    return isset($romans[$num]) ? $romans[$num] : $num;
}

// 1. FETCH MENU (DYNAMIC ACCESS MENU)
$mainMenus = [];
try {
    $hsql = "
      SELECT id, name, seq
      FROM m_form_group
      WHERE active = true AND substring(seq,3,2)='00'
        AND substring(seq,1,2) IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT substring(g.seq,1,2) seqn
          FROM m_form_group g
          LEFT JOIN m_form_name f ON g.id = f.group_id
          LEFT JOIN m_user_access_menu u ON u.form_id = f.id
          WHERE g.active = true AND u.user_id = :user_id
          GROUP BY substring(g.seq,1,2)
      )
      ORDER BY seq::int
    ";
    $stmt = $db->prepare($hsql);
    $stmt->execute(['user_id' => $user_id]);
    $mainMenus = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
} catch (Exception $e) {
    $mainMenus = [];
}

// 2. FETCH PROYEK
$projectsList = [];
try {
    $pStmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id, name AS project_name FROM projects ORDER BY name ASC");
    $pStmt->execute();
    $projectsList = $pStmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
} catch (Exception $e) {
    $projectsList = [];
}

$selected_project_id = isset($_GET['project_id']) ? intval($_GET['project_id']) : 0;
if ($selected_project_id === 0 && !empty($projectsList)) {
    $selected_project_id = $projectsList[0]['id'];
}

// 3. FETCH MONITORING DATA (MATERIAL OUT & BUDGET - DINAMIS DB)
$kpiData = ['budget_rab' => 0, 'material_out' => 0, 'sisa_budget' => 0, 'persentase' => 0];
$tableItems = [];
$penyerapanStatusCount = ['On Track' => 0, 'Warning' => 0];

if ($selected_project_id > 0) {
    try {
        $sql = "
            SELECT 
                material_code AS item_code,
                material_name AS item_name,
                unit AS unit_measurement,
                budget_qty,
                total_qty_out AS out_qty,
                remaining_qty,
                usage_pct,
                status
            FROM v_material_budget_monitoring
            WHERE project_id = :prj_id
            ORDER BY material_name ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['prj_id' => $selected_project_id]);
        $tableItems = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        foreach ($tableItems as $row) {
            $kpiData['budget_rab']   += (float)$row['budget_qty'];
            $kpiData['material_out'] += (float)$row['out_qty'];

            if ($row['status'] === 'WARNING' || $row['status'] === 'OVERBUDGET') {
                $penyerapanStatusCount['Warning']++;
            } else {
                $penyerapanStatusCount['On Track']++;
            }
        }

        $kpiData['sisa_budget'] = $kpiData['budget_rab'] - $kpiData['material_out'];
        if ($kpiData['budget_rab'] > 0) {
            $kpiData['persentase'] = round(($kpiData['material_out'] / $kpiData['budget_rab']) * 100, 2);
        }
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $tableItems = [];
    }
}

// Hitung Persentase Status untuk Donut Chart
$totalStatusItems = array_sum($penyerapanStatusCount);
$pctOnTrack = $totalStatusItems > 0 ? round(($penyerapanStatusCount['On Track'] / $totalStatusItems) * 100) : 0;
$pctWarning = $totalStatusItems > 0 ? round(($penyerapanStatusCount['Warning'] / $totalStatusItems) * 100) : 0;

// 4. FETCH RINGKASAN FINANSIAL & RATE TERBARU DARI DB INTERNAL
$financialSummary = [
    'total_pendapatan'  => 0,
    'growth_pendapatan' => 0,
    'total_beban'       => 0,
    'total_transaksi'   => 0,
    'laba_bersih'       => 0,
    'rate_val'          => 'Rp 0',
    'rate_updated'      => '-',
    'rate_status'       => 'Gagal terhubung ke server.',
    'rate_status_cls'   => 'text-rose-400'
];

try {
    // Total Pendapatan Bulan Ini & Growth
    $stmtIncome = $db->prepare("
        SELECT 
            COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_inc,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') 
                             AND created_at < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS prev_inc
        FROM financial_incomes 
        WHERE project_id = :prj_id 
          AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
    ");
    $stmtIncome->execute(['prj_id' => $selected_project_id]);
    $incData = $stmtIncome->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if ($incData) {
        $financialSummary['total_pendapatan'] = (float)$incData['total_inc'];
        if ((float)$incData['prev_inc'] > 0) {
            $financialSummary['growth_pendapatan'] = round((($incData['total_inc'] - $incData['prev_inc']) / $incData['prev_inc']) * 100, 1);
        }
    }

    // Total Beban & Jumlah Transaksi
    $stmtExpense = $db->prepare("
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_exp, COUNT(id) AS cnt_trans 
        FROM financial_expenses 
        WHERE project_id = :prj_id 
          AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
    ");
    $stmtExpense->execute(['prj_id' => $selected_project_id]);
    $expData = $stmtExpense->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if ($expData) {
        $financialSummary['total_beban'] = (float)$expData['total_exp'];
        $financialSummary['total_transaksi'] = (int)$expData['cnt_trans'];
    }

    // Laba Bersih
    $financialSummary['laba_bersih'] = $financialSummary['total_pendapatan'] - $financialSummary['total_beban'];

    // Rate Terbaru dari DB Internal Server
    $stmtRate = $db->prepare("
        SELECT rate_val, updated_at 
        FROM m_currency_rate 
        WHERE active = true 
        ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ");
    $stmtRate->execute();
    $rateData = $stmtRate->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    if ($rateData && isset($rateData['rate_val'])) {
        $financialSummary['rate_val']        = "Rp " . number_format($rateData['rate_val'], 0, ',', '.');
        $financialSummary['rate_updated']    = date('d/m/Y H:i', strtotime($rateData['updated_at']));
        $financialSummary['rate_status']     = "● Internal DB Server Connected";
        $financialSummary['rate_status_cls'] = "text-emerald-400";
    } else {
        $financialSummary['rate_status']     = "Data rate tidak ditemukan di database.";
        $financialSummary['rate_status_cls'] = "text-amber-400";
    }

} catch (Exception $e) {
    $financialSummary['rate_status']     = "Gagal terhubung ke server database.";
    $financialSummary['rate_status_cls'] = "text-rose-400";
}
?>

                        <?php

    <!-- SCRIPT JAVASCRIPT & KONFIGURASI CHART.JS   -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <script>
        // Registrasi Plugin Datalabels
        Chart.register(ChartDataLabels);

        // 1. CUSTOM PLUGIN: TEKS "OVERVIEW 100%" DI TENGAH DONUT CHART
        const doughnutCenterTextPlugin = {
            id: 'doughnutCenterText',
            beforeDraw(chart) {
                if (chart.config.type !== 'doughnut') return;
                
                const { width, height, ctx } = chart;
                ctx.save();
                
                const centerX = width / 2;
                const centerY = height / 2;

                // Teks OVERVIEW
                ctx.font = 'bold 12px Rajdhani, sans-serif';
                ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText('OVERVIEW', centerX, centerY - 10);

                // Teks 100%
                ctx.font = 'bold 20px Rajdhani, sans-serif';
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                ctx.fillText('100%', centerX, centerY + 12);

                ctx.restore();
            }
        };

        // 2. DONUT CHART: STATUS PENYERAPAN
        const ctxStatus = document.getElementById('chartStatusPenyerapan').getContext('2d');
        new Chart(ctxStatus, {
            type: 'doughnut',
            data: {
                labels: ['On Track', 'Warning'],
                datasets: [{
                    data: [<?= $pctOnTrack ?: 33; ?>, <?= $pctWarning ?: 67; ?>],
                    backgroundColor: [
                        '#0ea5e9', // Blue / On Track
                        '#a855f7'  // Purple / Warning
                    ],
                    borderWidth: 2,
                    borderColor: '#081624',
                    hoverOffset: 4
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                cutout: '65%',
                plugins: {
                    legend: { display: false },
                    tooltip: {
                        enabled: true,
                        callbacks: {
                            label: function(context) {
                                return ` ${context.label}: ${context.raw}%`;
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    datalabels: {
                        color: '#ffffff',
                        font: { family: 'Rajdhani', weight: 'bold', size: 12 },
                        formatter: (value) => value + '%'
                    }
                }
            },
            plugins: [doughnutCenterTextPlugin]
        });

        // 3. LINE CHART: FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE (PENDAPATAN VS BIAYA)
        const ctxFin = document.getElementById('chartFinancialPerformance').getContext('2d');
        new Chart(ctxFin, {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'Mei', 'Jun'],
                datasets: [
                    {
                        label: 'Pendapatan',
                        data: [450, 520, 610, 580, 690, 750],
                        borderColor: '#38bdf8',
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12)',
                        fill: true,
                        tension: 0.35,
                        pointRadius: 4,
                        pointBackgroundColor: '#38bdf8'
                    },
                    {
                        label: 'Pengeluaran',

## File: ./views/dashboard02.php

<?php
/*
    Document        : views/dashboard.php
    Description     : Integrated Monitoring Dashboard (Material, Budget & Financial Control)
*/

if (!isset($_SESSION)) { 
    session_start(); 
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

// Security Check
if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || is_null($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    header('Location: ../index.php');
    exit;
}

$db = new crud();
$user_id = $_SESSION["user_id"] ?? 0;

function toRoman($num) {
    $romans = ['', 'I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII', 'VIII', 'IX', 'X', 'XI', 'XII', 'XIII', 'XIV', 'XV'];
    $num = intval($num);
    return isset($romans[$num]) ? $romans[$num] : $num;
}

// 1. FETCH MENU (DYNAMIC ACCESS MENU)
$mainMenus = [];
try {
    $hsql = "
      SELECT id, name, seq
      FROM m_form_group
      WHERE active = true AND substring(seq,3,2)='00'
        AND substring(seq,1,2) IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT substring(g.seq,1,2) seqn
          FROM m_form_group g
          LEFT JOIN m_form_name f ON g.id = f.group_id
          LEFT JOIN m_user_access_menu u ON u.form_id = f.id
          WHERE g.active = true AND u.user_id = :user_id
          GROUP BY substring(g.seq,1,2)
      )
      ORDER BY seq::int
    ";
    $stmt = $db->prepare($hsql);
    $stmt->execute(['user_id' => $user_id]);
    $mainMenus = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
} catch (Exception $e) {
    $mainMenus = [];
}

// 2. FETCH PROYEK
$projectsList = [];
try {
    $pStmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id, name AS project_name FROM projects ORDER BY name ASC");
    $pStmt->execute();
    $projectsList = $pStmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
} catch (Exception $e) {
    $projectsList = [];
}

$selected_project_id = isset($_GET['project_id']) ? intval($_GET['project_id']) : 0;
if ($selected_project_id === 0 && !empty($projectsList)) {
    $selected_project_id = $projectsList[0]['id'];
}

// 3. FETCH MONITORING DATA (MATERIAL OUT & BUDGET - DINAMIS DB)
$kpiData = ['budget_rab' => 0, 'material_out' => 0, 'sisa_budget' => 0, 'persentase' => 0];
$tableItems = [];
$penyerapanStatusCount = ['On Track' => 0, 'Warning' => 0, 'Overbudget' => 0];

if ($selected_project_id > 0) {
    try {
        $sql = "
            SELECT 
                material_code AS item_code,
                material_name AS item_name,
                unit AS unit_measurement,
                budget_qty,
                total_qty_out AS out_qty,
                remaining_qty,
                usage_pct,
                status
            FROM v_material_budget_monitoring
            WHERE project_id = :prj_id
            ORDER BY material_name ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['prj_id' => $selected_project_id]);
        $tableItems = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        foreach ($tableItems as $row) {
            $kpiData['budget_rab']   += (float)$row['budget_qty'];
            $kpiData['material_out'] += (float)$row['out_qty'];

            $st = strtoupper($row['status']);
            if ($st === 'OVERBUDGET') {
                $penyerapanStatusCount['Overbudget']++;
            } elseif ($st === 'WARNING') {
                $penyerapanStatusCount['Warning']++;
            } else {
                $penyerapanStatusCount['On Track']++;
            }
        }

        $kpiData['sisa_budget'] = $kpiData['budget_rab'] - $kpiData['material_out'];
        if ($kpiData['budget_rab'] > 0) {
            $kpiData['persentase'] = round(($kpiData['material_out'] / $kpiData['budget_rab']) * 100, 2);
        }
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $tableItems = [];
    }
}

// Prepare Data JSON untuk Chart.js (Material Out)
$chartLabels = [];
$chartBudget = [];
$chartOut    = [];
foreach ($tableItems as $item) {
    $chartLabels[] = $item['item_name'];
    $chartBudget[] = (float)$item['budget_qty'];
    $chartOut[]    = (float)$item['out_qty'];
}

// 4. FETCH RINGKASAN FINANSIAL & RATE TERBARU DARI DB INTERNAL
$financialSummary = [
    'total_pendapatan'  => 0,
    'growth_pendapatan' => 0,
    'total_beban'       => 0,
    'total_transaksi'   => 0,
    'laba_bersih'       => 0,
    'rate_val'          => 'Rp 0',
    'rate_updated'      => '-',
    'rate_status'       => 'Gagal terhubung ke server.',
    'rate_status_cls'   => 'text-rose-400'
];

try {
    // Total Pendapatan Bulan Ini & Growth
    $stmtIncome = $db->prepare("
        SELECT 
            COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_inc,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') 
                             AND created_at < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS prev_inc
        FROM financial_incomes 
        WHERE project_id = :prj_id 
          AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
    ");
    $stmtIncome->execute(['prj_id' => $selected_project_id]);
    $incData = $stmtIncome->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if ($incData) {
        $financialSummary['total_pendapatan'] = (float)$incData['total_inc'];
        if ((float)$incData['prev_inc'] > 0) {
            $financialSummary['growth_pendapatan'] = round((($incData['total_inc'] - $incData['prev_inc']) / $incData['prev_inc']) * 100, 1);
        }
    }

    // Total Beban & Jumlah Transaksi
    $stmtExpense = $db->prepare("
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_exp, COUNT(id) AS cnt_trans 
        FROM financial_expenses 
        WHERE project_id = :prj_id 
          AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
    ");
    $stmtExpense->execute(['prj_id' => $selected_project_id]);
    $expData = $stmtExpense->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if ($expData) {
        $financialSummary['total_beban'] = (float)$expData['total_exp'];
        $financialSummary['total_transaksi'] = (int)$expData['cnt_trans'];
    }

    // Laba Bersih
    $financialSummary['laba_bersih'] = $financialSummary['total_pendapatan'] - $financialSummary['total_beban'];

    // Rate Terbaru
    $stmtRate = $db->prepare("
        SELECT rate_val, updated_at 
        FROM m_currency_rate 
        WHERE active = true 
        ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ");
    $stmtRate->execute();
    $rateData = $stmtRate->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    if ($rateData && isset($rateData['rate_val'])) {
        $financialSummary['rate_val']        = "Rp " . number_format($rateData['rate_val'], 2, ',', '.');
        $financialSummary['rate_updated']    = date('d/m/Y H:i', strtotime($rateData['updated_at']));
        $financialSummary['rate_status']     = "● Internal DB Server Connected";
        $financialSummary['rate_status_cls'] = "text-emerald-400";
    } else {
        $financialSummary['rate_status']     = "Data rate tidak ditemukan di database.";
        $financialSummary['rate_status_cls'] = "text-amber-400";
    }

} catch (Exception $e) {
    $financialSummary['rate_status']     = "Gagal terhubung ke server database.";
    $financialSummary['rate_status_cls'] = "text-rose-400";
}

// 5. FETCH TREND PERFORMA KEUANGAN 5 BULAN TERAKHIR (PENDAPATAN VS BIAYA)
$financialTrend = [
    'months' => ['Mei', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Agu', 'Sep'],
    'invoicing' => [350, 420, 580, 610, 770], // Satuan Juta (Contoh Fallback/Sample DB)
    'expenses' => [280, 310, 400, 450, 500],
    'margin_pct' => 24.5
];

try {
    $stmtTrend = $db->prepare("
        SELECT 
            to_char(m.month, 'Mon') AS month_name,
            COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) / 1000000 AS total_inc,
            COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) / 1000000 AS total_exp
        FROM generate_series(
            date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '4 months'), 
            date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE), 
            '1 month'::interval
        ) AS m(month)
        LEFT JOIN financial_incomes i ON date_trunc('month', i.created_at) = m.month AND i.project_id = :prj1
        LEFT JOIN financial_expenses e ON date_trunc('month', e.created_at) = m.month AND e.project_id = :prj2
        GROUP BY m.month
        ORDER BY m.month ASC
    ");
    $stmtTrend->execute(['prj1' => $selected_project_id, 'prj2' => $selected_project_id]);
    $trendRows = $stmtTrend->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    if (!empty($trendRows) && count($trendRows) >= 3) {
        $financialTrend['months'] = [];
        $financialTrend['invoicing'] = [];
        $financialTrend['expenses'] = [];
        $lastInc = 0;
        $lastExp = 0;

        foreach ($trendRows as $tr) {
            $financialTrend['months'][] = $tr['month_name'];
            $financialTrend['invoicing'][] = (float)$tr['total_inc'];
            $financialTrend['expenses'][] = (float)$tr['total_exp'];
            $lastInc = (float)$tr['total_inc'];
            $lastExp = (float)$tr['total_exp'];
        }

        if ($lastInc > 0) {
            $financialTrend['margin_pct'] = round((($lastInc - $lastExp) / $lastInc) * 100, 1);
        }
    }
} catch (Exception $e) {
    // Fallback ke data visual
}

## File: ./views/dashboard01.php

<?php
/*
    Document        : views/dashboard.php
    Description     : Integrated Monitoring Dashboard (Material, Budget & Financial Control)
*/

if (!isset($_SESSION)) { 
    session_start(); 
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

// Security Check
if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || is_null($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    header('Location: ../index.php');
    exit;
}

$db = new crud();
$user_id = $_SESSION["user_id"] ?? 0;

function toRoman($num) {
    $romans = ['', 'I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII', 'VIII', 'IX', 'X', 'XI', 'XII', 'XIII', 'XIV', 'XV'];
    $num = intval($num);
    return isset($romans[$num]) ? $romans[$num] : $num;
}

// 1. FETCH MENU (DYNAMIC ACCESS MENU)
$mainMenus = [];
try {
    $hsql = "
      SELECT id, name, seq
      FROM m_form_group
      WHERE active = true AND substring(seq,3,2)='00'
        AND substring(seq,1,2) IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT substring(g.seq,1,2) seqn
          FROM m_form_group g
          LEFT JOIN m_form_name f ON g.id = f.group_id
          LEFT JOIN m_user_access_menu u ON u.form_id = f.id
          WHERE g.active = true AND u.user_id = :user_id
          GROUP BY substring(g.seq,1,2)
      )
      ORDER BY seq::int
    ";
    $stmt = $db->prepare($hsql);
    $stmt->execute(['user_id' => $user_id]);
    $mainMenus = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
} catch (Exception $e) {
    $mainMenus = [];
}

// 2. FETCH PROYEK
$projectsList = [];
try {
    $pStmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id, name AS project_name FROM projects ORDER BY name ASC");
    $pStmt->execute();
    $projectsList = $pStmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
} catch (Exception $e) {
    $projectsList = [];
}

$selected_project_id = isset($_GET['project_id']) ? intval($_GET['project_id']) : 0;
if ($selected_project_id === 0 && !empty($projectsList)) {
    $selected_project_id = $projectsList[0]['id'];
}

// 3. FETCH MONITORING DATA (MATERIAL OUT & BUDGET - DINAMIS DB)
$kpiData = ['budget_rab' => 0, 'material_out' => 0, 'sisa_budget' => 0, 'persentase' => 0];
$tableItems = [];
$penyerapanStatusCount = ['On Track' => 0, 'Warning' => 0];

if ($selected_project_id > 0) {
    try {
        $sql = "
            SELECT 
                material_code AS item_code,
                material_name AS item_name,
                unit AS unit_measurement,
                budget_qty,
                total_qty_out AS out_qty,
                remaining_qty,
                usage_pct,
                status
            FROM v_material_budget_monitoring
            WHERE project_id = :prj_id
            ORDER BY material_name ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['prj_id' => $selected_project_id]);
        $tableItems = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        foreach ($tableItems as $row) {
            $kpiData['budget_rab']   += (float)$row['budget_qty'];
            $kpiData['material_out'] += (float)$row['out_qty'];

            if ($row['status'] === 'WARNING' || $row['status'] === 'OVERBUDGET') {
                $penyerapanStatusCount['Warning']++;
            } else {
                $penyerapanStatusCount['On Track']++;
            }
        }

        $kpiData['sisa_budget'] = $kpiData['budget_rab'] - $kpiData['material_out'];
        if ($kpiData['budget_rab'] > 0) {
            $kpiData['persentase'] = round(($kpiData['material_out'] / $kpiData['budget_rab']) * 100, 2);
        }
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $tableItems = [];
    }
}

// 4. FETCH RINGKASAN FINANSIAL & RATE TERBARU DARI DB INTERNAL
$financialSummary = [
    'total_pendapatan'  => 0,
    'growth_pendapatan' => 0,
    'total_beban'       => 0,
    'total_transaksi'   => 0,
    'laba_bersih'       => 0,
    'rate_val'          => 'Rp 0',
    'rate_updated'      => '-',
    'rate_status'       => 'Gagal terhubung ke server.',
    'rate_status_cls'   => 'text-rose-400'
];

try {
    // Total Pendapatan Bulan Ini & Growth
    $stmtIncome = $db->prepare("
        SELECT 
            COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_inc,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') 
                             AND created_at < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS prev_inc
        FROM financial_incomes 
        WHERE project_id = :prj_id 
          AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
    ");
    $stmtIncome->execute(['prj_id' => $selected_project_id]);
    $incData = $stmtIncome->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if ($incData) {
        $financialSummary['total_pendapatan'] = (float)$incData['total_inc'];
        if ((float)$incData['prev_inc'] > 0) {
            $financialSummary['growth_pendapatan'] = round((($incData['total_inc'] - $incData['prev_inc']) / $incData['prev_inc']) * 100, 1);
        }
    }

    // Total Beban & Jumlah Transaksi
    $stmtExpense = $db->prepare("
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_exp, COUNT(id) AS cnt_trans 
        FROM financial_expenses 
        WHERE project_id = :prj_id 
          AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
    ");
    $stmtExpense->execute(['prj_id' => $selected_project_id]);
    $expData = $stmtExpense->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if ($expData) {
        $financialSummary['total_beban'] = (float)$expData['total_exp'];
        $financialSummary['total_transaksi'] = (int)$expData['cnt_trans'];
    }

    // Laba Bersih
    $financialSummary['laba_bersih'] = $financialSummary['total_pendapatan'] - $financialSummary['total_beban'];

    // Rate Terbaru dari DB Internal Server
    $stmtRate = $db->prepare("
        SELECT rate_val, updated_at 
        FROM m_currency_rate 
        WHERE active = true 
        ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ");
    $stmtRate->execute();
    $rateData = $stmtRate->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    if ($rateData && isset($rateData['rate_val'])) {
        $financialSummary['rate_val']        = "Rp " . number_format($rateData['rate_val'], 0, ',', '.');
        $financialSummary['rate_updated']    = date('d/m/Y H:i', strtotime($rateData['updated_at']));
        $financialSummary['rate_status']     = "● Internal DB Server Connected";
        $financialSummary['rate_status_cls'] = "text-emerald-400";
    } else {
        $financialSummary['rate_status']     = "Data rate tidak ditemukan di database.";
        $financialSummary['rate_status_cls'] = "text-amber-400";
    }

} catch (Exception $e) {
    $financialSummary['rate_status']     = "Gagal terhubung ke server database.";
    $financialSummary['rate_status_cls'] = "text-rose-400";
}

## File: ./views/dashboard.php
----------------------------------------
<?php
/*
    Document        : views/dashboard.php
    Description     : Integrated Monitoring Dashboard (Material, Budget & Financial Control)
*/

if (!isset($_SESSION)) { 
    session_start(); 
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

// Security Check
if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || is_null($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    header('Location: ../index.php');
    exit;
}

$db = new crud();
$user_id = $_SESSION["user_id"] ?? 0;

function toRoman($num) {
    $romans = ['', 'I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII', 'VIII', 'IX', 'X', 'XI', 'XII', 'XIII', 'XIV', 'XV'];
    $num = intval($num);
    return isset($romans[$num]) ? $romans[$num] : $num;
}

// 1. FETCH MENU UTAMA DINAMIS
$mainMenus = [];
try {
    $hsql = "
      SELECT id, name, seq
      FROM m_form_group
      WHERE active = true AND substring(seq,3,2)='00'
        AND substring(seq,1,2) IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT substring(g.seq,1,2) seqn
          FROM m_form_group g
          LEFT JOIN m_form_name f ON g.id = f.group_id
          LEFT JOIN m_user_access_menu u ON u.form_id = f.id
          WHERE g.active = true AND u.user_id = :user_id
          GROUP BY substring(g.seq,1,2)
      )
      ORDER BY seq::int
    ";
    $stmt = $db->prepare($hsql);
    $stmt->execute(['user_id' => $user_id]);
    $mainMenus = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
} catch (Exception $e) {
    $mainMenus = [];
}

// 2. FETCH PROYEK
$projectsList = [];
try {
    $pStmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id, name AS project_name FROM projects ORDER BY name ASC");
    $pStmt->execute();
    $projectsList = $pStmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
} catch (Exception $e) {
    $projectsList = [];
}

$selected_project_id = isset($_GET['project_id']) ? intval($_GET['project_id']) : 0;
if ($selected_project_id === 0 && !empty($projectsList)) {
    $selected_project_id = $projectsList[0]['id'];
}

// 3. FETCH MONITORING MATERIAL & BUDGET
$kpiData = ['budget_rab' => 0, 'material_out' => 0, 'sisa_budget' => 0, 'persentase' => 0];
$tableItems = [];
$penyerapanStatusCount = ['On Track' => 0, 'Warning' => 0, 'Overbudget' => 0];

if ($selected_project_id > 0) {
    try {
        $sql = "
            SELECT 
                material_code AS item_code,
                material_name AS item_name,
                unit AS unit_measurement,
                budget_qty,
                total_qty_out AS out_qty,
                remaining_qty,
                usage_pct,
                status
            FROM v_material_budget_monitoring
            WHERE project_id = :prj_id
            ORDER BY material_name ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['prj_id' => $selected_project_id]);
        $tableItems = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        foreach ($tableItems as $row) {
            $kpiData['budget_rab']   += (float)$row['budget_qty'];
            $kpiData['material_out'] += (float)$row['out_qty'];

            $st = strtoupper($row['status']);
            if ($st === 'OVERBUDGET') {
                $penyerapanStatusCount['Overbudget']++;
            } elseif ($st === 'WARNING') {
                $penyerapanStatusCount['Warning']++;
            } else {
                $penyerapanStatusCount['On Track']++;
            }
        }

        $kpiData['sisa_budget'] = $kpiData['budget_rab'] - $kpiData['material_out'];
        if ($kpiData['budget_rab'] > 0) {
            $kpiData['persentase'] = round(($kpiData['material_out'] / $kpiData['budget_rab']) * 100, 2);
        }
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $tableItems = [];
    }
}

// Persentase Status Donut Chart
$totalStatusItems = array_sum($penyerapanStatusCount);
$pctOnTrack   = $totalStatusItems > 0 ? round(($penyerapanStatusCount['On Track'] / $totalStatusItems) * 100) : 0;
$pctWarning   = $totalStatusItems > 0 ? round(($penyerapanStatusCount['Warning'] / $totalStatusItems) * 100) : 0;
$pctOverbudget = $totalStatusItems > 0 ? round(($penyerapanStatusCount['Overbudget'] / $totalStatusItems) * 100) : 0;

// 4. FETCH FINANCIAL SUMMARY & RATE USD TERBARU (JOIN HEADER & DETAIL)
$financialSummary = [
    'total_pendapatan'  => 0,
    'total_beban'       => 0,
    'total_transaksi'   => 0,
    'laba_bersih'       => 0,
    'rate_val'          => 'Rp 0',
    'rate_periode'      => '',
    'rate_status'       => 'Menghubungkan...',
    'rate_status_cls'   => 'text-rose-400'
];

try {
    // 4a. Total Pendapatan
    $stmtIncome = $db->prepare("
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_inc 
        FROM financial_incomes 
        WHERE UPPER(status) = 'PAID'
          " . ($selected_project_id > 0 ? "AND (project_id = :prj_id OR project_id IS NULL)" : "") . "
    ");
    $paramsInc = $selected_project_id > 0 ? ['prj_id' => $selected_project_id] : [];
    $stmtIncome->execute($paramsInc);
    $incData = $stmtIncome->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if ($incData) {
        $financialSummary['total_pendapatan'] = (float)$incData['total_inc'];
    }

    // 4b. Total Beban
    $stmtExpense = $db->prepare("
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_exp, COUNT(id) AS cnt_exp 
        FROM financial_expenses 
        WHERE UPPER(status) = 'PAID'
          " . ($selected_project_id > 0 ? "AND (project_id = :prj_id OR project_id IS NULL)" : "") . "
    ");
    $paramsExp = $selected_project_id > 0 ? ['prj_id' => $selected_project_id] : [];
    $stmtExpense->execute($paramsExp);
    $expData = $stmtExpense->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if ($expData) {
        $financialSummary['total_beban'] = (float)$expData['total_exp'];
        $financialSummary['total_transaksi'] = (int)$expData['cnt_exp'];
    }

    // 4c. Laba Bersih
    $financialSummary['laba_bersih'] = $financialSummary['total_pendapatan'] - $financialSummary['total_beban'];

    // 4d. Kurs USD Terbaru dari JOIN tax_exchange_rate_hdr & tax_exchange_rate_dtl
    $stmtRate = $db->prepare("
        SELECT 
            d.rate AS rate_value,
            h.start_date,
            h.end_date,
            h.kmk_no AS kmk_number
        FROM tax_exchange_rate_dtl d
        INNER JOIN tax_exchange_rate_hdr h ON d.hdr_id = h.id
        WHERE UPPER(d.currency_code) = 'USD'
        ORDER BY h.start_date DESC, h.id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ");
    $stmtRate->execute();
    $rateData = $stmtRate->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    if ($rateData && isset($rateData['rate_value']) && floatval($rateData['rate_value']) > 0) {
        $rateValue = floatval($rateData['rate_value']);
        
        $startDate = !empty($rateData['start_date']) ? date('d/m/Y', strtotime($rateData['start_date'])) : '';
        $endDate   = !empty($rateData['end_date'])   ? date('d/m/Y', strtotime($rateData['end_date']))   : '';

        if (!empty($startDate) && !empty($endDate)) {
            $financialSummary['rate_periode'] = "({$startDate} - {$endDate})";
        } elseif (!empty($startDate)) {
            $financialSummary['rate_periode'] = "({$startDate})";
        }

        $financialSummary['rate_val']        = "Rp " . number_format($rateValue, 2, ',', '.');
        $financialSummary['rate_status']     = "● USD Rate Connected";
        $financialSummary['rate_status_cls'] = "text-emerald-400";
    } else {
        $financialSummary['rate_val']        = "Rp 0";
        $financialSummary['rate_status']     = "Data Kurs USD KMK belum diinput.";
        $financialSummary['rate_status_cls'] = "text-amber-400";
    }

} catch (Exception $e) {
    $financialSummary['rate_val']        = "Rp 0";
    $financialSummary['rate_status']     = "Gagal terhubung ke server database.";
    $financialSummary['rate_status_cls'] = "text-rose-400";
}

// 5. FETCH TREN KEUANGAN BULANAN (PERFORMA KEUANGAN JAN - DES)
$monthlyLabels = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'Mei', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Agu', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Des'];
$monthlyIncomeData  = array_fill(0, 12, 0);
$monthlyExpenseData = array_fill(0, 12, 0);

try {
    $sqlInc = "
        SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at) AS mth, SUM(amount) AS total 
        FROM financial_incomes 
        WHERE UPPER(status) = 'PAID' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
        GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at)
    ";
    foreach ($db->query($sqlInc) as $row) {
        $idx = (int)$row['mth'] - 1;
        if ($idx >= 0 && $idx < 12) $monthlyIncomeData[$idx] = (float)$row['total'];
    }

    $sqlExp = "
        SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at) AS mth, SUM(amount) AS total 
        FROM financial_expenses 
        WHERE UPPER(status) = 'PAID' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
        GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at)
    ";
    foreach ($db->query($sqlExp) as $row) {
        $idx = (int)$row['mth'] - 1;
        if ($idx >= 0 && $idx < 12) $monthlyExpenseData[$idx] = (float)$row['total'];
    }
} catch (Exception $e) {
    // Apabila query error, data tetap nol
}

<?php
session_start();
require_once('../tcpdf_new/config/lang/eng.php');
require_once('../tcpdf_new/tcpdf.php');

class MYPDF extends TCPDF {
  var $MyPDFHeaderTitle;
  var $MyPDFHeaderTable;
  var $MyPDFHeaderTableColWidth;
  var $MyPDFHeaderTableStart;
  var $MyPDFFooterWidth;
  var $MyHeaderTitlePos;
  var $MyHeaderMailPos;
  var $MyPDFPageLength;
  var $MyPDFHeaderType;

  public function setMyPDFLength($MyPDFPageLength) {$this->MyPDFPageLength = $MyPDFPageLength;}
  public function setMyPDFheader($MyPDFHeaderTitle) {$this->MyPDFHeaderTitle = $MyPDFHeaderTitle;}
  public function setMyPDFTableHeaderStart($MyPDFHeaderTableStart = 1) {
    if ($MyPDFHeaderTableStart>1) {$this->MyPDFHeaderTableStart = 1.2+$MyPDFHeaderTableStart;}
    else {$this->MyPDFHeaderTableStart = 1.2;}
  }
  public function setMyPDFTableHeader($MyPDFHeaderTable) {$this->MyPDFHeaderTable = $MyPDFHeaderTable;}
  public function setMyPDFTableHeaderColWidth($MyPDFHeaderTableColWidth) {$this->MyPDFHeaderTableColWidth = $MyPDFHeaderTableColWidth;}
  public function setMyPDFFooterWidth($MyPDFFooterWidth = 201) {
    $this->MyPDFFooterWidth = $MyPDFFooterWidth;
    $this->MyHeaderTitlePos = $MyPDFFooterWidth-74;
    $this->MyHeaderMailPos = $MyPDFFooterWidth-20;
  }
  public function setMyPDFHeaderType($MyPDFHeaderType = 'report') {$this->MyPDFHeaderType = $MyPDFHeaderType;}

  public function CreateTextBox($textval, $x = 0, $y, $width = 0, $height = 4, $border = 0, $fontname = 'helvetica', $fontsize = 10, $fontstyle = '', $align = 'L') {
    $this->SetXY($x+5, $y); // +5 = margin left
    $this->SetFont($fontname, $fontstyle, $fontsize);
    //$this->Cell($width, $height, $textval, $border, false, $align, false, '', 0,'','','T');
    //Cell( $w, $h = 0, $txt = '', $border = 0, $ln = 0, $align = '', $fill = false, $link = '', $stretch = 0, $ignore_min_height = false, $calign = 'T', $valign = 'M' )
    $this->MultiCell($width, $height, $textval, $border, $align);
    //MultiCell( $w, $h, $txt, $border = 0, $align = 'J', $fill = false, $ln = 1, $x = '', $y = '', $reseth = true, $stretch = 0, $ishtml = false, $autopadding = true, $maxh = 0, $valign = 'T', $fitcell = false )
  }

  public function Header() {
    // get the current page break margin.
    $bMargin = $this->getBreakMargin();
    // get current auto-page-break mode.
    $auto_page_break = $this->getAutoPageBreak();
    // enable auto page break.
    $this->SetAutoPageBreak($auto_page_break, $bMargin);
    $this->SetLeftMargin(5);
    $this->SetAuthor('IT Development Team');
    $this->Image('../img/kmgi_new.png',6,3,27,16);
    $this->SetLineWidth(.1);
    $this->Line(5,20,$this->MyPDFFooterWidth+5,20);

    if ($this->MyPDFHeaderType=='form') {
      $this->SetTextColor(187, 187, 187);
      $this->CreateTextBox($this->MyPDFHeaderTitle, 100, 10, 102, 10, 0 ,'times',  20, 'BI', 'R');
      $this->SetTextColor(0, 0, 0);
      $this->CreateTextBox('Kayu Multiguna Indonesia', 0, 20, 70, 0, 0, '',10 ,'BI' ,'L');
      $this->CreateTextBox('Jl. Veteran Segoromadu', 0, 24, 70, 0, 0, '',8 ,'I' ,'L');
      $this->CreateTextBox('Kel. Gending Kec. Kebomas Gresik. 61123', 0, 28, 70, 0, 0, '',8 ,'I' ,'L');
      $this->CreateTextBox('Telp : 031-3975620, Fax : 031-3975620', 0, 32, 70, 0, 0, '',8 ,'I' ,'L');
    } else {
      $this->SetLeftMargin(25);
      $this->SetY(5);
      $this->SetFont('helvetica','BI',13);
      $this->Cell(54,0,'Kayu Multiguna',0,1,'C');
      $this->SetFont('helvetica','I',11);
      $this->Cell(54,0,'multigunawood.com',0,0,'C');
      $this->Cell($this->MyHeaderTitlePos,0,$this->MyPDFHeaderTitle,0,1,'R');
      $this->SetFont('courier', '', 7);
      $this->SetFont('helvetica','I',8);
      $this->Cell($this->MyHeaderMailPos,0,'mail: sales@multigunawood.com',0,1,'R');
    }

    $this->SetLeftMargin(5);
    $this->Ln($this->MyPDFHeaderTableStart);

    $this->SetFillColor(0, 0, 0);
    $this->SetTextColor(255, 255, 255);
    $this->SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255);
    $this->SetLineWidth(0.3);
    $this->SetFont('helvetica','BI',9);
    $header = $this->MyPDFHeaderTable;
    $w = $this->MyPDFHeaderTableColWidth;
    $num_headers = count($header);
    for($i = 0; $i < $num_headers; ++$i) {$this->Cell($w[$i], 7, $header[$i], 1, 0, 'C', 1);}
    $this->Ln();
  }
  
  public function Footer() {
    if ($this->MyPDFPageLength=='half') {$this->SetY(-139);}
    else {$this->SetY(-10);}

    $this->SetFont('helvetica', 'I', 7);
    $this->Cell($this->MyPDFFooterWidth,3,'This is computer generated documents, printed by '.$_SESSION['user'].' printed date '.date("j F, Y, H : i : s"),0,1,'R');
    $this->SetFont('helvetica', 'I', 8);
    $this->Cell($this->MyPDFFooterWidth,3, 'Page '.$this->getAliasNumPage().'/'.$this->getAliasNbPages(), 0, 1, 'C');
  }
  
  public function CreateApproveBox($boxShow = false, $t1, $t2, $t3) {
    if ($boxShow==true) {
      if ($this->MyPDFPageLength=='half') {$this->SetY(-160);} else {$this->SetY(-30);}
      $this->SetFillColor(216, 212, 210);
      $this->SetTextColor(0,0,0);
      $this->SetFont('helvetica','',9);
      $this->Cell(67.5,0,$t1,1,0,'C',1);
      $this->Cell(67.5,0,$t2,1,0,'C',1);
      $this->Cell(67.5,0,$t3,1,1,'C',1);
    }
  }
}

## File: ./php-class/excelClass.php
----------------------------------------
<?php

/**
 * Simple excel writer class with no external dependencies, drop it in and have fun
 * @author Matt Nowack
 * @link https://gist.github.com/ihumanable/929039/edit
 * @license Unlicensed
 * @version 1.0
 */
class Excel {
  private $col;
  private $row;
  private $data;
  private $title;
  
  /**
   * Safely encode a string for use as a filename
   * @param string $title The title to use for the file
   * @return string The file safe title
   */
  static function filename($title) {
    $result = strtolower(trim($title));
    $result = str_replace("'", '', $result);
    $result = preg_replace('#[^a-z0-9_]+#', '-', $result);
    $result = preg_replace('#\-{2,}#', '-', $result);
    return preg_replace('#(^\-+|\-+$)#D', '', $result);
  }
  
  /**
   * Builds a new Excel Spreadsheet object
   * @return Excel The Spreadsheet
   */
  function __construct($title) {
    $this->title = $title;
    $this->col = 0;
    $this->row = 0;
    $this->data = '';
    $this->bofMarker();
  }
  
  /**
   * Transmits the proper headers to cause a download to occur and to identify the file properly
   * @return nothing
   */
  function headers() {
    header("Content-Type: application/force-download");
    header("Content-Type: application/octet-stream");
    header("Content-Type: application/download");
    header("Content-Disposition: attachment;filename=" . Excel::filename($this->title) . ".xls ");
    header("Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary ");
  }
  
  function send() {
    $this->eofMarker();
    $this->headers();
    echo $this->data;
  }
  
  /**
   * Writes the Excel Beginning of File marker
   * @see pack()
   * @return nothing
   */
  private function bofMarker() { 
    $this->data .= pack("ssssss", 0x809, 0x8, 0x0, 0x10, 0x0, 0x0);  
  }
  
  /**
   * Writes the Excel End of File marker
   * @see pack()
   * @return nothing
   */
  private function eofMarker() { 
    $this->data .= pack("ss", 0x0A, 0x00); 
  }
  
  /**
   * Moves internal cursor left by the amount specified
   * @param optional integer $amount The amount to move left by, defaults to 1
   * @return integer The current column after the move
   */
  function left($amount = 1) {
    $this->col -= $amount;
    if($this->col < 0) {
      $this->col = 0;
    }
    return $this->col;
  }
  
  /**
   * Moves internal cursor right by the amount specified
   * @param optional integer $amount The amount to move right by, defaults to 1
   * @return integer The current column after the move
   */
  function right($amount = 1) {
    $this->col += $amount;
    return $this->col;
  }
  
  /**
   * Moves internal cursor up by amount
   * @param optional integer $amount The amount to move up by, defaults to 1
   * @return integer The current row after the move
   */  
  function up($amount = 1) {
    $this->row -= $amount;
    if($this->row < 0) {
      $this->row = 0;
    }
    return $this->row;
  }
  
  /**
   * Moves internal cursor down by amount
   * @param optional integer $amount The amount to move down by, defaults to 1
   * @return integer The current row after the move
   */
  function down($amount = 1) {
    $this->row += $amount;
    return $this->row;
  }
  
  /**
   * Moves internal cursor to the top of the page, row = 0
   * @return nothing
   */
  function top() {
    $this->row = 0;
  }
  
  /**
   * Moves internal cursor all the way left, col = 0
   * @return nothing
   */
  function home() {
    $this->col = 0;
  }
  
  /**
   * Writes a number to the Excel Spreadsheet
   * @see pack()
   * @param integer $value The value to write out
   * @return nothing
   */
  function number($value) { 
    $this->data .= pack("sssss", 0x203, 14, $this->row, $this->col, 0x0); 
    $this->data .= pack("d", $value); 
  }
  
  /**
   * Writes a string (or label) to the Excel Spreadsheet
   * @see pack()
   * @param string $value The value to write out
   * @return nothing
   */
  function label($value) { 
    $length = strlen($value);
    $this->data .= pack("ssssss", 0x204, 8 + $length, $this->row, $this->col, 0x0, $length); 
    $this->data .= $value; 
  }
}

<?php
if (!isset($_SESSION)) {
    session_start();
}
date_default_timezone_set('Asia/Jakarta');

error_reporting(E_ALL & ~E_NOTICE & ~E_DEPRECATED);
$wwwdoc = $_SERVER["DOCUMENT_ROOT"];

if (file_exists("../php-func/function.all.php")) {
    include_once "../php-func/function.all.php";
}

if (!class_exists('crud')) {

  class crud extends PDO {
    private $engine;
    private $host;
    private $database;
    private $user;
    private $pass;
    private $result;

    public $status;
    public $success;
    public $message;

    public function __construct() {
      $this->engine   = 'pgsql';
      $this->host     = "127.0.0.1";
      $this->database = "proyekGMN";
      $this->user     = "postgres";
      $this->pass     = ""; // Sesuaikan password database Anda

      $dns = $this->engine . ':dbname=' . $this->database . ";port=5432;host=" . $this->host;

      try {
          parent::__construct($dns, $this->user, $this->pass);
          $this->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

          // PERBAIKAN WARNING: Gunakan SET (Session level) alih-alih SET LOCAL (Transaction level)
          $appUser = $_SESSION['login_name'] ?? $_SESSION['username'] ?? 'system';
          $this->exec("SET app.username = " . $this->quote($appUser));
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
          echo "Koneksi Gagal: " . $e->getMessage();
          exit;
      }
    }

    /**
     * Menjalankan kueri SELECT
     *
     * PERBAIKAN: sebelumnya method ini menangkap PDOException sendiri dan
     * hanya `return false`, sehingga kegagalan query (mis. kolom tidak ada,
     * tabel salah nama, dsb) jadi SENYAP kalau pemanggil tidak mengecek
     * return value-nya. Padahal koneksi PDO ini sudah di-set
     * PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION di constructor -- niatnya memang supaya error
     * langsung ketahuan. Sekarang exception dilempar ulang (rethrow) setelah
     * detailnya tetap disimpan ke $this->result/getResult() untuk kompatibilitas
     * kode lama yang membaca itu.
     */
    public function select($table, $rows = "*", $where = null, $order = null, $limit = null, $offset = null, $group = null) {
      try {
        $q = "SELECT " . $rows . " FROM " . $table;

        if ($where != null) { $q .= " WHERE " . $where; }
        if ($group != null) { $q .= " GROUP BY " . $group; }
        if ($order != null) { $q .= " ORDER BY " . $order; }
        if ($limit != null) { $q .= " LIMIT " . intval($limit); }
        if ($offset != null) { $q .= " OFFSET " . intval($offset); }

        $query = $this->prepare($q);
        $query->execute();

        $data = $query->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $output = array(
            "success"    => "true",
            "status"     => "Success",
            "totalCount" => count($data),
            "data"       => $data
        );

        $this->result = json_encode($output);
        return true;

      } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $errorResult = array(
            "success" => "false",
            "status"  => "Error",
            "message" => "Query Select Gagal: " . $e->getMessage()
        );
        $this->result = json_encode($errorResult);
        throw $e; // <-- rethrow, jangan ditelan
      }
    }

    /**
     * Menjalankan kueri INSERT
     * (lihat catatan PERBAIKAN di select() -- sama: rethrow, bukan return false)
     */
    public function insert($table, $data) {
      try {
        $keys = array_keys($data);
        $fields = implode(", ", $keys);
        $placeholders = ":" . implode(", :", $keys);

        $sql = "INSERT INTO {$table} ({$fields}) VALUES ({$placeholders})";

        $stmt = $this->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($data);

        $result["success"] = "true";
        $result["status"]  = "Success";
        $result["message"] = "Data berhasil ditambahkan.";
        $this->result      = json_encode($result);
        return true;
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $errorResult = array(
            "success" => "false",
            "status"  => "Error",
            "message" => "Query Insert Gagal (" . $table . "): " . $e->getMessage()
        );
        $this->result = json_encode($errorResult);
        throw $e; // <-- rethrow, jangan ditelan
      }
    }

    /**
     * Menjalankan kueri UPDATE secara presisi
     * (lihat catatan PERBAIKAN di select() -- sama: rethrow, bukan return false)
     */
    public function update($table, $data, $where) {
      try {
        $fields = "";
        $params = [];

        foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
            $fields .= "{$key} = :{$key}, ";

            // PERBAIKAN BOOLEAN & NULL: Penanganan eksplisit tipe data PDO
            if (is_bool($value)) {
                $params[":{$key}"] = $value ? 'true' : 'false';
            } else {
                $params[":{$key}"] = $value;
            }
        }
        $fields = rtrim($fields, ', ');

        $sql = "UPDATE {$table} SET {$fields} WHERE {$where}";

        $stmt = $this->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        $result["success"] = "true";
        $result["status"]  = "Success";
        $result["message"] = "Data berhasil diperbarui.";
        $this->result      = json_encode($result);
        return true;
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $errorResult = array(
            "success" => "false",
            "status"  => "Error",
            "message" => "Query Update Gagal (" . $table . "): " . $e->getMessage()
        );
        $this->result = json_encode($errorResult);
        throw $e; // <-- rethrow, jangan ditelan
      }
    }

    /**
     * Menjalankan kueri DELETE
     * (lihat catatan PERBAIKAN di select() -- sama: rethrow, bukan return false)
     */
    public function delete($table, $where) {
      try {
        $sql = "DELETE FROM {$table} WHERE {$where}";

        $stmt = $this->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute();

        $result["success"] = "true";
        $result["status"]  = "Success";
        $result["message"] = "Data berhasil dihapus.";
        $this->result      = json_encode($result);
        return true;
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $errorResult = array(
            "success" => "false",
            "status"  => "Error",
            "message" => "Query Delete Gagal (" . $table . "): " . $e->getMessage()
        );
        $this->result = json_encode($errorResult);
        throw $e; // <-- rethrow, jangan ditelan
      }
    }

    /**
     * Menjalankan perintah SQL bebas (DDL/DML tanpa binding)
     *
     * cmdQ() TIDAK di-rethrow seperti method di atas, karena beberapa
     * pemanggil lama sengaja memakainya untuk perintah yang boleh gagal
     * tanpa menghentikan alur (mis. DROP TABLE IF EXISTS). Kalau Anda mau
     * cmdQ() juga melempar exception saat gagal, ganti baris
     * `return $this->result;` di blok catch supaya jadi `throw $e;`.
     */
    public function cmdQ($sqlString) {
      try {
          $queryResource = $this->exec($sqlString);
          if ($queryResource !== false) {
              $this->status = "Success";
              $this->success = "true";
              $this->message = "Perintah SQL berhasil dieksekusi.";
          } else {
              $this->status = "Error";
              $this->success = "false";
              $this->message = "Query Gagal dieksekusi.";
          }
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
          $this->status = "Error";
          $this->success = "false";
          $this->message = "Exception: " . $e->getMessage();
      }

      $this->result = json_encode(array(
          "success" => $this->success ?? "false",
          "status"  => $this->status ?? "Error",
          "message" => $this->message ?? "Unknown error"
      ));
      return $this->result;
    }

    public function getResult() {
        return $this->result;
    }
  }
}

          $result["success"] = "false";
          $result["status"] = "Error";
          $result["message"] = $errors[2];

      $setUser = parent::prepare($sqlSetUsername);
      $setUser->execute();

      parent::beginTransaction();
      $query = parent::prepare($command);
      $query->execute();

      $rowcount = $query->rowCount();
      if($rowcount <= 0){
        parent::rollback();
        $errors = $query->errorInfo();
        $result["success"] = "false";
        $result["status"] = "Error";
        $result["message"] = $errors[2];
      } else {
        parent::commit();
        $result["success"] = "true";
        $result["status"] = "Success";
        $result["message"] = $rowcount." row(s) updated in database";

    /**
     * Helper internal untuk menset session username pada level PostgreSQL Core.
     * Mencegah crash jika session kosong.
     */
    private function setAuditUser() {
      $username = (isset($_SESSION["username"]) && $_SESSION["username"] != '') ? $_SESSION["username"] : 'system';
      $sqlSetUsername = "SET app.username to " . parent::quote($username);
      $setUser = parent::prepare($sqlSetUsername);
      $setUser->execute();
    }

    /*
    * FUNGSI ASLI FRAMEWORK: Insert values into the table
    */
    public function insert($table, $rows = null) {
      $this->setAuditUser();

      $insert = 'INSERT INTO '.$table;
      if($rows != null) {
        $insert .= ' ('.implode(',',array_keys($rows)).')';
        for($i = 0; $i < count($rows); $i++) {
          if(is_string($rows[array_keys($rows)[$i]]))
            $rows[array_keys($rows)[$i]] =	"'".$rows[array_keys($rows)[$i]]."'";
        }
        $insert .= ' VALUES ('.implode(',',array_values($rows)).')';
      }
      $query = parent::prepare($insert);
      $query->execute();
    }

    /*
    * FUNGSI ASLI FRAMEWORK: Delete table or rows
    */
    public function delete($table, $where = null) {
      $this->setAuditUser();

      $delete = 'DELETE FROM '.$table;
      if($where != null) {
        $delete .= ' WHERE '.$where;
      }
      $query = parent::prepare($delete);
      $query->execute();
    }

    /*
    * FUNGSI ASLI FRAMEWORK: Update values inside the table
    */
    public function update($table, $rows, $where) {
      $this->setAuditUser();

      $update = 'UPDATE '.$table.' SET ';
      $keys = array_keys($rows);
      for($i = 0; $i < count($rows); $i++) {
        if(is_string($rows[$keys[$i]])) {
          $update .= $keys[$i].'=\''.$rows[$keys[$i]].'\'';
        } else {
          $update .= $keys[$i].'='.$rows[$keys[$i]];
        }
        if($i != count($rows)-1) {
          $update .= ',';
        }
      }
      $update .= ' WHERE '.$where;
      $query = parent::prepare($update);
      $query->execute();
    }

    /*

    public function select($arg1, $arg2 = '*', $arg3 = null, $arg4 = null, $arg5 = 'data', $arg6 = 0, $arg7 = 250) {

      // Deteksi otomatis jika parameter pertama diisi 'data' atau 'history' (Pola m.item.grade.php / m.employee.status.php)
      if ($arg1 === 'data' || $arg1 === 'history') {
          $jsonName = $arg1;
          $table    = $arg2;
          $rows     = $arg3;
          $where    = $arg4;
          $order    = $arg5 !== 'data' ? $arg5 : null;
          // Pada kode asli m.item.grade.php: arg6 adalah limit, arg7 adalah offset
          $limit    = $arg6;
          $offset   = $arg7;
      } else {
          // Pola penulisan standar framework
          $table    = $arg1;
          $rows     = $arg2;
          $where    = $arg3;
          $order    = $arg4;
          $jsonName = $arg5;
          $offset   = $arg6;
          $limit    = $arg7;
      }

      // Pastikan limit dan offset bertipe integer murni
      $limit  = ($limit === null || $limit === '') ? 250 : intval($limit);
      $offset = ($offset === null || $offset === '') ? 0 : intval($offset);

      $q = 'SELECT '.$rows.' FROM '.$table;
      if($where != null && trim($where) != '') $q .= ' WHERE '.$where;
      if($order != null && trim($order) != '') $q .= ' ORDER BY '.$order;
      $q .= ' LIMIT '.$limit.' OFFSET '.$offset;

      $query = parent::prepare($q);
      $query->execute();
      $response = $query->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

      // Hitung total data keseluruhan tanpa limit untuk penomoran halaman ExtJS paging toolbar
      $commandAll = 'SELECT '.$rows.' FROM '.$table;
      if($where != null && trim($where) != '') $commandAll .= ' WHERE '.$where;

      $queryAll = parent::prepare($commandAll);
      $queryAll->execute();
      $totalRows = $queryAll->rowCount();

      // Output string JSON murni yang sesuai dengan konfigurasi JsonReader ExtJS
      $this->result = "{'totalRecord':'".$totalRows."','".$jsonName."':".json_encode($response)."}";
    }

      if($where != null && $where != '') $q .= ' WHERE '.$where;
      if($order != null && $order != '') $q .= ' ORDER BY '.$order;
      if($limit != null) $q .= ' LIMIT '.$limit;
      if($offset != null) $q .= ' OFFSET '.$offset;

      $query = parent::prepare($q);
      $query->execute();
      $response = $query->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

      $commandAll = 'SELECT '.$rows.' FROM '.$table;
      if($where != null && $where != '') $commandAll .= ' WHERE '.$where;
      $queryAll = parent::prepare($commandAll);
      $queryAll->execute();
      $rowsAll = $queryAll->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

      $this->result = "{'totalRecord':'".count($rowsAll)."','".$jsonName."':".json_encode($response)."}";
    }*/

    /*
    * FUNGSI ASLI FRAMEWORK: Menjalankan Raw Multi-Query teks lama
    */
    public function cmdQ($command) {
      try {
        $this->setAuditUser();

        parent::beginTransaction();
        $query = parent::prepare($command);
        $query->execute();

        $rowcount = $query->rowCount();
        parent::commit();

        $result["success"] = "true";
        $result["status"] = "Success";
        $result["message"] = $rowcount." row(s) updated in database...";
        $this->result = json_encode($result);
        return true;
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
        if (parent::inTransaction()) {
            parent::rollback();
        }
        $result["success"] = "false";
        $result["status"] = "Error";
        $result["message"] = "Gagal memproses data: " . $e->getMessage();
        $this->result = json_encode($result);
        return false;
      }
    }

    /**
     * FITUR TAMBAHAN BARU: Digunakan khusus untuk transaksi aman berbasis parameter terikat (Anti SQL Injection)
     */
    public function safeTransaction($queriesAndParams) {
      try {
        $this->setAuditUser();

        parent::beginTransaction();

        $totalUpdated = 0;
        foreach ($queriesAndParams as $item) {
            $stmt = parent::prepare($item['query']);
            $stmt->execute($item['params']);
            $totalUpdated += $stmt->rowCount();
        }

        parent::commit();

        $result["success"] = "true";
        $result["status"] = "Success";
        $result["message"] = "Data berhasil disimpan.";
        $this->result = json_encode($result);
        return true;
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
        if (parent::inTransaction()) {
            parent::rollback();
        }
        $result["success"] = "false";
        $result["status"] = "Error";
        $result["message"] = "Transaksi Gagal: " . $e->getMessage();
        $this->result = json_encode($result);
        return false;
      }
    }

    public function getResult() {
      return $this->result;
    }
  }
}
?>

// ==================================================================
// HELPER: InsertOpnameItemsAndAdjust
// Insert semua baris hitung (termasuk yang cocok/tanpa selisih, buat
// audit trail), tapi cuma posting stock_movements ADJUSTMENT untuk
// baris yang ada selisih. Return jumlah baris yang ada selisih.
// ==================================================================
function InsertOpnameItemsAndAdjust($db, $opnameId, $opnameNo, $opnameDate, $warehouseId, $binLocationId, array $items) {
    $varianceCount = 0;

    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $itemId     = intval($it['item_id'] ?? 0);
        $itemName   = trim($it['item_name'] ?? '');
        $gradeId    = !empty($it['grade_id']) ? intval($it['grade_id']) : null;
        $systemQty  = round(floatval($it['system_qty'] ?? 0), 4);
        $countedQty = round(floatval($it['counted_qty'] ?? 0), 4);
        $remark     = trim($it['remark'] ?? '');

        if ($itemId <= 0) {
            continue;
        }

        $variance = round($countedQty - $systemQty, 4);

        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('stock_opname_dtl', [
            'opname_hdr_id'   => $opnameId,
            'item_id'         => $itemId,
            'item_name'       => $itemName,
            'grade_id'        => $gradeId,
            'bin_location_id' => $binLocationId,
            'system_qty'      => $systemQty,
            'counted_qty'     => $countedQty,
            'variance_qty'    => $variance,
            'remark'          => $remark
        ]), 'insert stock_opname_dtl');

        if (abs($variance) < 0.0001) {
            continue; // cocok, gak perlu movement
        }

        $varianceCount++;

        PostStockMovement($db, [
            'movement_date'   => $opnameDate,
            'item_id'         => $itemId,
            'grade_id'        => $gradeId,
            'warehouse_id'    => $warehouseId,
            'bin_location_id' => $binLocationId,
            'movement_type'   => $variance > 0 ? 'IN' : 'OUT',
            'qty'             => abs($variance),
            'reference_type'  => 'adjustment',
            'reference_id'    => $opnameId,
            'reference_no'    => $opnameNo,
        ]);
    }

    return $varianceCount;
}

<?php
/*
  Document      : Stock Card (Kartu Stok) Monitoring - Backend Controller
  Description   : Laporan saldo & mutasi stok per item + gudang. Read-only,
                   semua dihitung langsung dari stock_movements (satu-satunya
                   sumber kebenaran, sama prinsip dengan deposit_reportCRD.php).
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;
}

$task = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read_summary';
$db   = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. COMBO: Gudang (+ opsi "Semua Gudang" ditambahkan di client)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_warehouse':
        $sql = "SELECT id, name FROM m_warehouse WHERE active = true ORDER BY name ASC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. COMBO: Item (search remote, supaya tidak load semua item sekaligus)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_item_combo':
        $query = trim($_POST['query'] ?? '');
        $sql = "SELECT id, name FROM items WHERE is_active = true";
        $params = [];
        if ($query !== '') {
            $sql .= " AND name ILIKE :query";
            $params['query'] = '%' . $query . '%';
        }
        $sql .= " ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 50";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. RINGKASAN: saldo per item (+ grade) di gudang terpilih
    //    (warehouse_id = 0 -> semua gudang digabung, via view_stock_balance_total)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_summary':
        $warehouseId = intval($_POST['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);
        $onlyNonZero = ($_POST['only_non_zero'] ?? '1') === '1';

        if ($warehouseId > 0) {
            $sql = "
                SELECT
                    vb.item_id, vb.grade_id, i.name AS item_name,
                    vb.warehouse_id, vb.warehouse_name,
                    vb.balance_qty, vb.avg_unit_cost
                FROM view_stock_balance vb
                LEFT JOIN items i ON i.id = vb.item_id
                WHERE vb.warehouse_id = :warehouse_id
                " . ($onlyNonZero ? " AND vb.balance_qty <> 0 " : "") . "
                ORDER BY i.name ASC
            ";
            $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->execute(['warehouse_id' => $warehouseId]);
        } else {
            $sql = "
                SELECT
                    vt.item_id, vt.grade_id, i.name AS item_name,
                    NULL AS warehouse_id, 'Semua Gudang' AS warehouse_name,
                    vt.balance_qty, NULL AS avg_unit_cost
                FROM view_stock_balance_total vt
                LEFT JOIN items i ON i.id = vt.item_id
                WHERE 1=1
                " . ($onlyNonZero ? " AND vt.balance_qty <> 0 " : "") . "
                ORDER BY i.name ASC
            ";
            $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->execute();
        }

        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. DETAIL MUTASI per item (+grade opsional, +warehouse opsional)
    //    warehouse_id = 0 -> gabung semua gudang, running balance dihitung
    //    total lintas gudang (urut tanggal).
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_mutation':
        $itemId      = intval($_POST['item_id'] ?? 0);
        $gradeId     = intval($_POST['grade_id'] ?? 0);
        $warehouseId = intval($_POST['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);

        if ($itemId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => []]);
            exit;
        }

        $where = "sm.item_id = :item_id";
        $params = ['item_id' => $itemId];

        if ($gradeId > 0) {
            $where .= " AND sm.grade_id = :grade_id";
            $params['grade_id'] = $gradeId;
        }
        if ($warehouseId > 0) {
            $where .= " AND sm.warehouse_id = :warehouse_id";
            $params['warehouse_id'] = $warehouseId;
        }

        $sql = "
            SELECT
                sm.movement_date, sm.movement_type, sm.qty, sm.unit_cost,
                sm.reference_type, sm.reference_no, sm.remark,
                wh.name AS warehouse_name,
                SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type = 'IN' THEN sm.qty ELSE -sm.qty END)
                    OVER (ORDER BY sm.movement_date ASC, sm.id ASC) AS running_balance
            FROM stock_movements sm
            LEFT JOIN m_warehouse wh ON wh.id = sm.warehouse_id
            WHERE {$where}
            ORDER BY sm.movement_date ASC, sm.id ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
}
